1.name: Invigoration
1.description: If Hamstring hits a Hero, half of the Mana cost is refunded and the cooldown is reduced by 1 second.

2.name: Block
2.description: Every 5 seconds, gain 75 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing the damage taken by 75%.  Stores up to 2 charges.

3.name: Chop Meat
3.description: Increases Hamstring damage by 100% to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters.

1.name: Flail Axe
1.description: Increases the length of Hamstring by 40%.

2.name: Unrelenting Pursuit
2.description: Reduces the cooldown of Ruthless Onslaught by 33% upon impact.

3.name: Cheap Shot
3.description: Hamstring does 100% more damage to targets affected by a Slow, Root, or Stun.

1.name: Insatiable Blade
1.description: While facing a branded enemy, The Butcher's Movement Speed is increased by 25%.

2.name: Victuals
2.description: Every time a nearby enemy minion dies, The Butcher heals 5% of his maximum health.

3.name: Meat Shield
3.description: When Ruthless Onslaught impacts an enemy Hero, The Butcher gains 50 Spell Armor for 2.5 seconds, reducing Ability Damage taken by 50%.

1.name: Furnace Blast
1.description: After a 3 second delay, fire explodes around The Butcher dealing 500 (+4% per level) damage to enemies.  Can be cast while using Ruthless Onslaught.

2.name: Lamb to the Slaughter
2.description: Throw a hitching post that attaches to the nearest enemy Hero after a 1 second delay. This deals 171 (+4% per level) damage and causes the enemy to be chained to the post and Silenced for 3 seconds.

1.name: Cleaver
1.description: Basic Attacks deal 35% of The Butcher's Basic Attack Damage in an area around the target.

2.name: Savage Charge
2.description: Ruthless Onslaught deals bonus damage to Heroes equal to 10% of their maximum Health.

3.name: Brutal Strike
3.description: After using Hamstring, The Butcher's next 3 Basic Attacks within 5 seconds deal an additional 15% damage.

1.name: Crippling Slam
1.description: Hamstring's slow no longer fades out, and the duration is increased by 30%.

2.name: Enraged
2.description: While below 50% of his maximum Health, taking damage causes The Butcher to become Enraged for 10 seconds, gaining 40% Attack Speed and 25 Armor, reducing damage taken by 25%.  This effect has a 25 second cooldown.

3.name: Blood Frenzy
3.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes grant 5% increased Attack and Movement Speed for 3 seconds, up to 25%.

1.name: Fires of Hell
1.description: Furnace Blast explodes a second time 3 seconds after the initial explosion.

2.name: Slaughterhouse
2.description: Lamb to the Slaughter now chains all enemy Heroes in range.

3.name: Nexus Blades
3.description: Basic Attacks deal 20% more damage and Slow enemy Movement Speed by 20% for 1 second.

4.name: Bolt of the Storm
4.description: Activate to teleport to a nearby location.

1.name: Widowmakers
1.description: Enemies hit by Corpse Spiders' jar are Slowed by 25% for 1 second.  Reward: After Corpse Spiders attack Heroes 100 times, their attack damage is increased by 25% and their duration is increased by 1 second.

2.name: Pandemic
2.description: Quest: Hit Heroes with Plague of Toads.  Reward: After hitting 35 Heroes with Plague of Toads, it spawns 2 additional toads.  Reward: After hitting 70 Heroes with Plague of Toads, it reduces the damage Heroes deal by 5%, stacking up to 25%.

3.name: Thing of the Deep
3.description: Increase the range of Nazeebo's Basic Abilities by 20%.  Reward: After gaining 50 stacks of Voodoo Ritual, gain 5% Spell Power.  Reward: After gaining 100 stacks of Voodoo Ritual, gain an additional 5% Spell Power.

1.name: Hexed Crawlers
1.description: Corpse Spiders restore 1% of Nazeebo's maximum Health and Mana when they attack an enemy Hero.

2.name: Big Voodoo
2.description: Increases the Health and Mana bonuses from Voodoo Ritual by 100%.

3.name: Blood Ritual
3.description: If an enemy dies while poisoned by Voodoo Ritual, restore 2% of Nazeebo's maximum Health and Mana.  Passive: Takedowns grant 3 stacks of Voodoo Ritual.

1.name: Spirit of Arachyr
1.description: The number of Corpse Spiders spawned is increased from 3 to 4. If Corpse Spiders' jar hits only one enemy, it creates an additional spider.

2.name: Dead Rush
2.description: Zombie Wall deals 100% more damage. When it expires up to 5 remaining Zombies uproot and attack nearby enemies for 3 seconds.

3.name: Toads of Hugeness
3.description: Increase the damage and explosion radius of Plague of Toads by 25% after each hop, up to a maximum of 100%.

1.name: Gargantuan
1.description: Summon a Gargantuan to guard an area for 20 seconds. Deals 100 (+4% per level) damage when summoned, attacks for 140 (+4% per level) damage, and can be ordered to stomp nearby enemies. The Gargantuan's Stomp deals 140 (+4% per level) damage and Slows by 30% for 2 seconds.

2.name: Ravenous Spirit
2.description: Channel a Ravenous Spirit that deals 230 (+4% per level) damage per second. Cannot move while channeling. Lasts for 8 seconds.

1.name: Guardian Toads
1.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Plague of Toads grants 30 Armor for 3 seconds, stacking up to 6 seconds.

2.name: Superstition
2.description: Gain 40 Spell Armor. Heroic Basic Attacks against Nazeebo remove this bonus for 3 seconds and spawn a Corpse Spider to attack the Hero.

3.name: Ice Block
3.description: Activate to place yourself in Stasis and gain Invulnerability for 3 seconds.

1.name: Spider Colony
1.description: Corpse Spider Attacks against Heroes reduce the cooldown of Nazeebo's Basic Abilities by 0.125 seconds.

2.name: Ring of Poison
2.description: Zombie Wall lasts 1 second longer, and the center is filled with poison that deals a total of 319 (+4% per level) damage over 4 seconds. This damage starts small and increases over the duration.

3.name: Soul Harvest
3.description: Activate to increase Nazeebo's Health and Spell Power by 7% for each nearby enemy, up to a maximum of 35%. Lasts 15 seconds.

1.name: Humongoid
1.description: Gargantuan Stomp's area is increased by 25% and its Slow amount is increased to 50%.  Passive: Reduce Gargantuan's cooldown by 40 seconds and its Mana cost by 50%.

2.name: Annihilating Spirit
2.description: When Ravenous Spirit damages an enemy Hero, reduce their healing received by 50% for 1 second and increase Ravenous Spirit's damage by 5% for the rest of its duration.  Passive: Increases the range of Ravenous Spirit by 50%.

3.name: Vile Infection
3.description: Quest: Reach 175 stacks of Voodoo Ritual.  Reward: After reaching 175 stacks of Voodoo Ritual, it can also be applied to Heroes and its damage is increased from 67 (+4% per level) to 167 (+4% per level) over 6 seconds.

4.name: Bad Medicine
4.description: Consume 5 stacks of Voodoo Ritual to become Unstoppable, gain 20% increased Movement Speed, and 50 Armor for 2 seconds.

1.name: Exterminator
1.description: Basic Attacks deal 50% more damage to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters. This is increased to 125% while Inspire is active.  Passive: Inspire does not expire on friendly Minions and Mercenaries.

2.name: Veteran Marksman
2.description: Quest: Every time the primary target of Give 'Em Some Pepper is a Hero, permanently increase its damage bonus by 0.75%.  Gambit: Gain 60% bonus Give 'Em Some Pepper damage. Every death reduces this bonus by 15%.

3.name: Ace In The Hole
3.description: Deal 12% more damage to Stunned or Slowed Heroes.  Enemy Heroes hit by Give 'Em Some Pepper are Slowed by 10% for 2.5 seconds.

1.name: Fight or Flight
1.description: Reduce Adrenaline Rush's cooldown by 10 seconds. Casting Adrenaline Rush grants 25 Armor for 3 seconds.

2.name: Sustaining Rounds
2.description: Give 'Em Some Pepper heals Raynor for 3% of his maximum Health, increased to 6% if the primary target is a Hero.

3.name: Behemoth Armor
3.description: Gain 200 bonus maximum Health.   Quest: Every time Give 'Em Some Pepper's primary target is a Hero, gain an additional 8 maximum Health.

1.name: Heavy Slugs
1.description: Increase Penetrating Round's Slow by 15% and its duration by 2 seconds.

2.name: Fuel The Rush
2.description: Reduce the Mana cost of Adrenaline Rush from 75 to 45. While Inspire is active, increase Adrenaline Rush's cooldown reduction from Basic Attacks by 300%.

3.name: Unstable Compound
3.description: Increase the area of Give 'Em Some Pepper by 15%. Each enemy Hero hit by Give 'Em Some Pepper grants Raynor 10 Mana and reduces the cooldown of Penetrating Round by 1.5 seconds.

1.name: Hyperion
1.description: Order the Hyperion to make a strafing run for 12 seconds, hitting up to 4 enemies for 66 (+4% per level) damage every second. Every 4 seconds, it can fire its Yamato Cannon at a Structure, dealing 794 (+4% per level) damage.

2.name: Raynor's Raider
2.description: Summon a Banshee that assists Raynor. The Banshee deals 84 (+4% per level) damage per second and regenerates 75 (+4% per level) Health per second if it hasn't taken damage in the last 4 seconds. Can reactivate to retarget or move the Banshee.  The Banshee respawns automatically after 45 seconds.

1.name: Line 'Em Up
1.description: Reduce the cooldown of Penetrating Round by 3 seconds. Penetrating Round hitting two or more enemy Heroes reduces its cooldown by an additional 3 seconds.

2.name: Giddy-Up
2.description: Gain 10% Movement Speed while mounted and unmounted. Inspire grants 10% more Movement Speed.

3.name: Give Me More!
3.description: Increase Adrenaline Rush healing by 50%. While Inspire is active, gain 1 Basic Attack range.

1.name: Paint Them Red
1.description: Increase the damage of Penetrating Round by 50% and heal for 90% of the damage Penetrating Round deals to Heroes.

2.name: Rallying Cry
2.description: Increase the Attack Speed bonus of Inspire by 20%.  Passive: After every 12 Basic Attacks, cast Inspire for free.

3.name: Bounty Hunter
3.description: If Give 'Em Some Pepper's target is a Hero, it deals an additional 3% of their maximum Health as damage and grants Raynor 10 Armor for 3 seconds.  Activate Give 'Em Some Pepper to apply it to Raynor's next Basic Attack.

1.name: Cavalry's Arrived
1.description: Give 'Em Some Pepper lowers the cooldown of Hyperion by 5 seconds if the primary target is a Hero. These Heroes are targeted by the Hyperion for 100% increased damage for 6 seconds.

2.name: Dusk Wing
2.description: Increase the Health and leash range of Raynor's Raider by 100%. Its Basic Attack lowers enemy Hero Armor by 3 for 1 second, stacking up to 30.

3.name: Raiders Roll
3.description: Adrenaline Rush grants Unstoppable and continues healing for an additional 2 seconds. The additional duration ends upon reaching 70% Health.

4.name: Sergeant Pepper
4.description: Give 'Em Some Pepper now activates every 3 Basic Attacks.

5.name: Execute Orders
5.description: Reduce Raynor's death timer by 35 seconds. Upon death, the Hyperion is cast towards the closest enemy Hero.

1.name: Salvation
1.description: Increase the Shield amount Tyrael gains from Righteousness by 40% and heal Tyrael for 140 (+4% per level) Health if his Shield is destroyed. Does not increase the Shield amount gained by allies.

2.name: Justice for All
2.description: Increase the Shield applied to allies by Righteousness to 80% of the Shield gained by Tyrael.

3.name: Ardent Restoration
3.description: Dealing damage to a Hero heals Tyrael for 20 (+4% per level) Health over 5 seconds. Dealing damage resets this timer, and the heal amount stacks up to 10 times.  Quest: Every Regeneration Globe gathered increases this heal amount by 1%.

1.name: Stalwart Angel
1.description: Gain 25 Armor while El'druin's Might is active, and for 3 seconds after teleporting.

2.name: Bound by Law
2.description: Heroes hit by El'druin's Might heal Tyrael for 3% of his maximum Health. Tyrael's Basic Attacks against enemies Slowed by El'druin's Might increase the Slow duration by 1 second, up to 4 seconds.

3.name: Divine Vigor
3.description: If Smite hits an enemy, Tyrael's Basic Attacks within the next 4 seconds heal for 70% of the damage dealt.

1.name: Reciprocate
1.description: When Tyrael's Shield from Righteousness expires or is destroyed, it deals 190 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies.

2.name: Purge Evil
2.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Smite increases Tyrael's Basic Attack damage by 60% for 4 seconds.

3.name: Swift Retribution
3.description: Smite grants 20% more Movement Speed and also grants 25% Attack Speed for 2 seconds.

1.name: Judgment
1.description: After 0.75 seconds, charge an enemy Hero, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 1.5 seconds. Nearby enemies are knocked away and take 75 (+4% per level) damage.

2.name: Sanctification
2.description: After 0.5 seconds create a field of holy energy that makes allied Heroes Invulnerable. Lasts 3 seconds.

1.name: Sword of Justice
1.description: Upon teleporting using El'druin's Might, El'druin swaps places with Tyrael, and El'druin's Might can be reactivated to teleport an additional time.

2.name: Holy Ground
2.description: Create a ring for 3 seconds that blocks enemies from entering the area teleported to using El'druin's Might.

3.name: Law and Order
3.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Smite reduces the cooldown of Righteousness by 1 second. Each allied Hero Shielded by Righteousness increases the damage of the next Smite by 35%.

1.name: Horadric Reforging
1.description: Tyrael's Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of El'druin's Might by 2 seconds.

2.name: Burning Halo
2.description: Both Tyrael and El'druin deal 18 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. Teleporting increases this damage from Tyrael by 150% for 2 seconds.

3.name: Smite the Wicked
3.description: While El'druin's Might is active, and for 2 seconds after teleporting, Smite's cooldown recharges 125% faster.

1.name: Angel of Justice
1.description: Increases the cast range of Judgment by 50%, and reduces the cooldown by 40 seconds.

2.name: Holy Arena
2.description: Increase the duration of Sanctification by 1 second and increase the damage of allies inside by 25%.

3.name: Seal of El'druin
3.description: Using a Basic Ability grants 50% Attack Speed for 3 seconds.

4.name: Defense of the Angels
4.description: Activate to gain 50 Armor for 3 seconds.  Each time Tyrael damages an enemy Hero with a Basic Attack or Basic Ability, increase the duration of this Armor bonus by 0.5 seconds.

1.name: Free Drinks
1.description: Healing Brew's cooldown is reduced by 1 second and its Mana cost is refunded if it heals a Hero under 50% Health.

2.name: Serpent Sidekick
2.description: Cloud Serpent no longer costs Mana and while Fast Feet is active its cooldown refreshes an additional 75% faster.

3.name: Eager Adventurer
3.description: Increase Fast Feet's duration by 150% and increase Mana regeneration by 150% while Fast Feet is active.

1.name: Wind Serpent
1.description: Cloud Serpent grants its bearer 10% increased Movement Speed. Casting Blinding Wind increases this bonus to 20% for 3 seconds.  Passive: Cloud Serpent attacks 25% faster.

2.name: Surging Winds
2.description: If Blinding Wind hits 2 Heroes, its cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds and Li Li gains 10% Spell Power for 10 seconds.

3.name: Safety Sprint
3.description: Activate to gain Fast Feet, 30 Armor, and 30% Movement Speed for 3 seconds.  Passive: While Fast Feet is active, Li Li gains 10 Armor.

1.name: The Good Stuff
1.description: Healing Brew heals for an additional 42 (+4% per level) over 3 seconds. While Fast Feet is active, this heal amount is increased by 100%.

2.name: Mass Vortex
2.description: Increase the number of enemies hit by Blinding Wind from 2 to 3. Blinding Wind deals 75% additional damage if all 3 enemies hit are Heroes.

3.name: Let's Go!
3.description: Activate to heal an allied Hero for 160 (+4% per level) and make them Unstoppable for 1 second. Let's Go's cooldown is affected by Fast Feet.  Cannot be used on Li Li.

1.name: Jug of 1,000 Cups
1.description: Channel for up to 6 seconds. Every 0.25 seconds, increase the cooldown of Jug of 1,000 Cups by 2 seconds, up to 50 additional seconds, and heal the lowest Health nearby allied Hero for 66 (+4% per level) Health.

2.name: Water Dragon
2.description: Li Li channels for 2 seconds, summoning a Water Dragon that hits the nearest enemy Hero within 12 range and all enemies near them, dealing 300 (+4% per level) damage and slowing their Movement Speed by 70% for 4 seconds.

1.name: Lightning Serpent
1.description: Cloud Serpent attacks bounce to hit 2 additional targets for 13 (+4% per level) damage and 10 (+4% per level) healing.

2.name: Gale Force
2.description: Increase Blinding Wind's Blind duration by 0.75 seconds. Li Li's Basic Attacks against Blinded Heroes deal 100% increased damage.

3.name: Hindering Winds
3.description: Increase Blinding Wind's Slow amount to 30% and its duration to 2 seconds.

1.name: Two For One
1.description: Increases the number of allies healed by Healing Brew to 2, but increases the cooldown by 1 second.

2.name: Pick Me Up
2.description: Healing Brew's healing for Heroes is increased by 33% if they are under 50% Health.

3.name: Blessings Of Yu'lon
3.description: Cloud Serpent grants its bearer 10% increased healing received and heals them for an additional 0.5% of their maximum Health each time it attacks.

1.name: Jug of 1,000,000 Cups
1.description: Jug of 1,000 Cups heals two allies at a time.

2.name: Double Dragon
2.description: After hitting a target with Water Dragon, another Water Dragon is summoned at the point of impact.

3.name: Mistweaver
3.description: Activate to heal nearby allied Heroes for 149 (+4% per level). Basic Attacks and Cloud Serpent attacks reduce the cooldown of Mistweaver by 1 second.

4.name: Shake It Off
4.description: Gain 35 Armor while Stunned, Silenced, or Rooted.  Passive: Increase Fast Feet's cooldown refresh rate to 75%

1.name: Stormcaller
1.description: Increase the radius of Lightning Shield by 25%.  Quest: Each time Lightning Shield damages an enemy Hero, permanently increase Rehgar's Health by 2 and Mana by 1, stacking up to 300 times.

2.name: Colossal Totem
2.description: Reactivate Earthbind Totem to move an existing totem to a new location. This can be used once per cast.  Passive: Increase Earthbind Totem's area and duration by 50%, and Health by 25%.

3.name: Feral Heart
3.description: Ghost Wolf's Movement Speed bonus is increased to 40% for the first second, then falls to 30%. Entering or exiting Ghost Wolf form grants 15 Armor for 1 second.

1.name: Earthliving Enchant
1.description: When Chain Heal heals a Hero below 50% Health, they are healed an additional 160 (+4% per level) Health over 4 seconds.

2.name: Electric Charge
2.description: The bearer of Lightning Shield Heals for 20% of the damage it deals to enemy Heroes, doubled if the bearer is Rehgar.  While Lightning Shield is damaging an enemy, its bearer gains 10% increased Movement Speed.

3.name: Healing Totem
3.description: Activate to place a Totem that heals allied Heroes in an area for 2% of their maximum Health every second. This Totem has 125 (+4% per level) Health and lasts for 10 seconds.

1.name: Grounded Totem
1.description: Enemy Heroes in Earthbind Totem's area also have their Attack Speed Slowed by 25% and their Spell Power reduced by 15%.  Passive: Increase Earthbind Totem's range by 50%.

2.name: Purification
2.description: If Purge removes a Slow, Stun, Root, or Silence effect from an ally, heal them for 220 (+4% per level).  Using Purge on an enemy Hero deals up to 330 (+4% per level) damage to Shields and reduces healing received by 40% for 2 seconds.  Passive: Reduce Purge's cooldown by 15 seconds.

3.name: Blood and Thunder
3.description: Ghost Wolf attacks reduce Basic Ability cooldowns by 1.5 seconds and restore 5% of Rehgar's maximum Mana.

1.name: Ancestral Healing
1.description: After 1 second, heal an allied Hero for 1180 (+4% per level) Health.

2.name: Bloodlust
2.description: Grant nearby allied Heroes 40% Attack Speed and 35% Movement Speed and causes them to heal for 30% of the Basic Attack damage to their primary target. Lasts for 6 seconds.

1.name: Tidal Waves
1.description: Reduces Chain Heal's cooldown by 1 second for each Hero healed, and reduces its Mana cost from 60 to 40.

2.name: Earth Shield
2.description: Lightning Shield gives Heroes a Shield that absorbs damage equal to 14% of their maximum Health for 3 seconds.

3.name: Wellspring
3.description: Every 2 seconds, Earthbind Totem will cast an untalented Chain Heal at the nearest allied Hero with the lowest Health. This Chain Heal heals for 35% of its normal amount.

1.name: Rising Storm
1.description: Every time a Lighting Shield damages an enemy Hero, increase its damage by 10%. Stacks up to 15 times.  Passive: Increase the duration of Lightning Shield by 3 seconds.

2.name: Earthgrasp Totem
2.description: When Earthbind Totem is first cast, it deals 115 (+4% per level) damage and Slows nearby enemies by 90% for 1 second.

3.name: Hunger of the Wolf
3.description: Ghost Wolf attacks against Heroes deal an additional 6% of the target's maximum Health and heal Rehgar for 6% of his maximum Health.

1.name: Farseer's Blessing
1.description: After 1.5 seconds, Ancestral Healing is cast a second time on the same target. Allies near the target are healed for 590 (+4% per level).

2.name: Gladiator's War Shout
2.description: Increase the duration and range of Bloodlust by 100%.

3.name: Elemental Conduit
3.description: Activate to gain Lightning Shield and grant all nearby allied Heroes a Shield equal to 10% of their maximum Health for 5 seconds.  For up to 5 seconds after activating, hitting an enemy Hero with this effects' Lightning Shield gives nearby allies a Shield equal to 1.5% of their maximum Health for 5 seconds.

4.name: Pit Fighter
4.description: Gain 10% increased Attack Damage and 3 Spell Power. Each nearby ally Hero grants an additional stack of this effect, up to 5 stacks.  While at 2 or more stacks, Purge's cooldown refreshes 50% faster.

1.name: Journeyman Cooking
1.description: Each Hero hit by Ez-Thro Dynamite heals you for 8% of maximum Health.  Quest: Hitting Heroes with Ez-Thro Dynamite permanently increases your maximum Health by 10, to a maximum of 750 bonus Health.

2.name: Bones to Gnaw
2.description: Loot Hoard creates a chunk of Meat when it lands. While under the effects of Meat, gain 10 Armor.

3.name: On The Prowl
3.description: Activate to gain 30 Rage over 8 seconds.  Passive: You heal for 8 (+4% per level) Health every second, increased by 2% per point of Rage.

1.name: Brute Force
1.description: Increase the range of Loot Hoard by 20% and its damage by 50%.  Quest: Hitting Heroes with Staggering Blow permanently increases Basic Attack damage by 2, to a maximum of 150 bonus damage. Enemy Heroes that hit terrain grant an additional 8 damage.

2.name: Aggro Range
2.description: Increase Hogg Wild's radius by 20% and each enemy hit generates 0.5 Rage, increased to 2 against Heroes.

3.name: Hogger's Joggers
3.description: While above 30 Rage, gain 10% increased Movement Speed and healing received.  When at or above 50 Rage, increase these bonuses to 15%.

1.name: Dense Blasting Powder
1.description: Instant detonations of Ez-Thro Dynamite creates an additional dynamite behind the Hero hit.  Hitting the bundle of Ez-Thro Dynamite with Staggering Blow breaks it into three sticks and launches them forward in an arc.

2.name: Garbage Fire
2.description: Reduce the cooldown of Loot Hoard by 2 seconds.  Every 0.5 seconds, enemies in a large area around Loot Hoard take 23 (+4% per level) damage and are Slowed by 20%.

3.name: Seeing Red
3.description: While above 50 Rage, gain 35% Attack Speed and the cooldowns of Staggering Blow and Hogg Wild refresh 30% faster.

1.name: Hoardapult
1.description: Launch an empowered Loot Hoard with Hogger attached, dealing 100 (+4% per level) damage and Slowing enemies by 50% for 2 seconds.  Hoardapult's Loot Hoard lasts for up to 20 seconds, decaying rapidly while not nearby. Every 10 seconds Hogger can take a chunk of Meat from the Loot Hoard.

2.name: Shockwave
2.description: After 0.5 seconds, slam the ground, sending out a shockwave that travels in a long line. Enemies hit by the initial slam take 335 (+4% per level) damage and are Stunned for 1.5 seconds. Enemies only hit by the shockwave take 230 (+4% per level) damage and are Stunned for 0.75 seconds.

1.name: Dust Devil
1.description: Gain 20 Armor while Hogg Wild is active and for 3 seconds after. When at or above 50 Rage, increase this Armor to 40.

2.name: Pummel
2.description: Enemies hit by Hogg Wild are Slowed by 10% for 2 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.  Heroes hit have their Spell Power reduced by 50% for 2 seconds.

3.name: Bloodthirst
3.description: Damaging Heroes with Basic Attacks, Staggering Blow, or Hogg Wild heals you for 33% of the damage dealt.

1.name: Headbanger
1.description: Enemy Heroes Stunned by Staggering Blow take an additional 8% of their maximum Health as damage and are Stunned for an additional 0.5 seconds.

2.name: Kablooie!
2.description: Instant Ez-Thro Dynamite detonations deal 50% more damage, reduce its cooldown by 1.5 seconds, and increase its Slow amount to 50%.  Passive: Increase Ez-Thro Dynamite's range by 25%.

3.name: Furzerker
3.description: Hitting Heroes with Staggering Blow or Ez-Thro Dynamite increases the damage of the next Basic Attack within 8 seconds by 50%, stacking up to 2 times.  When Hogg Wild ends, gain 30% Movement Speed for 2 seconds.

1.name: Secret Stash
1.description: Every 2 seconds, Hoardapults' Loot Hoard randomly launches Ez-Thro Dynamite, prioritizing nearby enemy Heroes.  Every 5 seconds, it also launches a chunk of Meat towards Hogger.

2.name: Power Spike
2.description: Hitting Heroes with Shockwave reduces their Armor by 15 for 4 seconds and grants 20 Rage.  Passive: Rage's cooldown reduction affects Shockwave's cooldown.

3.name: No Control
3.description: Activate to cast an untalented Hogg Wild and begin chasing an enemy Hero. After reaching the Hero, bounce to a random nearby enemy Hero. Lasts up to 5 seconds, rapidly decaying if there are no other enemy Heroes nearby.  Cannot be cancelled.

4.name: Anger Management
4.description: Increase maximum Rage by 50, raising the maximum bonuses for its cooldown refresh rate to 75% and Hogg Wild's Hero damage to 75%.  Passive: Basic Attacks grant 5 additional Rage.

1.name: Increasing Clarity
1.description: Quest: Every time Sacred Sweep hits a Hero in the center, increase the center damage by 2, up to 50.  Reward: After hitting 25 Heroes, this center damage bonus is increased to 180.

2.name: Righteous Assault
2.description: Reduces the cooldown of Sacred Sweep by 3 seconds for each enemy Hero hit by its center.

3.name: Searing Light
3.description: Ray of Heaven also deals damage to enemies in the area equal to 30% of the energy consumed.

1.name: Majestic Span
1.description: Increases the radius of Sacred Sweep by 15%.

2.name: Heavy Burden
2.description: Detainment Strike Slows enemy Heroes by 20% for 2.5 seconds. Slow amount and duration doubled on enemies it Stuns.  Passive: Increase Detainment Strikes' Stun duration by 0.25 seconds.

3.name: Repeated Offense
3.description: Enemies hit by Detainment Strike are knocked back 25% farther.  Quest: Every time Detainment Strike stuns a Hero, increase the stun damage by 10, up to 60.  Reward: After stunning 6 Heroes, increase this damage bonus to 250.

1.name: Glimmer of Hope
1.description: Collecting a Regeneration Globe reduces the cost of Auriel's next Ray of Heaven by 75%.

2.name: Empathic Link
2.description: Auriel stores 25% of damage taken by allies with Bestow Hope.

3.name: Energized Cord
3.description: Increases the energy stored from Auriel's Basic Attacks to 120% of the damage against Heroes and 55% of the damage against non-Heroes.  Does not affect Auriel's Bestow Hope ally.

1.name: Resurrect
1.description: Channel on the spirit of a dead ally for 1 second. After a 5 second delay, they are brought back to life with 100% of their maximum Health at the location where they died.  Auriel can use this ability while dead to resurrect herself.

2.name: Crystal Aegis
2.description: Place an allied Hero into Stasis for 2 seconds. Upon expiration, Crystal Aegis deals 255 (+4% per level) damage to all nearby enemies.

1.name: Blinding Flash
1.description: Enemies hit by the center area of Sacred Sweep are blinded for 2 seconds.

2.name: Converging Force
2.description: Enemies hit by the outer area are pushed slightly toward the center.

3.name: Piercing Lash
3.description: Detainment Strike now pierces and hits all enemy Heroes in a line, reducing the cooldown by 2 seconds for each Hero hit.

1.name: Reservoir of Hope
1.description: Quest: Each maximum energy Ray of Heaven Auriel casts increases the maximum amount of energy that can be stored by 75.

2.name: Will of Heaven
2.description: Allies with Bestow Hope gain 20% Attack Speed.  Passive: Auriel gains 10% increased Basic Attack Damage.

3.name: Wrath of Heaven
3.description: Allies with Bestow Hope gain 10% Spell Power.  Enemy Heroes hit by the center area of Sacred Sweep or the terrain collision of Detainment Strike have their Spell Armor reduced by 10 for 3 seconds.

1.name: Light Speed
1.description: Resurrected allies gain 200% increased Movement Speed, decaying over 4 seconds.  While a resurrected ally remains alive, Resurrect's next cooldown recharges 100% faster.

2.name: Diamond Resolve
2.description: When Crystal Aegis expires, it grants the target 75 Armor for 5 seconds, reducing damage taken by 75%.

3.name: Angelic Flight
3.description: After 2 seconds, fly to a target location.

4.name: Shield of Hope
4.description: Activate to grant all nearby allied Heroes a shield for 3 seconds equal to 50% of the amount of Health they are missing.

1.name: Enduring Swarm
1.description: Dark Swarm's duration is increased by 0.5 seconds and grants 50 Spell Armor while active.

2.name: Tissue Regeneration
2.description: Regeneration Globes grant 10 Essence.  Repeatable Quest: Every 50 Essence collected permanently increases Health Regeneration by 4, up to 40, and maximum Essence by 1, up to 10.

3.name: Enhanced Agility
3.description: Brushstalker's Movement Speed bonus now lasts for 5 seconds after leaving a bush.  Repeatable Quest: Every 50 Essence collected permanently increases the Movement Speed bonus of Brushstalker by 2%, up to 20%.

1.name: Lurker Strain
1.description: Emerging from Burrow grants Dehaka Stealth for 3 seconds and knocks nearby enemies back, dealing 125 (+4% per level) damage and Slowing them by 30% for 3 seconds.  Passive: Reduce the cooldown of Burrow by 3 seconds.

2.name: One-Who-Collects
2.description: Increases Essence collected from Minions by 50%. Dark Swarm deals 40% more damage to Mercenaries.

3.name: Hero Stalker
3.description: Increases Essence gained from Takedowns by 100%, and gain 1 Essence each time an enemy Hero is hit by Dark Swarm.

1.name: Feeding Frenzy
1.description: Basic Attacks reduce Drag's cooldown by 1.5 seconds.  Passive: Increase Drag's duration by 0.5 seconds.

2.name: Paralyzing Enzymes
2.description: Drag Slows enemies by 40% for 2 seconds after it ends.  Gambit: When Drag ends, deal an additional 280 (+4% per level) damage to the target over 2 seconds. Every death reduces this damage by 40 (+4% per level), up to 5 times.

3.name: Symbiosis
3.description: Every time Dark Swarm damages an enemy Hero, reduce its cooldown by 0.4 seconds.

1.name: Isolation
1.description: Launch biomass that hits the first enemy Hero dealing 200 (+4% per level) damage, revealing, Silencing, and Slowing them 30% for 3 seconds. Additionally, their vision radius is greatly reduced for 6 seconds.

2.name: Adaptation
2.description: After 4 seconds, heal for 100% of the damage Dehaka took over this period.

1.name: Ferocious Stalker
1.description: Dark Swarm Slows enemy Heroes by 15% for 0.75 seconds and deals 60% more damage while Brushstalker's Movement Speed bonus is active.

2.name: Primal Swarm
2.description: Dark Swarm causes enemies hit to lose 10 Armor for 0.75 seconds, causing them to take 10% extra damage.

3.name: Primal Rage
3.description: Gain 1.25% increased Attack Damage per Essence stored.

1.name: Elongated Tongue
1.description: Increase Drag range by 20%.

2.name: Tunneling Claws
2.description: Increase movement speed while Burrowing to 125%.

3.name: Pack Leader
3.description: Dehaka gains 20 Armor and 15% increased Attack Speed while in a bush and for 5 seconds after leaving.

1.name: Contagion
1.description: Isolation hits all Heroes near the first target.

2.name: Change Is Survival
2.description: Increases Adaptation healing to 200% of the damage received and reduces the cooldown by 40 seconds.

3.name: Essence Claws
3.description: Dehaka's Basic Attacks slow the target by 20% for 1 second. If the target is a Hero, Dehaka gains 5 Essence.

4.name: Apex Predator
4.description: Reduces Brushstalker's cooldown by 50 seconds and the cast time by 0.5 seconds.

1.name: Swift as the Wind
1.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Swift Strike increases Genji's Movement Speed by 30% for 3 seconds.

2.name: Agile Dismount
2.description: While mounted the range of Cyber Agility is increased by 70%, its cooldown is reduced by 14 seconds, and it Slows enemy Heroes in its landing area by 30% for 2 seconds.

3.name: Pathfinder
3.description: Jumping over terrain with Cyber Agility increases Movement Speed by 25%, and grants Stealth, for 4 seconds.

1.name: Shuriken Mastery
1.description: Quest: Hit enemy Heroes with Shuriken.  Reward: After hitting 30 Heroes, Shuriken damage is increased by 25.  Reward: After hitting 60 Heroes, Cyber Agility now refunds 3 charges of Shuriken.

2.name: Strike At The Heart
2.description: Enemies hit by the end of Swift Strike take an additional 134 (+4% per level) damage after 1 second.

3.name: Dragon Claw
3.description: After Genji blocks 330 (+4% per level) damage with Deflect, activate to release a Dragon Claw, dealing 190 (+4% per level) damage to all nearby enemies.

1.name: Augmented Guard
1.description: When Deflect ends, Genji gains a Shield equal to 100% of the damage blocked for 4 seconds.

2.name: Perfect Defense
2.description: Deflected damage reduces the cooldown of Deflect by 2 seconds, up to a maximum of 10 seconds.

3.name: Cyber Shield
3.description: Using Cyber Agility grants 50 Spell Armor for 4 seconds.  Passive: Genji dodges 1 Heroic Basic Attack every 5 seconds.

1.name: Dragonblade
1.description: Unleash the Dragonblade for 8 seconds. While active, Dragonblade can be reactivated to lunge forward and slash in a huge arc, dealing 240 (+4% per level) damage.

2.name: X-Strike
2.description: Perform two slashes dealing 145 (+4% per level) damage. The slashes detonate after 1.25 seconds causing an additional 290 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in their area.

1.name: Shingan
1.description: Hitting an enemy with all 3 Shuriken deals 115 (+4% per level) bonus damage.

2.name: Flow Like Water
2.description: Each enemy Hero hit with Swift Strike reduces its cooldown by 3 seconds.

3.name: Way Of The Shimada
3.description: Increase Genji's Basic Attack range by 1.  Each time Genji hits an enemy Hero with a Basic Attack, increase his Basic Attack damage by 1% for 3 seconds, stacking up to 15%.

1.name: Reflect
1.description: Deflect also deals an additional 33% of the damage blocked.

2.name: Final Cut
2.description: After 1 second, Swift Strike deals an additional 125 (+4% per level) damage to all enemies in the area.

3.name: Steady Blade
3.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Swift Strike increases the damage of the next Swift Strike by 30%. This bonus stacks up to 3 times.

1.name: The Dragon Becomes Me
1.description: Each time Dragonblade hits an enemy Hero, the duration of Dragonblade is increased by 0.5 seconds. If a Hero is killed within 1.5 seconds of being hit by Dragonblade, Swift Strike's cooldown is reset.

2.name: Living Weapon
2.description: Each enemy Hero hit by X-Strike reduces its cooldown by 10 seconds.

3.name: Sharpened Stars
3.description: Shuriken now pierce all enemies hit. Swift Strike's refund grants 1 charge of Shuriken.

4.name: Zanshin
4.description: Quest: Block 6500 damage with Deflect, including damage blocked so far.  Reward: Deflect hits all nearby enemy Heroes.

1.name: Overwhelming Power
1.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Discord Strike grants 40% Attack Speed and causes Basic Attacks to heal for 50% of the damage dealt for 4 seconds.

2.name: Ruthless Momentum
2.description: Reduce the Mana cost of Telekinesis from 30 to 20.  Telekinesis's cooldown recharges 100% faster while above 80% Health.

3.name: Extended Lightning
3.description: Reduce Sadism by 10%.  Quest: Hit Heroes with the center of Lightning Surge.  Reward: After hitting 5 Heroes, increase Lightning Surge's range by 20%.  Reward: After hitting 15 Heroes, Lightning Surge's center also Slows enemies by 40% for 2 seconds.  Reward: After hitting 3 Heroes with the center of a single cast, increase Sadism by 10% and instantly gain all other Rewards.

1.name: Chaos Reigns
1.description: Quest: Hit Heroes with Discord Strike.  Reward: After hitting 15 Heroes, increase Discord Strike's damage by 60.  Reward: After hitting 2 Heroes with a single Discord Strike, increase its damage by 60.  Reward: After hitting 3 Heroes with a single Discord Strike, increase its damage by 100 and instantly gain all other Rewards.

2.name: Negatively Charged
2.description: Increase the Lightning Surge damage bonus to enemies between Alarak and his victim to 175%.  Repeatable Quest: Each Hero hit by the center of Lightning Surge permanently increases the damage bonus by 5%.

3.name: Show of Force
3.description: Heroes hit with 3 of Alarak's Abilities within 2 seconds take an additional 61 (+4% per level) damage and increase Sadism by 2%, stacking up to 20%.   Sadism gained from Show of Force is lost on death.

1.name: Dissonance
1.description: Increase Discord Strike's Silence duration by 0.75 seconds.

2.name: Hindered Motion
2.description: Telekinesis Slows enemies by 30% for 3 seconds.

3.name: Applied Force
3.description: Reduce Sadism by 10%, but Telekinesis pushes 20% further and has 20% increased range.

1.name: Deadly Charge
1.description: After channeling, Alarak charges forward dealing 200 (+4% per level) damage to all enemies in his path. Distance is increased based on the amount of time channeled, up to 1.5 seconds.  Issuing a Move order while this is channeling will cancel it at no cost. Taking damage will interrupt the channeling.

2.name: Counter-Strike
2.description: Alarak targets an area and channels for 1 second, becoming Protected and Unstoppable. After, if he took damage from an enemy Hero, he sends a shockwave that deals 275 (+4% per level) damage.

1.name: Blade of the Highlord
1.description: Basic Attacks against Heroes increase Sadism by 2% stacking up to 40%.  Sadism gained from Blade of the Highlord is lost on death.

2.name: Pure Malice
2.description: Increase Sadism by 10% any time an allied Hero dies, up to 40%.  Sadism gained from Pure Malice is lost on death.

3.name: Rite of Rak'Shir
3.description: Activate to mark an enemy Hero for 300 seconds.  Hitting the marked Hero with Discord Strike increases Sadism by 3%. Killing the marked Hero increases Sadism by 5% and lowers the cooldown of Rite of Rak'Shir to 10 seconds.  Sadism gained from Rite of Rak'Shir is lost on death.

1.name: Lethal Onslaught
1.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Discord Strike grants 50% of Sadism's damage bonus to Alarak's Basic Attacks for 4 seconds. Basic Attacks against Heroes refresh this duration.

2.name: Lightning Barrage
2.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with the center of Lightning Surge allows it to be cast again for free on a different primary target within the next 3 seconds. This free cast cannot benefit from Lightning Barrage.

3.name: Mocking Strikes
3.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes reduce the cooldown of Alarak's Basic Abilities by 1.5 seconds.  This bonus is doubled against enemy Heroes who are Stunned, Silenced, Slowed, or Rooted.

1.name: Counter-Strike
1.description: Alarak targets an area and channels for 1 second, becoming Protected and Unstoppable. After, if he took damage from an enemy Hero, he sends a shockwave that deals 275 (+4% per level) damage.  This ability will take over Alarak's Trait button.

2.name: Deadly Charge
2.description: After channeling, Alarak charges forward dealing 200 (+4% per level) damage to all enemies in his path. Distance is increased based on the amount of time channeled, up to 1.5 seconds.  Issuing a Move order while this is channeling will cancel it at no cost. Taking damage will interrupt the channeling.

3.name: Last Laugh
3.description: Activate to teleport to the chosen location and remove all Roots, Slows, and damage over time effects. If Alarak fails to hit enemy Heroes 3 times with Basic Abilities within 4 seconds of using Last Laugh, his Health is reduced to 1.

4.name: Hasty Bargain
4.description: Activate to permanently reduce Alarak's Sadism by 4% and reset the cooldowns of his Basic Abilities.

1.name: Transcendence
1.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack heals the lowest nearby allied Hero for 104 (+4% per level) and gives 25% increased Move Speed for 2.5 seconds.

2.name: Iron Fists
2.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack deals 110% bonus damage and gives 25% increased Move Speed for 2.5 seconds.

3.name: Insight
3.description: Quest: Every 3rd Basic Attack restores 14 (+4% per level) Mana, grants a stack of Insight, and gives 25% increased Movement Speed for 2.5 seconds.  Reward: Upon getting 100 stacks of Insight, every 3rd attack also reduces Basic Ability cooldowns by 1.75 seconds.

1.name: Spirit Ally
1.description: Place a Spirit Ally that heals allied Heroes in a large area around it for 2% of their maximum Health every second. Has 150 (+4% per level) Health and lasts 10 seconds. Kharazim can Radiant Dash to Spirit Allies.

2.name: Earth Ally
2.description: Place an Earth Ally that grants nearby allied Heroes 50 Physical Armor against Heroic Basic Attacks, reducing damage taken by 50%. Has 400 (+4% per level) Health and lasts 10 seconds.  Kharazim can Radiant Dash to Earth Allies.

3.name: Air Ally
3.description: Place an Air Ally that gives allied Heroes 15% Spell Power, grants vision, and reveals a large area around it. Has 200 (+4% per level) Health and lasts 10 seconds. Kharazim can Radiant Dash to Air Allies.

1.name: Blinding Speed
1.description: Decreases Radiant Dash's cooldown by 2 seconds and increases the maximum number of charges by 1.

2.name: Heavenly Zeal
2.description: Increases Breath of Heaven's Movement Speed bonus to 30%.  Radiant Dashing to an ally increases the healing they receive from Breath of Heaven by 50% for 3.5 seconds.

3.name: Blazing Fists
3.description: Increase the duration of Deadly Reach by 100%.  Every 3rd Basic Attack reduces the cooldown of Deadly Reach by 0.75 seconds.

1.name: Divine Palm
1.description: Protect an allied Hero from death, causing them to be healed for 1200 (+4% per level) if they take fatal damage in the next 3 seconds.

2.name: Seven-Sided Strike
2.description: Become Invulnerable and strike 7 times over 2 seconds. Each strike hits the highest Health nearby Hero for 7% of their maximum Health.

1.name: Quicksilver
1.description: Radiant Dashing to an ally gives Kharazim and the target 30% bonus Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

2.name: Spell Shield
2.description: Every 30 seconds, gain 50 Spell Armor against the next enemy Ability and subsequent Abilities for 3 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 50%.  Can be toggled to allow or prevent this talent from triggering automatically.

3.name: Sixth Sense
3.description: While Stunned or Rooted, gain 75 Physical Armor against Hero Basic Attacks for 4 seconds, reducing their damage by 75%.

1.name: Cleansing Touch
1.description: Radiant Dashing to an ally makes them Unstoppable for 1 second.

2.name: Way of the Hundred Fists
2.description: Radiant Dashing to an enemy launches a rapid volley of 6 Basic Attacks dealing 45% damage each.

3.name: Echo of Heaven
3.description: Breath of Heaven heals 75% of its normal amount, but heals a second time 3 seconds later.

1.name: Peaceful Repose
1.description: Divine Palm's healing amount is increased by 75% and its cooldown is set to 5 seconds if the Hero does not die.

2.name: Transgression
2.description: Seven-Sided Strike hits 4 additional times.

3.name: Fists of Legend
3.description: Gain 50% of the benefit from both level 1  talents that were not chosen.

4.name: Storm Shield
4.description: Activate to give all nearby allied Heroes a Shield for 20% of their max Health for 3 seconds.

5.name: Epiphany
5.description: Activate to restore 33% of Kharazim's maximum Mana and refill 2 charges of Radiant Dash.

1.name: Greater Polymorph
1.description: Passive: Increase Polymorph's range by 30%.  If Brightwing hits an enemy Hero with Arcane Flare's center within 2 seconds of being Polymorphed, then reduce Polymorph's cooldown by 7 seconds and gain 50 Mana.

2.name: Hyper Shift
2.description: Increase Phase Shift's healing by an additional 6% of the target's maximum Health. Nearby enemy Minion deaths reduce Phase Shift's cooldown by 1 second.

3.name: Pixie Charm
3.description: Activate to consume 20 stacks of Bribe to instantly defeat an uncaptured non-Elite Mercenary.  Passive: Gain 1 stack of Bribe when a nearby enemy Minion dies, and 5 stacks when hitting an enemy Hero with Arcane Flare's center. Maximum 80 stacks.

1.name: Dream Shot
1.description: Increase Arcane Flare's range by 50%. Hitting a Hero with Arcane Flare's center reduces its cooldown to 2 seconds.

2.name: Unstable Anomaly
2.description: Increase Polymorph's Slow by 15%. Upon expiration, Polymorph deals damage to nearby enemy Heroes equal to 2% of their maximum Health.

3.name: Magic Spit
3.description: Increase Basic Attack range by 1.1. Basic Attacks against Heroes reduce the cooldown of Soothing Mist by 4 seconds.

1.name: Sticky Flare
1.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Arcane Flare have their Movement Speed Slowed by 20% for 3 seconds. Increase the Slow to 40% if they are hit by the center portion.

2.name: Peekaboo!
2.description: Phase Shifting to an ally grants both Brightwing and her target a 335 (+4% per level) Shield for 4 seconds and reveals a large area around them for 5 seconds.

3.name: Critical Mist
3.description: Soothing Mist heals allied Heroes for 165 (+4% per level). Increase this healing by 140% if Soothing Mist removed a disabling effect from that ally.

1.name: Blink Heal
1.description: Teleport to a nearby ally. When teleporting to a Hero, heal them for 200 (+4% per level).  Stores up to 2 charges.

2.name: Emerald Wind
2.description: After 0.5 seconds, create an expanding nova of wind, dealing 225 (+4% per level) damage and pushing enemies away.

1.name: Pixie Boost
1.description: Pixie Dust gives 50% bonus Movement Speed, decaying to 20% over 3 seconds.

2.name: Safety Dust
2.description: Increase Pixie Dust's duration by 1 second. Soothing Mist and Blink Heal heal allies with an active Pixie Dust for 75% more.

3.name: Pixie Power
3.description: Reduce the cooldown of Pixie Dust by 3 seconds and increase the Spell Armor granted by 25.

1.name: Hush!
1.description: Enemy Heroes hit by the center of Arcane Flare are Silenced for 1 second and deal 25% less damage for 3 seconds.

2.name: Critterize
2.description: While Polymorphed, the target's Armor is reduced by 25, increasing the damage they take by 25%.

3.name: Phase Out
3.description: Activate to place Brightwing in Stasis for 0.75 seconds.

1.name: Invisible Friends
1.description: Blink Heal grants Stealth to Brightwing and her Heroic targets for 9 seconds, and they are Unrevealable for the first 0.5 seconds. While Stealthed by Invisible Friends, Heroes heal for 25 (+4% per level) health per second.  Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible.

2.name: Intensive Winds
2.description: Permanently reduce Emerald Wind's cooldown to 5 seconds.

3.name: Speedy Dragon
3.description: Permanently gain 20% Movement Speed. Reduce Phase Shift's cast time by 1 second.

4.name: Faerie Protector
4.description: Activate to apply Pixie Dust to all nearby Heroes.  Passive: Pixie Dust always bounces back and applies to Brightwing.

1.name: Vigor
1.description: Valeera regenerates an additional 3 Energy per second.  Reward: After Gathering 20 Regen Globes, increase Valeera's maximum Energy to 120.

2.name: Subtlety
2.description: After teleporting with Ambush, Cheap Shot, or Garrote, regenerate 10 Energy per second for 5 seconds.

3.name: Combat Readiness
3.description: Each Combo Point spent grants 75 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing its damage by 75%. Stores up to 3 charges.

4.name: Crippling Poison
4.description: Activate to make Valeera's next damaging Ability and subsequent Abilities within 4 seconds Slow targets by 20% for 4 seconds.  Activating Crippling Poison does not break Stealth.

1.name: Relentless Strikes
1.description: Reduces the Energy cost of Sinister Strike by 10.

2.name: Hemorrhage
2.description: Valeera's Basic Attacks deal 40% additional damage to enemies affected by Garrote.

3.name: Initiative
3.description: Ambush, Cheap Shot, and Garrote grant 15% Movement Speed for 3 seconds and award 2 Combo Points.

4.name: Wound Poison
4.description: Activate to make Valeera's next damaging Ability and subsequent Abilities within 4 seconds reduce enemy healing received by 50% for 4 seconds.  Activating Wound Poison does not break Stealth.

1.name: Mutilate
1.description: Sinister Strike now hits with both blades, dealing 125% additional damage, but its range is reduced by 1.

2.name: Fatal Finesse
2.description: Quest: Each time Blade Flurry damages an enemy Hero, its damage increases by 6, up to 90.  Reward: After damaging 15 Heroes with Blade Flurry, permanently reduce its Energy cost by 20.

3.name: Slice and Dice
3.description: Eviscerating an enemy with 3 Combo Points grants 150% Attack Speed. Lasts 3 seconds or 3 Basic Attacks.  Passive: Basic Attacks restore 2 Energy.

1.name: Smoke Bomb
1.description: Create a cloud of smoke. While in the smoke, Valeera is Unrevealable, can pass through other units, and gains 60 Armor, reducing damage taken by 60%. Valeera can continue to attack and use abilities without being revealed. Lasts 5 seconds.  Using this Ability does not break Stealth.

2.name: Cloak of Shadows
2.description: Valeera is enveloped in a Cloak of Shadows, which immediately removes all damage over time effects from her. For 1.5 seconds, she becomes Unstoppable and gains 75 Spell Armor, reducing Ability Damage taken by 75%.  Using this Ability does not break Stealth.

1.name: Death From Above
1.description: Teleporting with Ambush reduces the cooldown of Vanish by 4 seconds.

2.name: Blind
2.description: Increase the duration of Cheap Shot's Blind by 2.5 seconds.

3.name: Strangle
3.description: Using Garrote on a Hero reduces their Spell Power by 40% for 6 seconds.

1.name: Seal Fate
1.description: Sinister Strike deals 50% additional damage and generates an additional Combo Point when used against Silenced, Rooted, or Stunned enemy Heroes.

2.name: Assassinate
2.description: Ambush deals 50% additional damage and reduces the target's Armor by an additional 10 if no other enemy Heroes are within 4 range of the victim.

3.name: Thistle Tea
3.description: Activate to instantly restore 100 Energy.  Activating Thistle Tea does not break Stealth.

1.name: Adrenaline Rush
1.description: While in the Smoke Bomb, Valeera regenerates an additional 40 Energy per second.

2.name: Enveloping Shadows
2.description: Whenever Valeera uses Vanish, she also gains Cloak of Shadows.

3.name: Rupture
3.description: Increase Garrote's damage over time by 100%. Valeera's Basic Attacks refresh the duration of Garrote.

4.name: Elusiveness
4.description: Increases Valeera's Movement Speed while Vanished by an additional 20%.

1.name: Static Charge
1.description: Quest: Heroes hit by Shock Ray permanently increases its damage by 5 and grants 33% Resonance Beam charge.  Maximum of 200 bonus damage.

2.name: Psi-Infusion
2.description: Increases the range of Psionic Storm by 33%. Each non-Structure enemy hit by Psionic Storm restores 0.5 Mana, increased to 5 against Heroes.

3.name: Khaydarin Amulet
3.description: Quest: Resonance Beam charges 50% faster.  Reward: After Resonance Beam has been fully charged for 80 seconds, it bounces to hit 1 additional target for 75% damage, prioritizing Heroes.  Reward: After Resonance Beam has been fully charged for 160 seconds, it bounces to hit 2 additional targets for 75% damage, prioritizing Heroes.

1.name: Induction
1.description: Tassadar gains 10% increased Movement Speed. Casting Shock Ray increases this bonus to 30% for 3 seconds.

2.name: Electric Fence
2.description: Force Wall deals 92 (+4% per level) damage a second to nearby enemies and Slows them by 35%.

3.name: Plasma Shield
3.description: While Resonance Beam is fully charged, gain a Shield equal to 3% of max Health every second, stacking up to 12%.

1.name: Beam Alignment
1.description: While Resonance Beam is fully charged, Shock Ray's cooldown refreshes 100% faster and its Slow duration is increased to 4 seconds.  Passive: Reduce the Mana cost of Shock Ray from 55 to 40.

2.name: Psionic Echo
2.description: Casting Psionic Storm causes your next Shock Ray within 3 seconds to only cost 30 Mana and create a Psionic Storm on the first enemy Hero hit.

3.name: Arc Discharge
3.description: When Resonance Beam is fully charged, Tassadar's Basic Attack range is increased by 1 and its next instance of damage also creates a Psionic Storm on the target.  This effect has a 20 second cooldown that decays twice as fast while Resonance Beam is fully charged.

1.name: Archon
1.description: Tassadar transforms into an Archon, gaining a Shield equal to 25% of his maximum Health and empowering Resonance Beam. Lasts for 12 seconds.  Resonance Beam: Deals 140 (+4% per level) damage to the target and splashes 70 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies. Heroes hit have their Spell Armor reduced by 20 for 2 seconds. Resonance Beam is fully charged while Archon is active.

2.name: Black Hole
2.description: After a 0.5 second cast, create a Black Hole that travels in a long line. Enemy Heroes within the Black Hole's area are quickly pulled towards its center. Touching the center deals 310 (+4% per level) damage and Stuns the target for 1.25 seconds.

1.name: Feedback
1.description: When an enemy Hero is affected by Psionic Storm, Resonance Beam's Slow is increased to 50% and it reduces Physical Armor by 25.

2.name: Shadow Walk
2.description: Tassadar becomes Stealthed and Unrevealable, but cannot attack or use Abilities for 1.5 seconds. While this effect is active, gain 40% increased Movement Speed and 35 Armor.  Can be cast while Channeling Shock Ray.

3.name: Oracle
3.description: Passive: While stationary, gain 30 Spell Armor for 0.75 seconds and restore 12 (+4% per level) Health a second.  Activate to Channel for up to 4 seconds, revealing a gradually increasing area anywhere on the map.

1.name: Thermal Lance
1.description: Shock Ray deals an additional 8% of maximum Health as damage to the first Hero it hits.

2.name: Psychic Shock
2.description: Psionic Storm deals damage 25% faster.

3.name: Executor's Will
3.description: Activate to gain full Resonance Beam charge, 20% Spell Power, and cause Basic and Heroic Ability cooldowns to regenerate 25% faster. This effect lasts as long as Resonance Beam remains at full charge.

1.name: Twilight Archon
1.description: Basic Attacks while in Archon form increase its duration by 2 seconds.

2.name: Kugelblitz
2.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Black Hole's center have their Armor reduced by 20 for 3 seconds and have a Psionic Storm created at their location.

3.name: Force Barrier
3.description: Increase the duration of Force Wall by 0.5 seconds, its range by 50%, and reduce its cooldown by 10 seconds.

4.name: Khala's Gift
4.description: Gain 4% Spell Power for yourself and each nearby ally Hero, up to 20% total Spell Power. Your total bonus is shared with all contributing allies.

1.name: Dragon Soul
1.description: Destroyer: Incinerate heals Deathwing for 75% of the damage dealt to enemy Heroes.  World Breaker: Lava Burst's explosion damage heals Deathwing for 150% of the damage dealt to enemy Heroes.

2.name: Molten Blood
2.description: While Deathwing has 3 or more Armor Plates, he heals for 0.6% of his maximum Health per second.

3.name: Draconic Might
3.description: Deathwing's Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes heal him for 25% of the damage dealt. Upon losing an Armor Plate, Deathwing becomes Protected for 0.75 seconds.

1.name: Infernus
1.description: Increase the damage of Molten Flame against enemy Heroes by 25%.  Increase this damage bonus to 75% when Molten Flame is cast at 75 Energy or higher.

2.name: Heat Wave
2.description: Destroyer: After hitting an enemy Hero with Incinerate, Deathwing deals 12 (+4% per level) damage per second to all nearby enemies for the next 8 seconds. Stacks up to 4 times.  World Breaker: Increase the explosion damage of Lava Burst by 125%.

3.name: Dragon's Ire
3.description: While Deathwing has 3 or fewer Armor Plates, his damage is increased by 25%.

1.name: Firestorm
1.description: Reduce the cooldown of Deathwing's landing Abilities by 2 seconds.  When Deathwing lands, he drops 7 meteors near the landing area, dealing 70 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit. Heroes hit by the meteors reduce Dragonflight's cooldown by 25 seconds.  Meteors prioritize landing on Heroes, otherwise they fall randomly in the area.

2.name: Death Drop
2.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Destroyer or World Breaker's landing damage reduces their Spell Armor by 15 for 6 seconds and Deathwing's Basic Ability cooldowns by 2 seconds.

1.description: Molten Flame's Energy cost per second is reduced by 10.  After using Molten Flame, Deathwing gains 15 Energy over 3 seconds.

When the Shield expires or is destroyed, Deathwing regains Armor Plates appropriate for his new Health.  The Shield and effect end immediately if Deathwing uses Dragonflight.

1.description: Enemy Heroes are Slowed by 40% while standing in scorched ground, and its duration is increased by 50%.

3.description: Misha's Basic Attacks lower the cooldown of Misha, Charge! by 1 second.

1.name: Bestial Wrath
1.description: Increases Misha's Basic Attack damage by 200% for 12 seconds.

2.name: Unleash the Boars
2.description: Release a herd of boars that track down all enemy Heroes in a direction, dealing 110 (+4% per level) damage, revealing, and slowing enemies by 40% for 5 seconds.

1.name: Aspect of the Hawk
1.description: When Spirit Swoop hits an enemy Hero, Rexxar gains 125% Attack Speed for 4 seconds. Misha's Basic Attacks increase the duration of this buff by 0.75 seconds.

2.name: Dire Beast
2.description: Rexxar and Misha's Basic Attacks increase the damage of the next Misha, Charge! by 15%, stacking up to a 150% bonus.

3.name: Wildfire Bear
3.description: Misha deals 28 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies.

1.name: Thrill of the Hunt
1.description: Rexxar's Basic Attacks increase both his and Misha's Movement Speed by 25% for 2 seconds.

2.name: Primal Intimidation
2.description: Activate to slow the Attack Speed by 50% and Movement Speed by 20% of Heroes and Summons near Rexxar and Misha for 2.5 seconds.  Passive: Heroes and Summons that attack Rexxar or Misha have their Attack Speed slowed by 20% for 2.5 seconds.

3.name: Feign Death
3.description: Rexxar fakes his death, becoming Invulnerable and untargetable for 5 seconds. During this time you control Misha.

1.name: Spirit Bond
1.description: Increases the duration of Bestial Wrath by 50% and Misha's Basic Attacks heal Rexxar for 50% of her damage dealt during Bestial Wrath.

2.name: Kill Command
2.description: Unleash the Boars deals 50% more damage and roots for 1.5 seconds.

3.name: Frenzy of Kalimdor
3.description: Rexxar's Basic Attacks deal 10% more damage, and Misha's Basic Attacks slow the target by 20% for 1.25 seconds.

4.name: Hardened Skin
4.description: Rexxar and Misha gain 75 Armor for 4 seconds, reducing damage taken by 75%.

1.name: Guitar Hero
1.description: While Guitar Solo is active, E.T.C. heals for 60% of his damage dealt by Basic Attacks.  Basic Attacks increase the duration of Guitar Solo by 0.5 seconds.

2.name: Prog Rock
2.description: Quest: Gathering a Regeneration Globe permanently increases the healing per second of Guitar Solo by 5, to a maximum of 100  Reward: After gathering 20 Regeneration Globes, Guitar Solo also heals nearby allied Heroes for 50 (+4% per level) Health every second while it is active.

3.name: Block Party
3.description: Using a Basic or Heroic ability also gives nearby allied Heroes a stack of Block, granting 75 Physical Armor against the next Hero Basic Attack for 8 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 75%. Maximum 2 stacks of Block.

1.name: Crowd Surfer
1.description: Allows Powerslide to travel over walls and terrain. If no enemies are hit, reduce the cooldown by 7 seconds and refund the Mana cost.

2.name: Loud Speakers
2.description: Increases Face Melt range and knockback by 50%.

3.name: Speed Metal
3.description: Using a Basic or Heroic ability also gives nearby allied Heroes 20% Movement Speed for 2.5 seconds.

1.name: Pinball Wizard
1.description: Face Melt does 300% more damage to enemies recently affected by Powerslide.

2.name: Hammer-on
2.description: While Guitar Solo is active your Basic Attacks deal 35% more damage.

3.name: Echo Pedal
3.description: Using a Basic or Heroic Ability releases two pulses of 18 (+4% per level) damage.  This deals 200% bonus damage to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters. The first occurs instantly, the second occurs 2 seconds later.

1.name: Mosh Pit
1.description: After 0.75 seconds, channel to stun nearby enemies for 4 seconds.

2.name: Stage Dive
2.description: Leap to target location, landing after 2.75 seconds, dealing 330 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in the area, and slowing them by 50% for 4 seconds.

1.name: Mic Check
1.description: Hitting at least 2 targets with Face Melt reduces its cooldown by 6 seconds.

2.name: Encore
2.description: Face Melt leaves an Amp behind, which will knock enemies away again 2 seconds later.  Passive: Each enemy Hero hit by Face Melt or the Amp reduces your Heroic Ability cooldown by 5%.

3.name: Face Smelt
3.description: Face Melt slows enemies by 50% fading over 2 seconds.

1.name: Show Stopper
1.description: After using Powerslide, gain 35 Armor for 4 seconds, reducing all damage taken by 35%.

2.name: Aggressive Shredding
2.description: E.T.C.'s Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Guitar Solo by 0.75 seconds.

3.name: Imposing Presence
3.description: Activate to reduce the Attack Speed by 50% and Movement Speed by 20% of nearby Heroes and Summons for 2.5 seconds.  Passive: Heroes and Summons that attack your Hero have their Attack Speed Slowed by 20% for 2.5 seconds.

1.name: Tour Bus
1.description: Channeling Mosh Pit refreshes Powerslide's cooldown, and it can be cast to increase Mosh Pit's duration by 2 seconds.

2.name: Crowd Pleaser
2.description: Stage Dive's impact area is 50% bigger, and its Slow is increased by 30%.

3.name: Death Metal
3.description: Upon dying, a ghost uses Mosh Pit at E.T.C's location.

4.name: Storm Shield
4.description: Activate to give all nearby allied Heroes a Shield for 20% of their max Health for 3 seconds.

5.name: Bolt of the Storm
5.description: Activate to teleport to a nearby location.

1.name: Force Armor
1.description: When Magic Missiles damages an enemy Hero, gain 50 Spell Armor, reducing the damage taken by the next Ability by 50%. Gain 1 charge per cast and store up to 4 charges.  Passive: Li-Ming's Mana regeneration is increased by 100% while below 35% Mana.

2.name: Aether Walker
2.description: Teleport costs no Mana.  If Li-Ming hasn't taken damage in the last 3 seconds, Teleport's cooldown is decreased by 2 seconds.  Casting Teleport causes Li-Ming's next cast of Magic Missiles to deal 10% bonus damage.

3.name: Power Hungry
3.description: Regeneration Globes restore 100% more Mana and grant 10% Spell Power for 20 seconds.

1.name: Charged Blast
1.description: Basic Attacking a target recently hit by a Magic Missile does an extra 87 (+4% per level) damage.

2.name: Triumvirate
2.description: If Arcane Orb hits an enemy Hero after traveling at least 50% of its base range, the cooldown is reduced by 5 seconds and 40 Mana is refunded.

3.name: Dominance
3.description: Takedowns restore 30% of Li-Ming's missing Health.

1.name: Seeker
1.description: If three Magic Missiles hit the same target, the third one deals an additional 140 (+4% per level) damage.

2.name: Zei's Vengeance
2.description: Increase Arcane Orb's damage increase for distance traveled by 30%. Additionally, reduce its cooldown by 1 second.

3.name: Calamity
3.description: Teleport does 300 (+3% per level) damage to enemy Heroes near the destination.

1.name: Disintegrate
1.description: Channel a powerful beam, dealing 480 (+5% per level) damage over 2.6 seconds to enemies while they are in it. The direction of the beam changes with your mouse cursor position.

2.name: Wave of Force
2.description: Knock away all enemies from an area and deal 160 (+5% per level) damage.

1.name: Illusionist
1.description: If Li-Ming loses more than 20% of her Health at once, its cooldown is instantly refreshed.  This effect has a 4 second cooldown.  Passive: Increases Teleport range by 50%

2.name: Cannoneer
2.description: When Li-Ming uses an Ability, her next Basic Attack's damage is increased by 75% and deals Spell damage instead of Physical.  Stacks up to 3 times.

3.name: Glass Cannon
3.description: Increase Li-Ming's Spell Power by 20%, but decrease her maximum Health by 15%.

1.name: Fireflies
1.description: Drastically increases Magic Missiles speed. Its cooldown is reduced by 1 second, and its Mana cost is reduced by 5.

2.name: Mirrorball
2.description: Magic Missiles fires an additional 2 missiles, but its Mana cost is increased by 5.

3.name: Arcane Orbit
3.description: Arcane Orb travels 25% farther, increasing its maximum distance damage bonus from 270 (+3% per level) to 371 (+3% per level).

4.name: Diamond Skin
4.description: Teleport grants a Shield equal to 25% of Li-Ming's maximum Health for 4 seconds.

1.name: Temporal Flux
1.description: Disintegrate gradually slows enemies caught in its beam, to a maximum of 60%.

2.name: Repulsion
2.description: Increases Wave of Force knockback distance by 150% and increases its cast range by 100%.

3.name: Tal Rasha's Elements
3.description: Casting Abilities increases the damage of the next Ability by 5%, up to 20%.  This bonus is reset when the same Ability is used within a chain.

4.name: Archon: Pure Power
4.description: Activate to enter Archon form, allowing Li-Ming to repeatedly use Disintegrate, but be unable to cast other Abilities.

1.name: The Plaguelands
1.description: Increase Death and Decay's duration by 1 second. After gaining 30 Blight, increase the radius of Death and Decay's pool by 30%.

2.name: Blighted Frost
2.description: Frost Nova deals 75% more damage to enemies in the center. After gaining 30 Blight, increase Frost Nova's Root duration by 0.5 seconds.

3.name: Barbed Chains
3.description: Increase Chains of Kel'Thuzad damage by 125%. After gaining 30 Blight, Chains of Kel'Thuzad reduces the Armor of pulled Heroes by 10 for 4 seconds.

1.description: Pulling a Hero with Chains of Kel'Thuzad grants Kel'Thuzad a permanent 128 (+4% per level) Shield, stacking up to 2 times.  Additionally, Chains of Kel'Thuzad deals up to 270 (+2.5% per level) bonus damage to Heroes' Shields.

2.name: Phylactery of Kel'Thuzad
2.description: Quest: Collect 12 Regeneration Globes to charge Kel'Thuzad's Phylactery.  Reward: Kel'Thuzad's Phylactery can be activated while dead to immediately respawn at the Hall of Storms, but must be charged again.  Passive: Kel'Thuzad heals for 10% of all Spell Damage dealt while the Phylactery is charged.

3.name: Armor of the Archlich
3.description: Activate to gain 50 Physical Armor for 4 seconds. Upon activation, nearby enemies take 45 (+4% per level) damage and are Slowed by 35% for 4 seconds.

1.name: Accelerated Decay
1.description: Each time a Hero is hit by Death and Decay's pool, they take 25% more periodic damage from Death and Decay for the next 4 seconds, stacking up to 4 times.

2.description: Every 8 seconds, Kel'Thuzad's next Basic Attack hits all enemies in the area for 80%  additional damage, deals Spell damage instead of Physical, and Slows by 30% for 2 seconds.

3.name: Ice Cold
3.description: Reduce the cooldown of Glacial Spike by 10 seconds and increase its damage by 400%.

1.name: Frost Blast
1.description: Launch a meteor of ice at an enemy Hero. Upon impact, the meteor deals 115 (+2.5% per level) damage to its target and 275 (+2.5% per level) damage to enemies in the area. All enemies hit by Frost Blast are Rooted for 2 seconds.

2.name: Shadow Fissure
2.description: Create a fissure anywhere on the Battleground that explodes after 1.5 seconds, dealing 320 (+2.5% per level) damage to enemy Heroes in its area. If an enemy Hero is hit, set its cooldown to 1.5 seconds.

1.name: Icy Grasp
1.description: Increase Frost Nova's Slow by 20%. Each time Kel'Thuzad damages enemies Slowed by Frost Nova, reduce the cooldown of Frost Nova by 0.75 seconds.

2.name: Chains of Ice
2.description: After Chains of Kel'Thuzad's Stun expires, the enemy is also Slowed by 60% for 1 second.

3.name: Chain-Link
3.description: Pulling a Hero with Chains of Kel'Thuzad reduces its cooldown by 5 seconds and refunds its Mana cost.

1.name: Arcane Echoes
1.description: Whenever Kel'Thuzad hits an enemy Hero with Death and Decay's explosion, its cooldown is reduced by 1.5 seconds.

2.name: Hungering Cold
2.description: Enemies that are Rooted take an additional 55 (+2.5% per level) damage each time they are damaged by Kel'Thuzad.

3.name: Power of Icecrown
3.description: Stunning, Rooting, or Slowing a Hero grants 6% Spell Power for 10 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.

1.name: Deathchill
1.description: When Frost Blast's Root expires, enemies are Slowed by 40% for 3 seconds. Heroes killed while under the effects of Frost Blast instantly release another Frost Blast explosion.

2.name: Might of the Scourge
2.description: If a Hero is hit with Shadow Fissure, a second one is cast below them 1 second later.  This second cast will not duplicate itself.

3.name: Shifting Malice
3.description: Activate to dash forward, dealing 150 (+2.5% per level) damage to enemies in the path. Takedowns reset the cooldown of Shifting Malice.

4.name: The Damned Return
4.description: Activate to create a Shade of Naxxramas that lasts 15 seconds and mimics Kel'Thuzad's casts of Death and Decay.

2.description: The final grenade launched from Frag Launcher deals 120% bonus damage, and Frag Launcher grenades last an additional 2 seconds before automatically detonating.

3.name: Blow 'Em Up!
3.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Concussion Mine or Steel Trap causes Junkrat to deal 25% more damage with Basic Attacks and Basic Abilities for 6 seconds.

RIP-Tire can be reactivated to detonate immediately, knocking nearby enemies back and dealing 720 (+4% per level) damage to enemies near the center gradually reduced to 445 (+4% per level) to enemies on the edge.

2.description: After 1.25 seconds, Junkrat launches into the air. While in the air, he can steer the landing location by moving. 1.description: Increase Junkrat's Basic Attack range by 1.  Frag Launcher grenades fired within 0.5 seconds of using a Basic Attack deal 30% bonus damage.

2.description: Junkrat is knocked back 50% farther by Concussion Mine. Additionally, Concussion Mine's cooldown is reduced by 12 seconds if only Junkrat is hit.

3.description: Reduce Steel Trap's cooldown by 5 seconds and increase the maximum number of active traps to 2.

1.description: Frag Launcher fires all of its charges in a continuous burst, its cooldown is reduced by 6 seconds, but it loses 1 maximum charge.

2.name: Endless Nades
2.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Frag Launcher reduces its cooldown by 1.5 seconds.

3.name: Spread Volley
3.description: Activate to make Frag Launcher fire 2 additional grenades in a spread. Works for up to 4 total charges, or until Frag Launcher runs out of charges.

1.description: Increase RIP-Tire's knockback distance by 50%, and its cooldown is reduced by 25 seconds for each enemy Hero hit.

2.name: Puckish Scamp
2.description: Junkrat also gains the Ability RIP-Tire. Each time he uses his Heroic, it swaps to the alternate ability.  Passive: Reduce both Heroic cooldowns by 20 seconds.

3.name: Cannonball!
3.description: Increase the radius and explosion radius of grenades from Basic Attacks and Frag Launcher by 50%.

4.name: I Hate Waiting!
4.description: Junkrat always rides his Rocket Ride Mount, which grants 150% increased Movement Speed, but his Mount cooldown is increased to 8 seconds.

2.name: Lunar Blaze
2.description: Increase Lunar Flare's range by 30%.  Quest: Hitting a Hero with Lunar Flare increases its damage by 5%, up to 150%.

3.name: Trueshot Aura
3.description: Activate to grant other nearby allied Heroes 40% increased Attack Damage for 5 seconds, and to reset the cooldown of Hunter's Mark.  Passive: Basic Attack damage increased by 30%.

2.description: Increase the Slow of Starfall to 60% and cause it to apply Hunter's Mark to enemy Heroes while inside of its area of effect.

1.description: Increase Lion's Fang's healing from Heroes by 75%.

2.description: Basic Attacks heal Varian for 1% of his maximum Health. While below 50% Health, they also heal him for 50% of the damage dealt.
