1.name: Baneling Massacre
1.description: Gain 2 additional charges of Banelings Barrage, but increase its cooldown by 2 seconds.

2.name: Viscous Acid
2.description: Banelings Slow enemies by 25% for 2.5 seconds.

3.name: Bile Drop
3.description: Quest: Passively increases the radius of Infested Drop by 20%.  Reward: After hitting 12 Heroes with Infested Drop, it spawns an additional Roachling.

1.name: Devouring Maw
1.description: Summon a Devouring Maw that devours enemies for 4 seconds. Devoured enemies cannot fight and take 94 (+4% per level) damage per second.  Usable on Unstoppable enemies.

2.name: Nydus Network
2.description: Summon a Nydus Worm on Creep anywhere that Zagara has vision. Zagara can enter a Nydus Worm and travel to any other Nydus Worm by right-clicking near it. While inside a Nydus Worm, Zagara regenerates 10% Health and Mana per second.  Stores up to 2 charges. Maximum of 4 Nydus Worms at a time.  Passive: Creep spreads 15% farther.  Passive: While on Creep, each Basic Attack reduces all of Zagara's cooldowns by 0.4 seconds.

1.name: Hydralisk Transfusion
1.description: Zagara is healed for 60% of the damage dealt by Hunter Killers' Basic Attacks to Heroes.

2.name: Protective Coating
2.description: While on Creep, Zagara gains 20 Armor, taking 20% less damage.

3.name: Spell Shield
3.description: Every 30 seconds, gain 50 Spell Armor against the next enemy Ability and subsequent Abilities for 3 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 50%.  Can be toggled to allow or prevent this talent from triggering automatically.

1.name: Corrosive Saliva
1.description: When attacking Heroes, Hunter Killers and Roachlings deal additional damage equal to 1.75% of their maximum Health.

2.name: Mutalisk
2.description: Reduce the cooldown of Hunter Killer by 4 seconds.  Hunter Killer now spawns a Mutalisk. Mutalisks have a bounce attack and last for 30 seconds.

3.name: Jagged Barbs
3.description: While on Creep, Zagara gains 50% more Basic Attack damage and her attack range is increased by 1.1.

1.name: Tyrant Maw
1.description: Devouring Maw deals 50% more damage. Takedowns reduce its cooldown by 25 seconds.

2.name: Endless Creep
2.description: The cast range for Creep Tumor is increased by 2000%. Creep Tumors now last 600 seconds. While on Creep, Zagara gains an additional 10% Movement Speed.

3.name: Broodmother
3.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack also launches a Baneling towards the target.  Passive: Gain 20% bonus Attack Speed.

4.name: Pack Instinct
4.description: Zagara and her summons deal 20% more damage to enemies attacked by a Hunter Killer in the last 2 seconds.

1.name: Maximum Effort
1.description: If Carnage damages the same enemy Hero 3 times it deals an additional 108 (+4% per level) damage and Slows by 25% for 2.5 seconds.

2.name: Fatal Wounds
2.description: While at maximum stacks, Blood Rage's bleed deals 30% additional damage to enemy Heroes under 50% Health.  Quest: Damage enemy Heroes with Blood Rage's bleed damage.  Reward: After damaging Heroes with Blood Rage's bleed damage 150 times, Blood Rage's duration is increased by 2 seconds.

3.name: Finishing Touch
3.description: Gain 20% Basic Attack damage. When Qhira Basic Attacks an enemy Hero below 50% Health it deals 20% additional damage, and she gains 35% Attack Speed for 3 seconds.

1.name: Upstage
1.description: Damaging at least 2 Heroes with Blood Rage causes Qhira to Evade the next 4 Heroic Basic Attacks within 12 seconds.

2.name: Ensnaring Swing
2.description: The primary target of Revolving Sweep is Slowed by 60% while Qhira is attached to them. Secondary targets hit by Revolving Sweep's swing are Slowed by 40% for 3 seconds.

3.name: Your Pain, My Gain
3.description: Basic Attacking an enemy Hero causes Qhira to gain 10 Armor for 3 seconds. Stacks 3 times.

1.name: The Thirst
1.description: Carnage heals for 50% of the damage dealt to enemy Heroes. Anytime Carnage damages an enemy Hero, Qhira's next Basic Attack within 4 seconds against an enemy Hero deals 15% additional damage, stacking up to 10 times.

2.name: Healmonger
2.description: If Blood Rage damages an enemy Hero below 50% Health, it heals for an additional 190 (+4% per level) Health.

3.name: Siphoning Link
3.description: Damaging an enemy Hero with Revolving Sweep's initial impact or swing causes Qhira to regenerate 96 (+4% per level) Health over 4 seconds. Stacks up to 4 times.  Passive: Basic Attacks heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

1.name: Unrelenting Strikes
1.description: Deal 44 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies every 0.5 seconds for 2.5 seconds as your sword grows outward. Upon expiring, deal 160 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemy Heroes and Stun them for 1.5 seconds.

2.name: Final Strike
2.description: After 1 second, deal 395 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in a line. This damage is increased by 25% against enemy Heroes who are below 50% Health.

1.name: Chainsaw
1.description: Carnage's cooldown recharges 100% faster while an enemy Hero has maximum Blood Rage stacks.

2.name: Pulsing Pain
2.description: Each additional enemy Hero hit by Revolving Sweep causes the primary target to take an additional 135 (+4% per level) damage.

3.name: The Hunted
3.description: Basic Attacking an enemy Hero increases your Basic Attack damage against that Hero by 25%. Stacks up to 4 times and lasts 4 seconds. Bonus is reset if a different Hero is attacked.

1.name: Booming Kick
1.description: Increase the Stun duration of Revolving Sweep's re-activation by 0.25 seconds. Enemy Heroes around the primary target are also affected by Revolving Sweep's re-activation.

2.name: Lingering Ailment
2.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Revolving Sweep or by Grappling Hook have their Armor reduced by 25 for 3 seconds.

3.name: Swing Life Away
3.description: Revolving Sweep's cooldown recharges 250% faster while Qhira is swinging around her target. She also gains 60 Spell Armor for 5 seconds after the re-activation impact.

1.name: Silent Killer
1.description: Hitting enemy Heroes with Unrelenting Strikes Silences them for 0.5 seconds and reduces its cooldown by 3 seconds.

2.name: Unleashed Potential
2.description: Increase the damage to enemy Heroes under 50% Health from 25% to 50%.  If an enemy Hero dies within 1.5 seconds of being hit by Final Strike, then reset the cooldowns of Final Strike and all of Qhira's Basic Abilities.

3.name: Utility Belt
3.description: Grappling Hook's cooldown is reset when hitting an enemy Hero with the initial impact of Revolving Sweep and recharges 900% faster if Qhira hasn't taken damage within the last 2 seconds.

4.name: No Sanctuary
4.description: Nearby enemy Heroes below 50% Health are revealed and you gain 20% Movement Speed while an enemy Hero is revealed by you in this way.  Additionally, you deal 20% increased damage to these revealed enemies.

1.name: Pressurized Glands
1.description: Increases the range of Symbiote's Spike Burst by 25% and decreases the cooldown by 1 second.

2.name: Envenomed Nest
2.description: Toxic Nests deal 75% more damage over 3 seconds and reduce the Armor of enemy Heroes hit by 10 for 4 seconds.

3.name: Reinforced Carapace
3.description: Increase the Shield amount of Carapace by 40%.

4.name: Survival Instincts
4.description: Increases Locust's Health by 100% and damage by 60%.

1.name: Adrenal Overload
1.description: Heroic Symbiote hosts gain 25% increased Attack Speed.

2.name: Needlespine
2.description: Increases the damage and range of Symbiote's Stab by 20%.

3.name: Prolific Dispersal
3.description: Increase the duration of Toxic Nests by 45 seconds, reduce its cooldown by 2 seconds, and add 2 additional charges.

1.name: Vile Nest
1.description: Toxic Nests Slow enemy Movement Speed by 40% for 2.5 seconds.

2.name: Networked Carapace
2.description: Using Symbiote's Carapace also applies an untalented Carapace Shield to all nearby allied Heroes, Minions, and Mercenaries.

3.name: Calldown: MULE
3.description: Activate to calldown a Mule that repairs Structures, one at a time, near target point for 40 seconds, healing for 90 Health every 1 second.

1.name: Ultimate Evolution
1.description: Clone target allied Hero and control it for 20 seconds. Abathur has perfected the clone, granting it 20% Spell Power, 20% bonus Attack Damage, and 10% bonus Movement Speed. Cannot use their Heroic Ability.

2.name: Evolve Monstrosity
2.description: Turn an allied Minion or Locust into a Monstrosity. When enemy Minions near the Monstrosity die, it gains 2% Health and 2% Basic Attack damage, stacking up to 40 times.  The Monstrosity can be healed by Carapace and has the ability to Burrow to a visible location every 80 seconds.  Using Symbiote on the Monstrosity allows Abathur to control it, in addition to Symbiote's normal benefits.  This Ability can be reactivated to automatically cast Symbiote on his Monstrosity.

1.name: Spatial Efficiency
1.description: Symbiote's Stab gains 1 additional charge and its cooldown is reduced by .5 seconds.

2.name: Soma Transference
2.description: Symbiote's Spike Burst heals the host for 64 (+4% per level) Health per enemy Hero hit.

3.name: Bombard Strain
3.description: Locust's Basic Attacks become a long-range siege attack and their duration is increased by 75%.

1.name: Envenomed Spikes
1.description: Abathur's Symbiote's Spike Burst also Slows enemy Movement Speed by 40% for 2 seconds.

2.name: Adrenaline Boost
2.description: Symbiote's Carapace increases the Movement Speed of the target by 40% for 3.5 seconds.

3.name: Volatile Mutation
3.description: Ultimate Evolution clones and Monstrosities deal 137 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies every 3 seconds and when they die. Enemy Heroes hit heal the clone or Monstrosity for 100% of the damage dealt.

4.name: Locust Brood
4.description: Activate to spawn 3 Locusts at a nearby location.

1.name: Evolutionary Link
1.description: Increase the duration of Ultimate Evolution by 50%.  As long as the Ultimate Evolution is alive, the original target of the clone gains a Shield equal to 35% of their maximum Health.  Refreshes every 5 seconds.

2.name: Evolution Complete
2.description: Increase Monstrosity's Basic Attack damage by 100%.

3.name: Hivemind
3.description: Symbiote creates an additional Symbiote on a nearby allied Hero.  This Symbiote mimics the commands of the first, but does half damage and Shielding.

4.name: Locust Nest
4.description: Activate to create a nest that periodically spawns Locusts. Only one Locust Nest can be active at a time.

1.name: Greater Cleave
1.description: Increases the radius of Cleave by 33%.

2.name: Shadow Hunter
2.description: Quest: Gather Regeneration Globes to lower the Mana cost of Blink by 3, up to 45.  Reward: Upon gathering 15 Regeneration Globes, Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Blink by 1.5 seconds.

3.name: Move Unseen
3.description: Reduce the cooldown of Permanent Cloak by 1 second. Gain 30% Movement Speed while Stealthed.

1.name: Rending Cleave
1.description: Cleave deals an additional 40% damage over 3 seconds.

2.name: Psionic Strength
2.description: Dealing damage to enemy Heroes increases all damage dealt by 6% for 3 seconds, stacking up to 30%.

3.name: Darkness Descends
3.description: Activate to gain 40% Attack Speed for 5 seconds.  Passive: Gain 20% Attack Speed.

1.name: Wormhole
1.description: After 1.25 seconds, reactivate Blink to return to the point where it was cast from within 4 seconds.

2.name: Seeker in the Dark
2.description: Singularity Spike takes 50% longer to explode. It can be reactivated to teleport to the target, granting 30% increased Move Speed for 3 seconds.

3.name: Warp Skirmisher
3.description: Vorpal Blade gains a 2nd charge. Teleporting to an enemy with Vorpal Blade or entering Permanent Cloak causes Zeratul's next Basic Attack to deal 50% more damage.

1.name: Might Of The Nerazim
1.description: Activate to cast an untalented version of Zeratul's most recently used Basic Ability, dealing 50% less damage.  Passive: After using an Ability, Zeratul's next Basic Attack within 6 seconds deals 30% more damage.

2.name: Void Prison
2.description: Slows time in an area to a near standstill, placing allies and enemies in Time Stop for 5 seconds. Zeratul is not affected.

1.name: Shroud of Adun
1.description: Zeratul gains a Shield equal to 20% of his Maximum Health over 3 seconds while under Permanent Cloak.

2.name: Mending Strikes
2.description: Basic Attacks heal for 35% of the damage dealt.

3.name: Spell Shield
3.description: Every 30 seconds, gain 50 Spell Armor against the next enemy Ability and subsequent Abilities for 3 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 50%.  Can be toggled to allow or prevent this talent from triggering automatically.

1.name: Master Warp-Blade
1.description: Every third consecutive Basic Attack against the same target deals 125% bonus damage.

2.name: Void Slash
2.description: If Cleave hits more than one enemy Hero, it deals 40% increased damage and its cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds.

3.name: Sentenced to Death
3.description: Deal 25% increased damage to enemies while they are marked or Slowed by Singularity Spike.

1.name: Twilight Falls
1.description: Might of the Nerazim resets the cooldown of all Basic Abilities.

2.name: Unwavering Pressure
2.description: Singularity Spike no longer costs Mana. Basic Attacks against enemies reduce its cooldown by 1.25 seconds, double versus Heroes.

3.name: Shadow Stride
3.description: Reduce the cooldown of Vorpal Blade by 10 seconds. Casting Vorpal Blade grants Zeratul a Shield that absorbs up to 260 (+4% per level) damage for 3 seconds.

4.name: Shadow Mending
4.description: Heal for 60% of Spell Damage dealt to Heroes.

1.name: Live and Let Live
1.description: While Alexstrasza is above 75% Health, Gift of Life's cooldown recharges 125% faster.

2.name: Circle of Life
2.description: Quest: Collect Regeneration Globes.  Reward: After collecting 10 Regeneration Globes, Abundance heals for an additional 5% maximum Health.  Reward: After collecting 15 Regeneration Globes, Abundance's healing burst creates a Regeneration Globe.

3.name: Flames of Fury
3.description: Reduce the Mana cost of Flame Buffet from 50 to 40.  Quest: Hit 20 Burning Heroes with Flame Buffet.  Reward: Hitting a Burning Hero with Flame Buffet reduces Dragonqueen's cooldown by 5 seconds.

1.name: Surge of Vitality
1.description: Abundance's healing burst grants allied Heroes 30% Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

2.name: Heat Exhaustion
2.description: Increase Flame Buffet's Slow from 40% to 50% and cause it to no longer decay.

3.name: Exuberance
3.description: While above 75% Health, gain 15% Movement Speed.

1.name: Lifeblossom
1.description: While Alexstrasza is above 75% Health, Gift of Life creates a Lifeblossom at the target's location. Alexstrasza can collect the Lifeblossom to make her next Gift of Life cost no Health.  Passive: Reduces the cost of Gift of Life to 10% of Alexstrasza's current Health.

2.name: Verdant Flourish
2.description: Alexstrasza receives 40% more healing from Abundance and 100% more healing from Regeneration Globes.

3.name: Fire Within
3.description: Hitting a Burning Hero with Flame Buffet heals Alexstrasza for 10% of her maximum Health.

1.name: Life-Binder
1.description: Bind Alexstrasza's life force with an allied Hero. Both her and her target are healed for 480 (+4% per level) Health over 2 seconds. Afterwards, the Hero with a lower percentage of Health is healed to the same Health percentage as the other Hero.

2.name: Cleansing Flame
2.description: After 1.25 seconds, take to the sky and drop 5 fireballs over 6 seconds at the position of the mouse cursor. Fireballs deal 135 (+4% per level) damage to enemies and heal allied Heroes for 300 (+4% per level) Health.  2 seconds after dropping all fireballs, Alexstrasza lands at the position of the mouse cursor.

1.name: Dragon Scales
1.description: Gain 50 Armor while Stunned, Rooted, or Silenced, and for 2 seconds after. Can only trigger once every 10 seconds.

2.name: Pacify
2.description: Activate to Slow and reduce an enemy Hero's damage by 50% for 3 seconds.  Healing a Stunned, Rooted, or Silenced ally reduces Pacify's cooldown by 30 seconds.

3.name: Life Unbound
3.description: Activate to heal an allied Hero for 15% of their maximum Health and deal 200 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies.  Healing a Stunned, Rooted, or Silenced ally reduces Life Unbound's cooldown by 30 seconds.  Cannot be used on Alexstrasza.

1.name: Tough Love
1.description: Gift of Life grants its target 10 Armor for 2.5 seconds, increased to 30 while Alexstrasza is above 75% Health.

2.name: Overprotective
2.description: Heroes healed by Abundance gain a Shield for 6 seconds equal to 70% of the amount healed.

3.name: Draconic Discipline
3.description: Increase Dragonqueen's duration by 6 seconds, and Basic Attack healing by 50%.

1.name: Ritual of Life
1.description: Life-Binder activates 3 times over 6 seconds.

2.name: On Ruby Wings
2.description: Healing or damaging Heroes 8 or more times with Cleansing Flame activates Dragonqueen for 15 seconds upon landing.

3.name: Ancient Flame
3.description: While Dragonqueen is active, Alexstrasza's Basic Attacks apply Flame Buffet.

4.name: Blessing of the Red
4.description: Activate to grant an allied Hero 500 bonus maximum Health until they die.  Cannot be used on Alexstrasza, or on a Hero who already has Blessing of the Red.

1.name: Consume Vitality
1.description: Skeletal Swing's cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds. Enemy Heroes hit heal Leoric for 4% of his maximum Health.

2.name: Fealty Unto Death
2.description: When a nearby friendly or enemy Minion dies, Leoric restores 1.25% of his maximum Health and 6 Mana.

3.name: Ossein Renewal
3.description: Activate to heal Leoric for 30% of his maximum Health over 5 seconds. Regeneration Globes lower the cooldown of this Ability by 20 seconds.

1.name: Ghastly Reach
1.description: Increase the range of Skeletal Swing by 25%.

2.name: Paralyzing Rage
2.description: Increase the Slow of Skeletal Swing by 20%.

3.name: Kneel, Peasants!
3.description: Skeletal Swing deals 75% additional damage to Mercenaries and Monsters, and hitting them activates Skeletal Swing's cost and cooldown refund.

1.name: Willing Vessel
1.description: Increase the healing from Drain Hope to 25% of Leoric's maximum Health. If Drain Hope lasts its full duration, Leoric instantly heals for an additional 5% of his maximum Health.

2.name: Drain Momentum
2.description: Drain Hope no longer reduces Leoric's Movement Speed. If Drain Hope lasts its full duration, gain 30% Movement Speed for 4 seconds.

3.name: Hopelessness
3.description: Increase the range of Drain Hope by 25%.

1.name: Entomb
1.description: Create an unpassable tomb for 4 seconds.

2.name: March of the Black King
2.description: Leoric becomes Unstoppable and walks forward, swinging his mace 3 times. Enemies hit take 250 (+4% per level) damage, and Heroes hit heal Leoric for 12% of his maximum Health.

1.name: Unyielding Despair
1.description: Drain Hope's cooldown is reduced by 0.75 seconds for every 1 second it is active. If Drain Hope lasts its full duration, its cooldown is reduced by an additional 2 seconds.

2.name: Ominous Wraith
2.description: Increase Wraith Walk's duration by 100%. Enemy Heroes that come in contact with the wraith deal 50% less damage for 4 seconds.

3.name: Spectral Leech
3.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes deal bonus damage equal to 2.5% of the Hero's maximum Health and heal Leoric for twice that amount.

1.name: Crushing Hope
1.description: If Drain Hope lasts its full duration, it instantly deals an additional 15% of the target's maximum Health as damage. This damage does not heal Leoric.

2.name: Royal Focus
2.description: Wraith Walk increases the damage of the next Skeletal Swing within 5 seconds by 50%. Each enemy Hero hit by this Skeletal Swing reduces the cooldown of Wraith Walk by 7 seconds.

3.name: Mithril Mace
3.description: Increase Leoric's Attack Speed by 20%.  Repeatable Quest: Nearby enemy Minion deaths grant 0.3% permanent Attack Speed, and Takedowns grant 3% permanent Attack Speed, up to 30%.

1.name: Buried Alive
1.description: The duration of Entomb is lowered by 1 second, but enemies trapped inside are Silenced and take 50 (+4% per level) damage every 1 second.

2.name: Death March
2.description: The final swing of March of the Black King also applies Drain Hope to nearby enemy Heroes.

3.name: Burning Despair
3.description: Deal 40 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies.  While Drain Hope is active, gain 40 Armor and the damage and area is increased by 100%.

4.name: Shroud of the Dead King
4.description: Activate to become Protected for 3 seconds, preventing all damage.

1.name: Fish Eye
1.description: Egg's Health is increased by 100%, its sight radius is increased by 300% and it can see Stealthed enemies.  Passive: Spawning from his Egg increases Murky's mount speed to 45% for 5 seconds.

2.name: Egg Hunt
2.description: Activate to place a fake Egg. If the fake Egg dies, it casts an untalented Slime. Maximum 3 fake Eggs.  Passive: Spawning from his Egg grants Murky Stealth for 5 seconds.

3.name: A Fishy Deal
3.description: Killing a Minion with Pufferfish grants a stack of Bribe. Use 8 stacks to bribe a Mercenary, instantly defeating them. Does not work on Elite Mercenaries.  Maximum of 32 stacks of Bribe.

1.name: Slime Time
1.description: Quest: Slime enemy Heroes that are already Slimed.  Reward: After Sliming 10 Heroes, increase Slime's bonus damage by 125.  Reward: After Sliming 20 Heroes, increase Slime's slow amount to 30%.

2.name: Tufferfish
2.description: Pufferfish gains 50 Spell Armor and deals 50% more damage to Slimed targets.

3.name: Living the Dream
3.description: Quest: Every 15 seconds Murky is alive, he gains 5% Spell Power, up to 25%. This bonus is reset upon his death.

1.name: Black Lagoon
1.description: Increase Slime's radius by 30%.

2.name: Slippery When Wet
2.description: Gain 50% Movement Speed and move through units while in Safety Bubble. Additionally, Safety Bubble's cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds.

3.name: Time to Krill
3.description: Basic Attacks against Heroes deal an additional 7 (+4% per level) damage a second and slow the target by 7% for 4 seconds. This effect can stack up to 5 times.

1.name: March of the Murlocs
1.description: After 0.75 seconds, Murky commands a legion of Murlocs to march in a target direction, each one leaping onto the first enemy Hero or Structure they find. Each Murloc deals 125 (+4% per level) damage and slows its target by 15% for 5 seconds. Murlocs deal 50% damage to Structures.

2.name: Octo-Grab
2.description: Murky becomes Unstoppable and Stuns target enemy Hero for 3 seconds while he hits them for 1 damage a second.

1.name: Rejuvenating Bubble
1.description: Safety Bubble restores 40% of Murky's maximum Health.

2.name: Egg Shell
2.description: Spawning from his Egg grants Murky a Shield equal to 100% of his maximum Health. The shield lasts indefinitely.

3.name: Fish Tank
3.description: Murky is healed for 25% of the damage he deals with Basic Attacks and Basic Abilities.

1.name: Toxic Buildup
1.description: Every 3rd consecutive Basic Attack against an enemy Hero causes a free Slime to be cast upon them.

2.name: Fish Oil
2.description: The Pufferfish casts Slime at its location upon landing.

3.name: Wrath of Cod
3.description: Heroes hit by Pufferfish take additional damage equal to 15% of their maximum Health over 5 seconds.

1.name: Never-Ending Murlocs
1.description: March of the Murlocs can be channeled, sending little Murlocs indefinitely.

2.name: ... And a Shark Too!
2.description: Increase the damage of Octo-Grab by 13700% (+4% per level).

3.name: Big Tuna Kahuna
3.description: Murky's maximum Health and Egg respawn time are doubled.

4.name: Making Inky
4.description: Reduces the cooldown of Slime from 4 seconds to 2 seconds.

1.name: Echo of the Elements
1.description: Quest: Kill Minions or Heroes within 1.5 seconds of hitting them with Chain Lightning.  Reward: After killing 10 enemies, reduce the Mana cost of Chain Lightning from 40 to 20.  Reward: After killing 20 enemies, gain a second charge of Chain Lightning.

2.name: Crash Lightning
2.description: Repeatable Quest: Hitting at least 2 Heroes with a single use of Chain Lightning increases the damage of its bounces by 12, up to 360.  Reward: After hitting multiple Heroes 30 times, Chain Lightning prioritizes bouncing to Heroes.

3.name: Rolling Thunder
3.description: For 8 seconds after hitting an enemy with Chain Lightning, Thrall's next Basic Attack against them grants a stack of Frostwolf Resilience. If the target is an enemy Hero, then he also deals damage to them equal to 3% of their maximum Health and healing for the same amount.  Passive: Increase the number of Chain Lightning bounces by 1.

1.name: Feral Resilience
1.description: Heroes damaged by Feral Spirit grant 4 stacks of Frostwolf Resilience and 2 stacks of Feral Resilience, granting 75 Physical Armor against the next incoming Hero Basic Attack.  Stacks are consumed on the next cast of Feral Spirit.

2.name: Frostwolf Pack
2.description: Quest: Hit 6 Heroes with Feral Spirit. Progress is lost on death and when Thrall fails to hit a Hero.  Reward: Reduce the cooldown and Mana cost of Feral Spirit by 50%.

3.name: Mana Tide
3.description: Frostwolf Resilience restores 15 Mana and reduces Basic Ability cooldowns by 0.5 seconds.

1.name: Maelstrom Weapon
1.description: Repeatable Quest: Basic Attacks against Heroes while Windfury's Movement Speed bonus is active increase Attack Damage by 1.  Reward: After gaining 20 Attack Damage, increase the Movement Speed bonus of Windfury to 40%.  Reward: After gaining 40 Attack Damage, Thrall permanently gains 15% increased Movement Speed.

2.name: Ancestral Wrath
2.description: Activate to consume 8 stacks of Ancestral Wrath, damaging a target enemy Hero for 15% of their maximum Health over 3 seconds, and healing Thrall for 150% of the damage dealt.  Gain 1 stack of Ancestral Wrath every time Frostwolf Resilience activates.

3.name: Follow Through
3.description: After using an Ability, your next Basic Attack within 6 seconds deals 40% additional damage.

1.name: Sundering
1.description: After 0.5 seconds, sunder the earth in a long line, dealing 290 (+4% per level) damage and shoving enemies to the side, Stunning them for 1 second.

2.name: Earthquake
2.description: After 0.5 seconds, summon a massive Earthquake that pulses every 4 seconds. Each pulse lasts 2 seconds, Slowing all enemies in the area by 50%, and deals 50 (+4% per level) damage to enemy Heroes. Does 3 pulses.

1.name: Grace Of Air
1.description: Windfury attacks grant twice as many stacks of Frostwolf Resilience.

2.name: Frostwolf's Grace
2.description: Frostwolf Resilience can be activated to instantly heal. This healing is increased by up to 100% based on Thrall's missing health.

3.name: Spirit Shield
3.description: Every 45 seconds, gain 50 Spell Armor against the next enemy Ability and subsequent Abilities for 4 seconds. Frostwolf Resilience reduces this cooldown by 10 seconds.  Can be toggled to allow or prevent this talent from triggering automatically.

1.name: Tempest Fury
1.description: The final strike of Windfury hits 3 times for 75% normal damage.

2.name: Thunderstorm
2.description: Chain Lightning Slows targets by 8% for 2 seconds.  Quest: Targeting a Hero directly with Chain Lightning increases this Slow by 8%, up to an additional 40%.  Reward: While at a 40% bonus, Chain Lightning's damage is increased by 25%.  Bonuses are reset if Chain Lightning is used on the same Hero it was last used on, or if Thrall dies.

3.name: Alpha Wolf
3.description: For 3 seconds after a Hero is hit by Feral Spirit, Thrall's Basic Attacks against them deal an additional 3% of the target's maximum Health as damage.  Passive: Increase the duration of Feral Spirit's Root to 1.5 seconds.

1.name: Worldbreaker
1.description: Lower the cooldown of Sundering by 40 seconds. After Sundering impacts, it leaves behind an impassable rift, blocking unit movement for 3 seconds.

2.name: Earthen Shields
2.description: Allies within the Earthquake area gain a Shield equal to 15% of their maximum Health each pulse. This shield lasts 4 seconds.

3.name: Elemental Momentum
3.description: Basic Attacks reduce Thrall's Basic and Heroic Ability cooldowns by 0.25 seconds, tripled against Heroes.

4.name: Nexus Blades
4.description: Basic Attacks deal 20% more damage and Slow enemy Movement Speed by 20% for 1 second.

5.name: Wind Rush
5.description: Activate to immediately teleport to a target location and gain Windfury.

1.name: Thunderstroke

3.description: Activate to deal 150 (+4% per level) damage to all nearby enemies after 2 seconds. For each Hero hit, heal for 182 (+4% per level) and gain 1 Chaos.

1.name: Bond of Anguish
1.description: Shadow Waltz deals bonus damage to Heroes equal to 3% of their maximum Health, healing Orphea for 50% of damage dealt.

2.name: Dead Magic
2.description: Basic Attacks that consume Chaos ignore Armor and deal 90 (+4% per level) Spell Damage to the target and all enemies around them.

3.name: Lurking Terror
3.description: After Dread erupts and for 2 seconds after, activate to cast Chomp from the eruption area. Enemy Heroes hit by this Chomp are Slowed by 70% for 1.5 seconds.

1.name: Monster Within
1.description: Eternal Feast grants 1 Chaos each time it hits a Hero. While Eternal Feast is active and for 5 seconds afterwards, Orphea's Basic Abilities recharge 150% faster.

2.name: Engulfing Oblivion
2.description: Crushing Jaws reduces the Armor of Heroes hit by 50 for 3 seconds. Takedowns set its cooldown to 5 seconds.

3.name: Eldritch Conduit
3.description: Each Chaos consumed increases Orphea's Spell Power by 3%, up to 30%. After reaching the maximum bonus, the Spell Power is increased by an additional 30%. Lasts 10 seconds.

4.name: Final Toccata
4.description: Activate to instantly reset the cooldown of Shadow Waltz. For the next 5 seconds, dashing with Shadow Waltz resets its cooldown and increases the duration of Final Toccata by 1 second.

1.name: Party Mix
1.description: Quest: Play Lúcio's Crossfade tracks to nearby allies. Multiple allies provide additional time.  Reward: For every 1 Minute played, permanently increase Lucio's maximum Mana by 10.  Reward: Once you have played for 8 minutes or more, permanently increase Crossfade's range by 20%.

2.name: Accelerando
2.description: Wall Ride's Movement Speed bonus gradually increases to 40% over 4 seconds while Lúcio maintains its effect.

3.name: Smooth Moves
3.description: While Wall Ride is active, Basic Attacks heal for 30% of the damage dealt and restore 0.5 Mana.  Passive: Increase Wall Ride duration by 1 second.

1.name: Subwoofer
1.description: Enemies within the first half of Soundwave's range are knocked back 75% further.  Quest: Hit 3 enemy Heroes with a single Soundwave.  Reward: Increase Soundwave's arc by 50% and its range by 20%.

2.name: Off the Wall
2.description: Hitting an enemy with Soundwave while Wall Ride is active reduces its cooldown by 3 seconds.

3.name: Supersonic
3.description: While Wall Ride is active, Push Off's cooldown recharges 100% faster.

1.name: Good Vibrations
1.description: Hitting an enemy with Soundwave grants Lúcio a 38 (+4% per level) Shield for 7 seconds. Hitting enemy Heroes grants 3 times this amount.

2.name: Reverse Amp
2.description: Blast Lúcio's active Crossfade track at enemy Heroes. While Amp It Up is active, Healing Boost deals 50 (+4% per level) damage per second and Speed Boost Slows by 20%.  This ability is unaffected by Crossfade talents.

3.name: Boombox
3.description: Place a boombox that plays Lúcio's active Crossfade track. Its volume adjusts with Amp It Up. Allied Heroes near the boombox gain 5 Armor.  Crossfade tracks do not stack.

1.name: Sound Barrier
1.description: After 1 second, Lúcio and nearby allied Heroes gain a 1296 (+4% per level) point Shield that rapidly decays over 6 seconds.

2.name: High Five
2.description: Quickly skate to an allied Hero. Upon arrival the ally is healed for 230 (+4% per level), Lúcio is healed for 80 (+4% per level), and both gain Unstoppable for 1 second.

1.name: All Together
1.description: For each ally affected by Crossfade, Lúcio gains 5% Movement Speed that stacks with other bonuses.

2.name: Heavy Casters
2.description: Push Off no longer Slows enemies, and instead Stuns them for 0.5 seconds.

3.name: Slip
3.description: While Wall Ride is active, passing near an enemy Hero increases its Movement Speed bonus to 40%, and grants 15 Armor, for 1 second.

1.name: Rejuvenescência
1.description: While Amp It Up is active, Crossfade's Healing Boost heals for an additional 2.5% of the target's maximum Health each second.

2.name: Up the Frequency
2.description: Hitting enemy Heroes with Basic Attacks reduces the cooldown of Amp It Up by 0.4 seconds.  Passive: Wall Ride increases Basic Attack range by 2.2.

3.name: Up To Eleven
3.description: Increase the duration of Amp It Up by 1 second. While Amp It Up is active, enemy Heroes hit by Soundwave or Push-Off further increase its duration by 0.3 seconds.

1.name: Bossa Nova
1.description: Reduce the cooldown of Sound Barrier to 30 seconds, but the Shield now decays over 4 seconds.

2.name: Mixing Fire
2.description: High Five can now be cast on enemy Heroes, dealing 160 (+4% per level) damage and reducing all healing received by 50% for 3 seconds.  Passive: Reduce the cost and cooldown of High Five by 30%.

3.name: House Party
3.description: For each ally affected by Crossfade, Lúcio gains 8% increased healing.

4.name: Summer Anthem
4.description: Activate for allies affected by Crossfade to become Unkillable for 1.5 seconds.

1.name: Patchwork Creation
1.description: Gain 3 Armor for every unit afflicted with Vile Gas, stacking up to 8 times. While Shambling Horror is active, this Armor amount is doubled.  Passive: Increase regeneration effects and all healing received by 15%.

2.name: Savor The Flavor
2.description: Quest: Hitting an enemy Hero with Devour increases Stitches' Health Regeneration by 1.5 and the damage of Vile Gas by 2%, stacking up to 100 times.

3.name: Hungry for More
3.description: Gain 5% Movement Speed.  Quest: Gathering a Regeneration Globe increases Stitches's maximum Health by 25.  Reward: Every 20 Globes gathered permanently increases Stitches' Movement Speed by an additional 5%.

1.name: Playtime!
1.description: Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Slam by 0.75 seconds and restores 5 Mana. Hitting Heroes with the inner area of Slam reduces its cooldown by 1.5 seconds.

2.name: Vile Cleaver
2.description: Basic Attacks against enemies with Vile Gas deal 35% more damage and spreads Vile Gas to nearby enemies.  Passive: Slam applies Vile Gas to all targets hit.

3.name: Tenderizer
3.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes Slow by 20% for 1.5 seconds and restore 1.75% of Stitches' maximum Health.

1.name: Serrated Edge
1.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Hook deals bonus damage equal to 5% of their maximum Health, reduces Hook's cooldown by 4 seconds, and restores 35 Mana.

2.name: Second Helping
2.description: Devour gains 1 additional charge with a 6 second cooldown between uses.  Gambit: If Stitches is at max Health after using Devour, he gains a Shield equal to 15% of his maximum Health for 10 seconds. Every death, reduce this Shield by 3%.

3.name: Putrefaction
3.description: While Shambling Horror is active, Vile Gas reduces healing received by 40%.  Passive: Vile Gas heals Stitches for 75% of the damage dealt.

1.name: Putrid Bile
1.description: Emit bile that deals 37 (+4% per level) damage per second to enemies within, Slowing them by 35% for 1.5 seconds. Gain 20% Movement Speed while emitting bile. Lasts 8 seconds.

2.name: Gorge
2.description: Consume an enemy Hero, trapping them for 4 seconds. When Gorge ends, the enemy Hero takes 274 (+4% per level) damage. The trapped Hero cannot move or act and doesn't take damage from other sources.

1.name: Meat Hook
1.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Hook heals Stitches for 20% of his maximum Health over 5 seconds. While active, Basic Attacks against the Hero hit refresh the duration of this effect.

2.name: Under Pressure
2.description: Increase Slam's damage by 25.  Quest: After damaging Heroes with Vile Gas 6 times, permanently increase the damage of Slam by 1, to a maximum of 75 additional damage.

3.name: Chop Chop
3.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Hook or activating Shambling Horror grants 40% increased Attack Speed for 4 seconds. Basic Attacks refresh the duration of this effect.

1.name: Pulverize
1.description: All enemies hit by Slam are Slowed by 70% for 0.75 seconds and Heroes have their Armor reduced by 10 for 3 seconds.

2.name: Digestive Juices
2.description: Devour deals an additional 140 (+4% per level) damage over 5 seconds. When used on a Hero, its cooldown is reduced by 4 seconds and causes the Hero hit to deal 50% reduced damage for 4 seconds.

3.name: Flare Up
3.description: Deals 15 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. Hitting an enemy Hero with Hook or activating Shambling Horror increases this damage by 150% for 4 seconds.

1.name: Gift From The Embalmer
1.description: Putrid Bile deals 100% more damage to Heroes.  Quest: Each time Putrid Bile damages an enemy Hero, the duration of Stitches' next death timer is reduced by 2%, to a maximum of 80% total reduction. All stacks of this effect are lost upon death.

2.name: Hungry Hungry Stitches
2.description: For 4 seconds after using Gorge, Stitches can teleport a short distance to additional targets and Gorge them. Enemies are Slowed by 75% for 1 second after Gorge ends.

3.name: Master Hooker
3.description: Reduce the cooldown of Hook by 4 seconds. Enemy Heroes hit by Hook have 75% reduced healing for 2 seconds. Allies hit by Helping Hand are Unkillable for 2 seconds.

4.name: Gas Bag
4.description: Activating Shambling Horror grants Unstoppable for 3 seconds.  Passive: Shambling Horror's cooldown is reduced by 20 seconds.

1.name: Reactive Parry
1.description: Damaging enemy Heroes with Twin Blades or Blade Dash grants Artanis 50 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing its damage by 50%.  Stores up to 2 charges.

2.name: Amateur Opponent
2.description: Twin Blades attacks deal 150% bonus damage to non-Heroes.

3.name: Protector Of Aiur
3.description: Quest: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes increase Artanis's Attack damage by 0.1%.  Takedowns grant 1% bonus damage.

1.name: Psionic Synergy
1.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Phase Prism grants 30 Armor for 5 seconds.

2.name: Shield Battery
2.description: Shield Overload's cooldown recharges 125% faster while its Shield is active.  Passive: Reduce Shield Overload's cooldown by 4 seconds.

3.name: Shield Surge
3.description: Increases Shield Overload's Shields by 80% while below 25% Health.

1.name: Solarite Reaper
1.description: Increases the damage of the first dash of Blade Dash by 175%.

2.name: Chrono Surge
2.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Phase Prism grants 40% bonus Attack Speed for 5 seconds and Slows the enemy's Movement Speed by 30% for 4 seconds.

3.name: Final Cut
3.description: After using an Ability, your next Basic Attack within 6 seconds deals 40% additional damage. While under 25% Health, this damage bonus is increased to 60%.

1.name: Suppression Pulse
1.description: Fire a large area pulse from the Spear of Adun, dealing 114 (+4% per level) damage and Blinding enemies for 4 seconds. Unlimited range.

2.name: Purifier Beam
2.description: Target an enemy Hero with an orbital beam from the Spear of Adun, dealing 184 (+4% per level) damage per second for 8 seconds. The beam will chase the target as they move.  Unlimited range.

1.name: Templar's Zeal
1.description: Reduce the Mana cost of Blade Dash from 50 to 25. Each time that Shield Overload activates, reduce the cooldown of Blade Dash by 6 seconds.

2.name: Triple Strike
2.description: Increases Twin Blades's number of Basic Attacks to 3, but increase its cooldown by 1 second.

3.name: Graviton Vortex
3.description: Reduce the Mana cost of Phase Prism from 50 to 25. Hitting an enemy Hero with Basic Attacks or Blade Dash reduces the cooldown of Phase Prism by 2 seconds.

4.name: Phase Bulwark
4.description: Shield Overload grants 50 Spell Armor while active and for 2 seconds after it expires.

1.name: Titan Killer
1.description: Basic Attacks against Heroes deal bonus damage equal to 0.5% of the target's maximum Health in damage, increased to 1.5% when empowered by Twin Blades.

2.name: Force of Will
2.description: Casting Basic Abilities reduces the cooldown of Shield Overload by 5 seconds.

3.name: Blades of a Templar
3.description: Increase Attack Speed by 20%. Basic Attacks Slow by 20% for 1.25 seconds.

1.name: Orbital Bombardment
1.description: Suppression Pulse gains an additional charge.  There is a 10 second cooldown between uses.

2.name: Target Purified
2.description: Increase the speed of Purifier Beam by 15%. If the target of Purifier Beam dies, it automatically recasts on the nearest visible enemy Hero.

3.name: Zealot Charge
3.description: Increase Twin Blades' charge distance by 75%.

4.name: Plasma Burn
4.description: While Shield Overload is active, deal 70 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies.

1.name: Scroll of Identify
1.description: Quest: Hitting an enemy Hero with Scroll of Sealing permanently increases its damage by 2.  Reward: After hitting 15 Heroes, Scroll of Sealing reveals and reduces the Armor of Heroes hit by 10 for 4 seconds.  Reward: After hitting 30 Heroes, this talent's Armor reduction effect is increased to 15 and its duration to 6 seconds.

2.name: Field Study
2.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Scroll of Sealing grants 20% Spell Power for 16 seconds, up to 40%.

3.name: Sapphire
3.description: Activate to increase the damage of the next Horadric Cube by 100% and its slow by 30%.  Only 1 Gem may be active at a time.

1.name: Potion of Shielding
1.description: Whenever an ally is healed by a Healing Potion, they gain a 140 (+4% per level) Shield for 6 seconds.

2.name: Rejuvenation Potion
2.description: Healing Potions restore 15 Mana and heal for an additional 114 (+4% per level) over 3 seconds.

3.name: Ruby
3.description: Activate to increase the damage of the next Horadric Cube by 100%  and it spawns 3 Lesser Healing Potions from each enemy Hero hit, healing allied Heroes for 250 (+4% per level) when picked up. Lesser Healing Potions last for 10 seconds.  Only 1 Gem may be active at a time.

1.name: Cube Mastery
1.description: Reduce the Mana cost of Scroll of Sealing from 40 to 25.  Each enemy Hero hit by Horadric Cube reduces the cooldown of Scroll of Sealing by 4 seconds.

2.name: Kanai's Cube
2.description: Horadric Cube reduces Hero damage dealt by 30% for 4 seconds.

3.name: Emerald
3.description: Activate to increase the damage of the next Horadric Cube by 100% and have it reduce the healing received of enemy Heroes by 75% for 4 seconds.  Only 1 Gem may be active at a time.

1.name: Stay Awhile and Listen
1.description: After 1 second, Channel for 3 seconds, putting enemy Heroes in front of Deckard to Sleep while Channeling, and for 2 seconds after.  Enemies can only be put to Sleep once per cast, and Sleep's effects end instantly if they take damage.

2.name: Lorenado
2.description: Vector Targeting After 1 second, create a twirling tome tornado that travels towards the targeted direction, continually knocking away enemies that come into contact with it. Deals 20 (+4% per level) damage to Heroes hit.

1.name: Super Healing Potion
1.description: If a Healing Potion isn't picked up for at least 2 seconds, it heals for 100% more.  Passive: Healing Potion heals for 25% more when the target is under 50% health.

2.name: Potion of Revival
2.description: When a Healing Potion is picked up, it also heals all nearby allied Heroes for 75% of the healing amount.

3.name: Ancient Blessings
3.description: Activate Fortitude of the Faithful to empower nearby allied Hero Basic Attacks for 8 seconds, causing them to deal an additional 62 (+4% per level) damage in an area and heal for 90 (+4% per level) for each Hero hit. This effect can only occur once per second.

1.name: Scroll of Stone Curse
1.description: Scroll of Sealing deals 200% more damage when hitting at least 2 Heroes.

2.name: Safety in Numbers
2.description: If at least 2 allied Heroes are nearby, Fortitude of the Faithful grants an additional 10 Armor, 50% Mana Regeneration per second, and causes Deckard's Basic Abilities to recharge an additional 50% faster.

3.name: Horadric Staff
3.description: Every 5 seconds, Deckard's next Basic Attack Stuns Heroes for 0.75 seconds.

1.name: Respect the Elderly
1.description: Stay Awhile and Listen Silences and Blinds enemies for 3 seconds upon waking up from Sleep.

2.name: Morenados!
2.description: Lorenado gains an additional charge and its cooldown is reduced by 10 seconds every time an enemy Hero is knocked back. This effect can only occur once per 0.5 seconds.

3.name: Bottomless Flask
3.description: After use, Healing Potions recharge after 8 seconds.

4.name: Perfect Gems
4.description: Reduce the cooldown of all Gems to 5 seconds and the cooldown of Horadric Cube by 6 seconds.

1.name: Light of Karabor
1.description: Increase Vindication's radius by 15%. Hitting an enemy Hero increases Vindication's healing by 45%. If more than one Hero is hit, the bonus is increased to 90%.

2.name: Dauntless
2.description: Casting a Basic Ability grants Yrel 35 Physical Armor for 2.5 seconds.

3.name: Maraad's Insight
3.description: After damaging an enemy Hero with a Basic Ability, Yrel's next Basic Attack heals her for 140 (+4% per level).

1.name: Aegis of Light
1.description: Upon landing, Avenging Wrath grants other nearby allied Heroes 30 Armor for 4 seconds.

2.name: Gift of the Naaru
2.description: Divine Purpose heals the lowest Health nearby allied Hero other than Yrel for 275 (+4% per level).

3.name: Hand of Freedom
3.description: Grant an allied Hero 30% Movement Speed for 3 seconds and remove all Slows and Roots from them.

1.name: Righteous Momentum
1.description: Gain 5% Movement Speed. Yrel is no longer Slowed while Channeling Righteous Hammer, and instead this bonus is quadrupled.

2.name: Holy Avenger
2.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Avenging Wrath at maximum charge deals 25% more damage and reduces its cooldown to 1 second.

3.name: Divine Steed
3.description: Mounting is instant and grants 60% Movement Speed that decays over 3 seconds.

1.name: Ardent Defender
1.description: Surround Yrel in a barrier for 3 seconds, absorbing all damage taken and healing her for 50% of the damage received.

2.name: Sacred Ground
2.description: Yrel sanctifies the ground around her, gaining 50 Armor until she leaves the area.

1.name: Aldor Peacekeeper
1.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Vindication at maximum charge deal 40% less damage for 3 seconds.

2.name: Repentance
2.description: Increase Avenging Wrath's Slow by 25% and duration by 0.75 seconds.

3.name: Velen's Chosen
3.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with a Basic Ability at maximum charge grants 10% Spell Power for 10 seconds, up to 30%.

1.name: Templar's Verdict
1.description: Righteous Hammer reduces the Armor of enemy Heroes hit by 20 for 4 seconds and deals bonus damage equal to 7% of their maximum Health.

2.name: Divine Favor
2.description: Casting a Basic Ability reduces the cooldown of Divine Purpose by 2.5 seconds.

3.name: Holy Wrath
3.description: After casting a Basic Ability, Yrel's next Basic Attack splashes for 35% increased damage around the target.

1.name: Word of Glory
1.description: Increase the amount that Yrel heals from damage received from 50% to 75%. Ardent Defender heals nearby allied Heroes for 100% of the healing received by Yrel.

2.name: Hallowed Ground
2.description: Casting Avenging Wrath while inside Sacred Ground moves Sacred Ground to Yrel's location upon landing.

3.name: Bubble Hearth
3.description: After 1 second, Yrel becomes Invulnerable and casts Hearthstone. Cannot be canceled.

4.name: Seraphim
4.description: Activate to become Unstoppable for 2 seconds.

1.name: Winged Guard
1.description: Each time Necrotic Embrace hits an enemy Hero, gain 75 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack.  If Winged Guard has no charges, Mal'Ganis will gain 1 charge after 6 seconds.

2.name: Vampiric Aura
2.description: Mal'Ganis heals for 30% of Physical Damage dealt, and nearby allied Heroes heal for 15% of Physical Damage dealt.

3.name: Time to Feed
3.description: Mal'Ganis heals for 70 (+4% per level) when damaging a nearby enemy Hero. This can occur once every 6 seconds against each enemy Hero, but is also refreshed when they are Slept by Night Rush.

1.name: Fueled by Torment
1.description: While Necrotic Embrace is active, Mal'Ganis heals for 12 (+4% per level) when damage is taken and Vampiric Touch converts 20% more Hero damage into healing.

2.name: Might of Sargeras
2.description: Necrotic Embrace's Armor is increased to 50.

3.name: Echo of Doom
3.description: When Necrotic Embrace expires, it explodes again for 68 (+4% per level) damage.  For each enemy Hero hit, gain 5 Mana and reduce the cooldown of Necrotic Embrace by 0.75 seconds.  Does not wake Sleeping targets.

1.name: Black Claws
1.description: After Mal'Ganis hits an enemy Hero with Fel Claws, his next Basic Attack deals 60% more damage and reduces the Armor of enemy Heroes by 15 for 2 seconds.

2.name: Will of Tichondrius
2.description: Each enemy Hero hit by the first 2 slashes of Fel Claws causes the final slash to steal 1% of maximum Health from enemy Heroes, up to 4%.  If at least 4 enemy Heroes are hit with the first 2 slashes of Fel Claws, then the final slash Stuns enemies for an additional 0.5 seconds.

3.name: Spreading Plague
3.description: After casting Night Rush, deal 33 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies.  This effect lasts for 5 seconds and Basic Attacks against Heroes refresh its duration.  Does not wake Sleeping targets.

1.name: Carrion Swarm
1.description: After 1 second, disperse into an Invulnerable swarm of bats for 3 seconds, dealing 120 (+4% per level) damage per second to enemies.  Vampiric Touch heals for 75% of Carrion Swarm's damage to Heroes.

2.name: Dark Conversion
2.description: Channel on an enemy Hero for 0.75 seconds, then swap Health percentages with the target over 3 seconds.

1.name: Deep Sleep
1.description: Increase Night Rush's Sleep duration by 0.75 seconds and its Movement Speed bonus by 10%.

2.name: The Night Beckons
2.description: Basic Attacks deal 200% bonus damage to Sleeping enemies.  After Night Rush's Sleep ends, targets are Slowed by 30% for 3 seconds.

3.name: Blood Rush
3.description: When Mal'Ganis is healed by a Hero, he gains 1% Movement Speed for 6 seconds, up to 15%.

1.name: Plague Bats
1.description: Necrotic Embrace unleashes a wave of bats in front of Mal'Ganis, dealing 81 (+4% per level) damage.

2.name: Frenzied Assault
2.description: Basic Attacks against Heroes with a higher Health percentage heal for an additional 50% of damage dealt.  Basic Attacks against Heroes with a lower Health percentage grant 35% Attack Speed for 3 seconds.

3.name: Blind as a Bat
3.description: Activate to erupt with blind rage, removing the cooldown and Mana cost of Fel Claws, but losing all vision. Lasts 6 seconds.   Enemy Heroes hit by the final slash of Fel Claws reduces the cooldown of this Ability by 4 seconds.

1.name: Seeker Swarm
1.description: Upon expiring, Carrion Swarm's bats seek nearby enemy Heroes, dealing 132 (+4% per level) damage and Sleeping them for 2.5 seconds.

2.name: Wrath of Nathreza
2.description: Enemy Heroes near the target suffer 75% of the transferred Health as damage over 3 seconds.  Does not benefit from Vampiric Touch.

3.name: Vanquish the Weak
3.description: Damage from Fel Claws and Basic Attacks Slows enemies by 25% for 1.5 seconds, and Vampiric Touch converts 10% more damage into healing versus Slowed Heroes.

4.name: Alone in the Dark
4.description: Reduce the cooldown of Night Rush by 4 seconds.  Enemy Heroes put to Sleep by Night Rush have their vision greatly reduced during the Sleep and for 2 seconds after.

1.name: Sentinel Wisp
1.description: After remaining in a bush for 5 seconds, Wisp's vision radius is increased by 200% and reveals the surrounding area.

2.name: Natural Perspective
2.description: Nature's Toxin reveals enemies for its duration.

3.name: Hippity Hop
3.description: After not Basic Attacking or taking damage for 2 seconds, increase the Move Speed bonus of Dryad's Swiftness by 10%.

1.name: Blossom Swell
1.description: Increases Noxious Blossom's range by 25% and its radius by 20%.  Blossom Swell applies 2 stacks of Nature's Toxin to enemies hit.

2.name: Nature's Culling
2.description: Increases Nature's Toxin's damage by 125% to non-Heroes.

3.name: Siphoning Toxin
3.description: While at least one enemy is afflicted by Nature's Toxin, heal for 9 (+4% per level) per second.  When an enemy Hero has 3 stacks of Nature's Toxin, increase this healing by 19 (+4% per level) per second.

1.name: Splintered Spear
1.description: Using Noxious Blossom causes Lunara's next Basic Attack to hit up to 4 enemies. These extra attacks can apply Nature's Toxin.

2.name: Choking Pollen
2.description: Noxious Blossom deals 100% more damage to enemies afflicted by Nature's Toxin, increased to 175% against enemies with 3 stacks.

3.name: Wild Vigor
3.description: Using Crippling Spores increases the damage of Lunara's next 4 Basic Attacks by 70%.

1.name: Thornwood Vine
1.description: Send forth vines that deal 184 (+4% per level) damage to all enemies in a line.  Stores up to 3 charges.

2.name: Leaping Strike
2.description: Leap over an enemy, Slowing them by 80% for 0.35 seconds and dealing 271 (+4% per level) damage.  Stores up to 2 charges.

1.name: Endless Spores
1.description: Casting Crippling Spores while at least 2 Heroes are afflicted by Nature's Toxin reduces the cooldown by 4 seconds.

2.name: Let Them Wither
2.description: Increases Crippling Spores' Slow duration by 1 second and causes it to no longer decay.

3.name: Greater Spell Shield
3.description: Every 30 seconds, gain 75 Spell Armor against the next enemy Ability and subsequent Abilities for 3 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 75%.  Can be toggled to allow or prevent this talent from triggering automatically.

4.name: Abolish Magic
4.description: Target an ally to remove all damage over time and disabling effects from them and Lunara. For 2 seconds after, the duration of disabling effects is reduced by 50%.

1.name: Accelerated Contamination
1.description: Reduce the Mana cost of Noxious Blossom from 60 to 40.  While at least 1 enemy Hero is afflicted with Nature's Toxin, Noxious Blossom's cooldown recharges 75% faster.

2.name: Star Wood Spear
2.description: Increase Lunara's Basic Attack range by 0.5.  Using Crippling Spores increases Lunara's Basic Attack range by an additional 2.25 for 6 seconds.

3.name: Invigorating Spores
3.description: Crippling Spores grants 30% Attack Speed for 6 seconds.  Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes with 3 stacks of Nature's Toxin deal damage equal to 1.5% of their maximum Health.

4.name: Unfair Advantage
4.description: Nature's Toxin deals 60% more damage to Heroes that are Slowed, Rooted, or Stunned.

1.name: Forest's Wrath
1.description: Thornwood Vine now applies 2 stacks of Nature's Toxin.  Increase Thornwood Vine's range by 30% and Lunara's vision radius by 35%.

2.name: Boundless Stride
2.description: All Leaping Strike charges are returned every 15 seconds. Leaping Strike can be used on allies.

3.name: Intensifying Toxin
3.description: At 3 stacks, Nature's Toxin deals 40% more damage.

4.name: Galloping Gait
4.description: Activate to increase the Movement Speed bonus of Dryad's Swiftness to 80% for 6 seconds.

1.name: Warbreaker
1.description: Quest: Stun Heroes with Groundbreaker.  Reward: After Stunning 5 Heroes, Groundbreaker's Stun deals an additional 165 (+4% per level) damage over 3 seconds to Heroes.  Reward: After Stunning 15 Heroes, permanently reduce Groundbreaker's cooldown by 2 seconds.

2.name: Unrivaled Strength
2.description: Increase Wrecking Ball's throw range by 25% and its damage by 125%.

3.name: Body Check
3.description: Activate to deal 111 (+4% per level) damage to a target enemy and Slow them by 35% for 3 seconds. Enemy Heroes hit receive 30% reduced healing for 3 seconds.

1.name: In For the Kill
1.description: Increase Bloodthirst's damage against non-Heroes by 70%. Killing enemies with Bloodthirst resets its cooldown and refunds its Mana cost.

2.name: Thirst for Battle
2.description: Basic Attacks against Heroes reduce the cooldown of Bloodthirst by 2 seconds.

3.name: Indomitable
3.description: Activate to become Unstoppable for 1.5 seconds.

1.name: Intimidation
1.description: Groundbreaker reduces the Attack Speed of Heroes hit by 30% for 4 seconds.

2.name: Oppressor
2.description: Basic Attacks and Bloodthirst against Heroes reduce the target's Spell Power by 30% for 2.5 seconds.

3.name: Lok-tar ogar!
