1.name: Siphoning Arrows
1.description: Hitting a Hero with Hungering Arrow heals Valla for 4% of her maximum Health, and Multishot heals for 2%.

2.name: Tempered by Discipline
2.description: Basic Attacks heal for 10% of the damage dealt, increased by 2% per Hatred stack.

3.name: Gloom
3.description: Activate to consume all Hatred, granting 3 Spell Armor per Hatred consumed for 5 seconds.  Passive: Gain 15 Spell Armor, and each stack of Hatred heals for 1.2 (+4% per level) Health per second.

1.name: Punishment
1.description: While at max Hatred, Multishot's cooldown recharges 50% faster.

2.name: Seething Hatred
2.description: While at max Hatred, increase all damage dealt by 10%.

3.name: Manticore
3.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack against the same Hero deals an additional 5% of their maximum Health as damage.

1.name: Death Siphon
1.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Strafe increases its duration by 0.125 seconds. Strafe also fires penetrating bolts in a line for 34 (+4% per level) damage every 0.25 seconds.

2.name: Storm of Vengeance
2.description: Basic Attacks against Heroes reduce the cooldown of Rain of Vengeance by 5 seconds.  Passive: Each stack of Hatred increases your Attack Speed by 2%. While at max Hatred, gain an additional 30% Attack Speed.

3.name: Acrobat
3.description: Gain 2 additional charges of Vault. Drop 3 Caltrops while Vaulting that deal 60 (+4% per level) damage and Slow enemies by 40% for 1 second.

4.name: Farflight Quiver
4.description: Gain 20% Basic Attack range. While at max Hatred, gain an additional 30% Basic Attack range.

1.name: Might of the Banshee Queen
1.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Withering Fire increases Sylvanas's Attack Speed and Spell Power by 5% for 6 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.

2.name: Unfurling Shadows
2.description: Quest: Each time an enemy Hero with 3 stacks of Banshee's Curse is hit by Shadow Dagger, its damage is permanently increased by 0.5%.

3.name: Overwhelming Affliction
3.description: Enemy Heroes with 3 stacks of Banshee's Curse are Slowed by 15%. Sylvanas's Basic Attacks against Slowed enemy Heroes deal 1% of their maximum Health as damage.

1.name: Unstable Poison
1.description: Minions that die under the effects of Shadow Dagger or Sylvanas's Traits explode, dealing 130 (+4% per level) damage to nearby Minions, Mercenaries, and Summons.

2.name: Mercenary Queen
2.description: Friendly non-Elite Mercenaries near Sylvanas deal 60% more damage. Sylvanas Stuns and deals 30% additional damage to Mercenaries with 3 stacks of Banshee's Curse.

3.name: Possession
3.description: Activate to force an enemy Minion to fight for Sylvanas's team. Catapults require 3 charges. Stores up to 3 charges.

1.name: Barbed Shot
1.description: Hitting the same enemy with 5 shots of Withering Fire causes the 5th shot to deal 350% bonus damage.

2.name: Lost Soul
2.description: Increase Shadow Dagger's damage by 10%.  Basic Attacks against Heroes with 3 stacks of Banshee's Curse reduce the cooldown of Shadow Dagger by 1.75 seconds.

3.name: Festering Wounds
3.description: Increase Haunting Wave's damage by 15%. Haunting Wave applies 3 stacks of Banshee's Curse.

1.name: Wailing Arrow
1.description: Shoot an arrow that can be reactivated to deal 228 (+4% per level) damage and Silence enemies in an area for 2.5 seconds. The arrow detonates automatically if it reaches maximum range.

2.name: Mind Control
2.description: After 0.25 seconds, fire a missile that Mind Controls the first enemy Hero hit. Heroes hit are Silenced, Slowed by 30%, have 3 stacks of Banshee's Curse applied to them, and are forced to walk towards Sylvanas for 1.75 seconds.

1.name: Cold Embrace
1.description: Shadow Dagger reduces the Armor of the initial target by 25 and any enemy it spreads to by 10 for 2.5 seconds.

2.name: Windrunner
2.description: Haunting Wave can be cast a second time for free within 5 seconds after teleporting. Teleporting with Haunting Wave resets the cooldown of Withering Fire.

3.name: Remorseless
3.description: Increase Sylvanas's Basic Attack range by 1. Sylvanas's Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes with 3 stacks of Banshee's Curse shoot an untalented shot of Withering Fire. This shot of Withering Fire applies Banshee's Curse.

1.name: Evasive Fire
1.description: Hitting an enemy with Withering Fire grants 6% Movement Speed for 2 seconds, up to 30%. Basic Attacks refresh this duration.

2.name: Life Drain
2.description: Heal for 15% of damage dealt by Sylvanas to enemies with 3 stacks of Banshee's Curse. Healing is doubled against Heroes.

3.name: Will of the Forsaken
3.description: Activate to become Unstoppable and gain 40% Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

1.name: Deafening Blast
1.description: Enemies at the center of Wailing Arrow's explosion take 50% more damage and are Silenced for twice as long.

2.name: Dark Lady's Call
2.description: Heroes hit by Mind Control have their vision radius greatly reduced for 5 seconds. Mind Control's cooldown is reduced by 25 seconds.

3.name: Withering Barrage
3.description: Withering Fire applies Banshee's Curse, and Heroes hit by Withering Fire reduce its cooldown by 0.75 seconds.

4.name: Bolt of the Storm
4.description: Activate to teleport to a nearby location.

1.name: Caduceus Feedback
1.description: Increases Attack Range by 1.1 and Basic Attacks against Heroes generate 4 Energy.

2.name: Life Support
2.description: During the first 2 seconds of Energy regeneration, Healing Beam regenerates 100% more Energy.  Passive: Increase your maximum Energy by 10.

3.name: Clear!
3.description: Quest: Each enemy Hero hit with Displacement Grenade restores 3 Energy.  Reward: After hitting 15 Heroes, reduce the cooldown of Displacement Grenade from 12 seconds to 9 seconds.  Reward: After hitting 30 Heroes, increase the detonation area of Displacement Grenade by 25%.

1.name: Cellular Reactor
1.description: Consume 30 Energy to heal Lt. Morales for 30% of her maximum Health over 3 seconds. Caduceus Reactor is disabled while this is active.  Passive: Generate 2 Energy each time Safeguard reduces damage, up to a maximum of 10 Energy per use.

2.name: Trauma Trigger
2.description: Taking damage while below 40% Health grants 40 Armor for 3 seconds. This effect has a 30 second cooldown.  Passive: Increase the healing provided by Caduceus Reactor from 2% to 4% of Lt. Morales's maximum Health per second.

3.name: Blast Shield
3.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Displacement Grenade are Slowed by 50% for 1 second after being knocked away and grant Lt. Morales a Shield equal to 6% of her maximum Health. This shield stacks up to 5 times.

1.name: Physical Therapy
1.description: Safeguard removes all Slows from its target and its cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds.

2.name: Vanadium Plating
2.description: While an ally affected by Safeguard is Stunned or Rooted, Safeguard grants an additional 20 Armor.  Passive: Increase the duration of Safeguard by 1 second.

3.name: Medi-Drone
3.description: Allies with Safeguard receive 75% of the healing done by Healing Beam on another ally.

1.name: Stim Drone
1.description: Grant an allied Hero 75% Attack Speed and 25% Movement Speed for 10 seconds.

2.name: Medivac Dropships
2.description: Unlock the Medivac Dropship and Reinforcements abilities. These abilities share a cooldown.  Medivac Dropship Target a location for a Medivac transport. For up to 10 seconds before takeoff, allies can right-click to enter the Medivac.  Reinforcements Call down a Medivac Dropship at your Hall of Storms for your allies. After 10 seconds, or when the Ability is activated again, the Medivac will travel to the original cast location to unload its passengers.

1.name: EMP Grenade
1.description: Displacement Grenade deals an additional 96 (+4% per level) damage over 2 seconds, and up to 400 (+4% per level) bonus damage to Shields.

2.name: System Shock
2.description: Heroes hit by Displacement Grenade deal 30% less damage for 3 seconds.

3.name: Bedside Manner
3.description: Heroes hit by Displacement Grenade will take an additional 6% of maximum Health as damage from Lt. Morales's next Basic Attack against them.  Passive: Basic Attacks against Heroes deal an additional 1% of maximum Health as damage.

1.name: Extended Care
1.description: Channeling Healing Beam on a Hero for at least 3 seconds causes them to be healed for 258 (+4% per level) over 3 seconds when Healing Beam ends.  Passive: Increase the range of Healing Beam by 30%.

2.name: First Responder
2.description: While above 60 Energy, Healing Beam's healing is increased by 20% and both Lt. Morales and her Healing Beam target gain 15% Movement Speed.

3.name: Shield Sequencer
3.description: Safeguard gains a second charge and its range is increased by 60%.

1.name: Hyperactivity
1.description: Reduce the cooldown of Stim Drone from 70 seconds to 35 seconds, and increase the Movement Speed bonus from 25% to 50%.

2.name: Safe Zone
2.description: After exiting the Medivac, allies are Protected from all damage for 3 seconds.  Passive: Reduce the cooldown of Medivac Dropship abilities by 15 seconds.

3.name: Hospice Care
3.description: Safeguard grants its target Unkillable for 1 second. If the target is under 50% maximum Health when the Unkillable effect ends, they are healed for 8% of their maximum Health.

4.name: Second Opinion
4.description: Hitting 2 or more Heroes with Displacement Grenade reduces its cooldown to 2 seconds.

1.name: Target Practice
1.description: Quest: Hit every enemy Hero with Storm Bow.  Reward: After hitting every enemy Hero once with Storm Bow, its range is increased by 30%.  Reward: After hitting every enemy Hero 3 times with Storm Bow, its damage is increased by 100.

2.name: Simple Geometry
2.description: Quest: Hit a Hero with multiple arrows from the same Scatter Arrow cast 20 times. Each arrow hit after the second grants additional progress.  Reward: Upon hitting terrain for the first time, Scatter Arrow creates 2 additional arrows.

3.name: Redemption
3.description: Quest: Every 2 Basic Attacks against the same Hero within 10 seconds grants 1 Redemption, stacking up to 12. Dying decreases Redemption by 3, and Redemption can be lost even at maximum stacks.  Reward: At 12 Redemption, gain 50% Attack Speed.

1.name: Explosive Arrows
1.description: Upon hitting a Minion or Monster, Storm Bow deals 60% of its damage to enemies around its target.

2.name: Serrated Arrows
2.description: Scatter Arrow deals 100% more damage to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters.

3.name: Ignore All Distractions
3.description: Basic Attacks instantly kill Minions and increase Hanzo's Basic Attack range by 2 for 3 seconds.

1.name: The Dragon Hungers
1.description: Hitting a Hero with Storm Bow grants 5% Spell Power for 12 seconds, stacking up to 20%.

2.name: Never Outmatched
2.description: Reduce Scatter Arrow's Mana cost from 50 to 30. Basic Attacks against Heroes lower the cooldown of Scatter Arrow by 3 seconds.

3.name: Sharpened Arrowheads
3.description: Hitting a Hero with Storm Bow or Basic Attacks reduces their Armor by 3 for 3 seconds, up to a maximum reduction of 20 Armor.

1.name: Dragonstrike
1.description: After 1.5 seconds, summon a pair of Spirit Dragons which travel forward, dealing 84 (+4% per level) damage every 0.25 seconds to enemy Heroes in its area.  Enemies in the center take 75% increased damage.

2.name: Dragon's Arrow
2.description: Fire a missile that travels across the battleground. Explodes upon hitting an enemy Hero, dealing 130 (+4% per level) damage to all nearby enemies and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds.  After traveling a medium distance, the damage is increased to 260 (+4% per level) and the Stun duration to 1.25 seconds.  After traveling a long distance, the damage is increased to 390 (+4% per level) and the Stun duration to 2 seconds.

1.name: Fleet of Foot
1.description: Hitting a Hero with Storm Bow grants 10% Movement Speed for 6 seconds, up to 30%.

2.name: Ninja Assassin
2.description: Hitting Heroes with Storm Bow lowers Natural Agility's cooldown by 10 seconds. Additionally, Hero Takedowns reset Natural Agility's cooldown.

3.name: Mounted Archery
3.description: Reduce the cooldown of Summon Mount by 2 seconds.  Upon mounting, gain 25% additional Movement Speed for 5 seconds. Using Natural Agility instantly mounts.

1.name: Flawless Technique
1.description: Hitting Heroes with Storm Bow increases the damage of Hanzo's next Basic Attack within 5 seconds by 40%. Basic Attacks against Heroes increase the damage of Hanzo's next Storm Bow within 5 seconds by 40%.

2.name: Piercing Arrows
2.description: Storm Bow and Scatter Arrow pierce, hitting an additional enemy. Additionally, Scatter Arrow can pierce through 1 enemy each time it ricochets.

3.name: Giant Slayer
3.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Scatter Arrow and Basic Attacks take a bonus 2% of their maximum Health as damage.

1.name: The Dragon Awakens
1.description: Hitting a Hero with Storm Bow, Scatter Arrow, or Basic Attacks reduces the cooldown of Dragonstrike by 4 seconds.

2.name: Play of the Game
2.description: While in flight or for up to 2 seconds after impacting a target, Dragon's Arrow can be reactivated to teleport to its location and jump backwards. If used after impact, Hanzo shoots arrows that deal 132 (+4% per level) damage to each target hit by the impact.  Hanzo is Unstoppable during Play of the Game.

3.name: Bullseye
3.description: Increase Sonic Arrow's speed and center radius by 100%. Additionally, Heroes hit by Sonic Arrow's center are Stunned for 1 second.

4.name: Perfect Agility
4.description: Natural Agility gains a 2nd charge and its cooldown is reduced by 10 seconds.

1.name: Contact Healing
1.description: Hitting Heroes with Biotic Grenade increases its damage and healing by 30% per Hero hit.

2.name: Slumber Shells
2.description: Reduce the cooldown of Sleep Dart by 2 seconds. Upon waking, enemy Heroes are Slowed by 25% for 3 seconds.

3.name: Vampiric Rounds
3.description: Quest: Stack 5 Doses on an enemy Hero or Basic Attack a Hero with 5 Doses.  Reward: Stack 5 Doses to increase Shrike's healing by 1%.  Reward: Basic Attack a Hero with 5 Doses to increase Shrike's healing by 0.25%.

1.name: Biotic Enhancements
1.description: Increase the bonus healing duration of Biotic Grenade by 50% and reduce its cooldown by 3 seconds.

2.name: Overdose
2.description: Sleep Dart applies 4 Doses.  While Aim Down Sights is active, Sleep Dart pierces all enemy Heroes.

3.name: Debilitating Dart
3.description: Fire a dart which Slows the Movement Speed and reduces the damage dealt by the first enemy Hero it hits by 50% for 4 seconds. If no Heroes are hit, reduce this cooldown by 8 seconds.

1.name: Anti-Healer
1.description: Increase the area of Biotic Grenade by 25% and the duration of the healing reduction by 0.75 seconds.

2.name: Night Terrors
2.description: Gain 25% Movement Speed for 2 seconds for every Hero hit by Sleep Dart. Upon waking, enemy Heroes take 8% of their Maximum Health in damage.

3.name: Mind-Numbing Agent
3.description: Every Dose a Hero has reduces their Spell Power by 10%.

1.name: Nano Boost
1.description: Instantly boost an allied Hero, restoring 200 Mana. For the next 8 seconds, they gain 30% Spell Power and their Basic Ability cooldowns recharge 150% faster.  Cannot be used on Ana.

2.name: Eye of Horus
2.description: Assume a sniping position, gaining the ability to fire up to 6 specialized rounds with unlimited range. Rounds pierce allied and enemy Heroes but collide with enemy Structures in their path. Allies are healed for 225 (+4% per level) and enemies are damaged for 135 (+4% per level). Deals 50% less damage to Structures.  Ana is unable to move while Eye of Horus is active.

1.name: Speed Serum
1.description: Healing Dart grants 25% Movement Speed to affected Heroes for 2 seconds.

2.name: Purifying Darts
2.description: Healing Dart removes Roots and Slows from the target, and heals for 20% more when doing so.

3.name: Smelling Salts
3.description: Healing Dart removes Stuns from the target, and grants them 50 Armor for 2 seconds when doing so.

1.name: Sharpshooter
1.description: Healing Dart's healing is increased by 5% if it heals a Hero, up to 50%. At maximum bonus, further increase its healing by 35%. This bonus is reset if Healing Dart fails to hit a Hero.

2.name: Concentrated Doses
2.description: Increase Healing Dart's healing by 12% for each Dose active on enemy Heroes.

3.name: Active Reload
3.description: Activate to instantly gain 3 charges of Healing Dart.

1.name: Nano Infusion
1.description: Allies affected by Nano Boost heal for 50% of Spell Damage dealt.

2.name: Deadeye
2.description: Increase Eye Of Horus' healing and damage by 5% for every Hero hit. This bonus resets after all shots have been fired.

3.name: Armored Stance
3.description: Increase Shrike's damage by 50%. While Aim Down Sights is active, gain 25 Armor.

4.name: Dynamic Optics
4.description: Basic Attacks increase Attack Speed by 10% for 3 seconds, up to 100%. While Aim Down Sights is active, increase your Basic Attack Range by 4.

1.name: Advanced Targeting
1.description: Quest: Hitting enemy Heroes with Plasma Cutter permanently increases Fenix's Basic Attack damage by 0.5, up to 60.  Reward: After hitting 30 Heroes, Plasma Cutter circles an additional time.

2.name: Arsenal Synergy
2.description: After hitting enemy Heroes with Basic Attacks 3 times while Repeater Cannon is active, the next Basic Attack with Phase Bomb deals 150% more damage and splashes in a 50% larger area.

3.name: Mobile Offense
3.description: After moving, Fenix's next Basic Attack deals 35% more damage to Heroes.

1.name: Target Acquired
1.description: Basic Attacks against Slowed Heroes with Repeater Cannon active grant 10% Movement Speed for 4 seconds, up to 40%.

2.name: Inhibiting Energy
2.description: Every 10 seconds, Fenix's next Basic Attack with Phase Bomb active Slows all enemies hit by 60%, decaying in strength over 1.5 seconds.

3.name: Emergency Protocol
3.description: While Fenix has shields from Shield Capacitor, he gains 10% Movement Speed.  This bonus is increased to 15% when Fenix loses shields from Shield Capacitor.

1.name: Combat Advantage
1.description: Plasma Cutter deals 35% more damage to Slowed targets.

2.name: Warp Warfare
2.description: After arriving with Warp, gain 175% Attack Speed for 4 seconds while in Repeater Cannon mode. Hero Takedowns reset Warp's cooldown.

3.name: Divert Power: Weapons
3.description: Activate to gain 40% Basic Attack damage for 5 seconds. Basic Attacking a Hero refreshes this duration. Once Divert Power: Weapons ends, drain all of Shield Capacitor's Shields.

1.name: Purification Salvo
1.description: Channel for 1.5 seconds, sweeping a laser in front of Fenix that locks onto enemy Heroes. Once Channeling finishes, fire 5 missiles at each locked Hero, dealing 79 (+4% per level) damage each. Deals 50% increased damage to Slowed targets.

2.name: Planet Cracker
2.description: After 0.5 seconds, Channel a powerful beam that spans across the battleground for 4 seconds, dealing 112 (+4% per level) damage every 0.25 seconds to non-Structure enemies hit.

1.name: Adanium Shell
1.description: After arriving with Warp, gain 50 Armor for 4 seconds.

2.name: Dampening Field
2.description: Fenix gains 30 Spell Armor while he has a Shield from Shield Capacitor.

3.name: Rapid Recharge
3.description: The time before Shield Capacitor begins regenerating after taking damage is reduced by 2 seconds. Whenever Fenix is healed, Shield Capacitor's Shield recharges for 60% of the healing received.

4.name: Auxiliary Shields
4.description: Permanently reduce Fenix's maximum Health by 30% but increase Shield Capacitor's Shield by 40%. Basic Attacks regenerate Shields equal to 10% of the damage dealt.

1.name: Offensive Cadence
1.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack against Heroes while Repeater Cannon is active deals an additional 6% of the target's maximum Health as damage.

2.name: Photonic Weaponry
2.description: Fenix deals 20% more damage while he has a Shield from Shield Capacitor.

3.name: Arsenal Overcharge
3.description: Basic Attacks with Repeater Cannon reduce Ability cooldowns by 0.5 seconds. Basic Attacks with Phase Bomb active reduce Ability cooldowns by 0.5 seconds per Hero hit.

1.name: Armageddon Beam
1.description: Planet Cracker's width increases by 100% over 1.5 seconds.  Passive: Reduce Planet Cracker's cooldown by 40 seconds.

2.name: Secondary Fire
2.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Plasma Cutter fires a Purification Salvo missile at them after 0.5 seconds, dealing 79 (+4% per level) damage. Deals 50% increased damage to Slowed targets.

3.name: Singularity Charge
3.description: Repeater Cannon grants 100% more Attack Speed, and Phase Bomb grants 1.25 more range.

4.name: Unconquered Spirit
4.description: Upon taking fatal damage, Shield Capacitor regains 800 (+4% per level) Shields. This effect has a 120 second cooldown.

1.name: Siphoning Impact
1.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Ravage grants 100 (+4% per level) points of Assimilation Shields.

2.name: Assimilation Mastery
2.description: Regeneration Globe healing grants 50 (+4% per level) points of Assimilation Shields per second while active. While Assimilation is active, Kerrigan's Health and Mana regeneration is increased by 150%.

3.name: Fury of the Swarm
3.description: Gain 10% more Assimilation Shields from Basic Attacks. After casting Ravage, Kerrigan's next Basic Attack within 3 seconds splashes for 100% damage around the target.

1.name: Sharpened Blades
1.description: Quest: Minions and Heroes that die within 1.5 seconds of being hit by Ravage increase its damage up to a maximum of 75.  Minions grant 1 increased damage and Heroes grant 5 increased damage.  Reward: After reaching a 75 damage increase, Ravage gains 50 additional damage.

2.name: Kinetic Fulmination
2.description: Damaging an enemy increases the damage of Kerrigan's next Impaling Blades within 10 seconds by 10%, up to 100%.

3.name: Psionic Pulse
3.description: Primal Grasp explodes a second time 2 seconds after its first explosion.

1.name: Queen of Blades
1.description: Reduce the cooldown of Ravage by 3 seconds and increase its damage to Minions and Mercenaries by 100%.

2.name: Boundless Fury
2.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Ravage grants a charge of Ravage. Can only occur once every 10 seconds per Hero.

3.name: Bladed Momentum
3.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes reduce the cooldown of Kerrigan's Basic Abilities by 0.6 seconds.

1.name: Maelstrom
1.description: Deals 74 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. Lasts for 7 seconds.

2.name: Summon Ultralisk
2.description: After 0.5 seconds, summon an Ultralisk that rushes forward upon spawning, dealing 250 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy Hero hit and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds.  The Ultralisk's Basic Attacks deal 50% of their damage in an area around their target. Reactivate to retarget the Ultralisk.

1.name: Psionic Barrier
1.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Primal Grasp grants 20 Spell Armor and 4% Movement Speed for 4 seconds, stacking up to 20% Movement Speed.

2.name: Volatile Power
2.description: Increase the amount of Assimilation Shields granted from damage dealt by 10%, but reduce duration of Assimilation by 3 seconds.

3.name: Chrysalis
3.description: Activate to place Kerrigan in a Chrysalis with 750 (+4% per level) Health for 5 seconds. While inside, Kerrigan regenerates 5% of her maximum Health per second.  Enemies can destroy the Chrysalis to end its effects early.

1.name: Mounting Potency
1.description: Ravage grants 5% Spell Power for 5 seconds, up to 40%.

2.name: Painful Spikes
2.description: Enemies hit by Impaling Blades take an additional 70 (+4% per level) damage the next 6 times Kerrigan damages them within 5 seconds.

3.name: Unbridled Energy
3.description: Damaging a Hero with a Heroic Ability grants 35% Spell Power for 4 seconds.

1.name: Omegastorm
1.description: Maelstrom's duration is increased by 0.25 seconds every time it damages a Hero.

2.name: Torrasque
2.description: Increase the Health and Basic Attack damage of the Ultralisk by 20%.  The Ultralisk morphs into an egg when it dies. If the egg isn't killed within 4 seconds, a new Ultralisk is born.

3.name: Assimilation Blades
3.description: Damaging an enemy increases Basic Attack damage by 2% for 5 seconds, up to 40%.

4.name: Psionic Shift
4.description: Activate to teleport to a nearby location, dealing 50 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies. Generates 300% increased Assimilation Shields from the damage dealt.

1.name: Heavy Pack
1.description: Increases the duration of Snow Blind's Slow by 1.5 seconds. Each time Blizzard damages an enemy Hero, reduce the cooldown of Snow Blind by 0.5 seconds and gain 3 Mana.

2.name: Ice Storm
2.description: Every 3rd hit of Blizzard against enemy Heroes deals an additional 42 (+4% per level) damage. Blizzard's final Stun damage is increased by 150% against all enemies.

3.name: Heat Transfer
3.description: Basic Attacks against Stunned, Rooted, or Slowed Heroes deal 33% more damage. Each time Mei Stuns or Slows an enemy Hero she heals for 16 (+4% per level) Health.

1.name: Slushball
1.description: Snow Blind deals 75% increased damage and Structures hit are disabled for 3 seconds.

2.name: Cold Front
2.description: Reduce the cooldown of Icing by 3 seconds.  If Mei enters her own Blizzard while Icing is active, the cooldown of Icing is reduced by 5 seconds and she gains 80 Mana.

3.name: Crystallize
3.description: Reduce the cooldown of Cryo-Freeze by 10 seconds. Mei gains 40 Spell Armor while Cryo-Freeze is active and for 1 second after.

1.name: Induce Hibernation
1.description: Blizzard reduces the damage dealt by enemy Heroes inside of its area by 40%.  When Blizzard ends, enemy Heroes still within its area gain this effect for an additional 4 seconds.

2.name: Skating Away
2.description: When Icing ends, Mei and all nearby allied Heroes gain 20% Movement Speed and 50 Physical Armor for 3 seconds.

3.name: Backup Battery
3.description: Activate to remove all Roots and Slows and regenerate 20% of maximum Health over 2 seconds. The cooldown of this ability is reduced by 10 seconds each time Mei picks up a Regeneration Globe.

1.name: Avalanche
1.description: After 0.5 seconds, roll a massive snowball that consumes enemy Heroes in its path. At the end of its path, the snowball crumbles, releasing the consumed Heroes, dealing 220 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds per Hero consumed.

2.name: Ice Wall
2.description: Vector Targeting After a 0.75 second delay, create an impassable wall that traps enemy Heroes hit for 2.5 seconds. When the wall expires, trapped Heroes are Slowed by 75%, decaying over 3 seconds.

1.name: Flurry
1.description: While in her own Blizzard, Mei gains 50% increased Attack Speed and Blizzard's cooldown refreshes 125% faster. If Mei is in her own Blizzard when it ends, gain these bonuses for 3 additional seconds.

2.name: Cooling Servos
2.description: While Cryo-Freeze is active, Mei's Basic Ability cooldowns recover 200% faster.  Passive: Basic Attacks Slow by 20% for 1.5 seconds.

3.name: Polar Vortex
3.description: Using an ability causes Mei to deal 24 (+4% per level) damage a second to nearby enemies for 4 seconds. Enemy Heroes damaged by this effect also have their Movement Speed and Attack Speed Slowed by 20%.

1.name: Fresh Powder
1.description: Snow Blind gains an additional charge and its range is increased by 33%.

2.name: Black Ice
2.description: Icing's Slow effect no longer decays over its duration. Icing deals 300% more damage to enemies very close to Mei.

3.name: Acclimation
3.description: Each time Mei Stuns or Slows an enemy Hero, the damage she deals and healing she receives is increased by 1%, stacking up to 20 times. While at maximum stacks, Mei also gains 10 Armor. Lasts 8 seconds.

1.name: Cascade
1.description: While traveling, Avalanche constantly launches a volley of untalented Snow Blind snowballs ahead of itself.  Passive: Reduce the cooldown of Avalanche by 30 seconds.

2.name: Shatter
2.description: When Ice Wall expires, trapped enemy Heroes hit take 210 (+4% per level) damage and have their Armor reduced by 25 for 5 seconds.

3.name: The Big One
3.description: Every 15 seconds, the next Snow Blind you cast has 67% increased area and 200% increased damage.

4.name: Flash Freeze
4.description: When Mei takes fatal damage she instantly gains Cryo-Freeze. This effect has a 180 second cooldown.

1.name: Eye of the Tiger
1.description: Basic Attacks against Brew-soaked enemy Heroes deal 40% more damage and heal Chen for 40% of the damage done.

2.name: Freshest Ingredients
2.description: Increase the healing duration of Regeneration Globes by 150%.  Quest: Gather 15 Regeneration Globes.  Reward: Reduce Fortifying Brew's cooldown by 2 seconds, and 50% of its Shield persists indefinitely after drinking.

3.name: Stormstout Secret Recipe
3.description: Chen heals for 3.5% of his maximum Health when his Basic Abilities hit an enemy Hero.

1.name: Deadly Strike
1.description: Flying Kick no longer costs Brew. Additionally, its damage is increased by 125% while Chen has Shields from Fortifying Brew.

2.name: Accumulating Flame
2.description: Increase Ignited damage by 20%.  Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes who are Ignited increase its duration by 0.75 seconds.

3.name: Withering Flames
3.description: Igniting an enemy Hero reduces their Spell Power by 60% for 4 seconds.

1.name: Gift of the Ox
1.description: Increase the duration of Stagger's damage prevention by 1.5 seconds, and reduce the amount of damage taken over time to 50% of damage taken.

2.name: Brewmaster's Balance
2.description: While at or below 50 Brew, gain 20% Movement Speed. While at or above 50 Brew, regenerate an additional 18 (+4% per level) Health per second.

3.name: Elusive Brawler
3.description: Activate to gain 30% Movement Speed and Evade enemy Basic Attacks for 2 seconds. Chen's Basic Attacks reduce this cooldown by 2 seconds.

1.name: Wandering Keg
1.description: Roll around inside an Unstoppable barrel with 70% increased Movement Speed and 25 Armor, dealing 59 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in the way and knocking them back. Lasts for 5 seconds.

2.name: Storm, Earth, Fire
2.description: After 1 second, Chen splits into three elemental spirits for 12 seconds, each with 70% of Chen's maximum Health and a unique Ability.  The last spirit Ability that is cast is empowered. If all three spirits are killed, Chen will die as well.  Storm can grant the spirits a Shield.  Earth can leap to an area and Slow enemies.  Fire can grant the spirits Attack Speed, damage.

1.name: Pressure Point
1.description: Flying Kick Slows the target enemy by 40% for 1 second, or by 80% if Chen has Shields from Fortifying Brew.

2.name: A Touch of Honey
2.description: Increase the Slows from Keg Smash by 20% and its duration by 0.5 seconds.

3.name: Ring of Fire
3.description: After Igniting an enemy, become bathed in a fiery aura, dealing 55 (+4% per level) damage every second to nearby enemies for 5 seconds.

4.name: Enough to Share
4.description: Fortifying Brew instantly grants Chen a Shield that absorbs 180 (+4% per level) damage, and each second grants nearby allied Heroes a Shield that absorbs 140 (+4% per level) damage, up to 420 (+4% per level).

1.name: Flying Leap
1.description: Increase Flying Kick's range by 15% and reduce its cooldown by 0.5 seconds each time an enemy Hero takes damage from being Ignited.

2.name: Celerity
2.description: Basic Attacks against Stunned, Rooted, or Slowed enemy Heroes reduce the cooldown of Stagger by 2 seconds and grant Chen 30 Armor for 3 seconds.

3.name: Combo Strikes
3.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack against the same target deals 75% bonus damage.  While Chen has Shields from Fortifying Brew and for 2 seconds after, he gains 35% Attack Speed.

1.name: Untapped Potential
1.description: Increase Wandering Keg's Movement Speed bonus from 70% to 125%, and its Armor bonus to 75 for its duration and 3 seconds afterwards.

2.name: Elemental Conduit
2.description: Increase the spirits' Health to 100% of Chen's maximum Health and all of their Abilities are empowered.

3.name: Purifying Brew
3.description: Casting Fortifying Brew grants Chen Unstoppable for 1.5 seconds.

4.name: Energizing Brew
4.description: If Chen Channels Fortifying Brew for its full duration, then he gains 20% bonus Health and 20% bonus damage for 25 seconds.

1.name: Winter's Reach
1.description: Increase the range and travel speed of Frostbolt by 30%.

2.name: Lingering Chill
2.description: Increase the duration of Chill from 4 seconds to 6 seconds.

3.name: Fingers of Frost
3.description: Quest: Gather Regeneration Globes to increase Jaina's Mana regeneration by 0.1 per second, up to 2 per second.  Reward: After gathering 20 Globes, the damage bonus from Frostbite is increased by 10%.

1.name: Frost Shards
1.description: Frostbolt will now pierce the first two targets.

2.name: Arcane Intellect
2.description: Dealing damage to a Chilled target returns Mana to Jaina. Basic Attacks return 5 Mana and Abilities return 20.  Passive: While above 75% Mana, Jaina gains 10% Spell Power.

3.name: Frost Armor
3.description: Enemies that attack Jaina are Chilled. Additionally, every 10 seconds, Jaina gains 75 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing the damage taken by 75%.

1.name: Ice Lance
1.description: Hitting a Chilled target with Frostbolt reduces its cooldown by 1.5 seconds and restores 10 Mana.

2.name: Ice Floes
2.description: Increase the width of Cone of Cold by 100% and cause each Hero hit to reduce its cooldown by 2 seconds, doubled against chilled Heroes, up to a maximum of 8 seconds per use.

3.name: Icefury Wand
3.description: Basic Attacks against Chilled enemies deal 50% more damage and lower the cooldown of Blizzard by 1.25 seconds.  Doubled against enemy Heroes.

1.name: Ring of Frost
1.description: After a 1.5 second delay, create a Ring of Frost in an area that deals 310 (+4% per level) damage and Roots enemies for 3 seconds. The ring persists for 3 seconds afterward, Chilling any enemies who touch it.

2.name: Summon Water Elemental
2.description: Summon a Water Elemental at target location. The Water Elemental's Basic Attacks deal 62 (+4% per level) damage, splash for 25% damage and Chill. The Ability can be reactivated to retarget the Water Elemental.  Lasts 20 seconds.

1.name: Storm Front
1.description: Increase the cast range of Blizzard by 75% and its radius by 30%.

2.name: Ice Barrier
2.description: Gain a Shield for 25% of Ability damage dealt to Chilled targets. The shield lasts 4 seconds.

3.name: Icy Veins
3.description: Activate to make Jaina's Basic Abilities' cooldowns recharge 200% faster and reduce their Mana cost by 50% for 5 seconds.

1.name: Snowstorm
1.description: The damage of the second wave of Blizzard is increased by 50%. The damage of the third wave is increased by 100%.

2.name: Northern Exposure
2.description: Enemies damaged by Cone of Cold have their Armor lowered by 25 for 2 seconds, increasing their damage taken by 25%.

3.name: Numbing Blast
3.description: Cone of Cold Roots Chilled targets for 1 second.

1.name: Cold Snap
1.description: The center area of Ring of Frost deals 310 (+4% per level) damage and Roots enemies after the outer ring expires. Each enemy Hero hit reduces its cooldown by 15 seconds.

2.name: Wintermute
2.description: Increases the cast range of Water Elemental by 50%, and the Water Elemental will now mimic Jaina's Basic Abilities for 50% damage.

3.name: Ice Blink
3.description: Activate to teleport a short distance and Chill all nearby enemies.

4.name: Deep Chill
4.description: Frostbite's Chill can now stack a second time, slowing targets up to 40%.

1.name: Echo Pulse
1.description: Disruption Pulse now returns to Probius 1.25 seconds after reaching its target, dealing 100% damage on the return trip.

2.name: Warp Resonance
2.description: Quest: Hit Heroes with Warp Rift explosions.  Reward: After hitting 8 Heroes with Warp Rift explosions, increase the explosion damage by 120.  Reward: After hitting 16 Heroes with Warp Rift explosions, Warp Rift gains 1 additional charge.

3.name: Gather Minerals
3.description: Quest: Gather Minerals to increase the Health of Photon Cannons by 8, up to 560.  Reward: After collecting 70 Minerals, Photon Cannons deal 35% more damage.

1.name: Photon Barrier
1.description: While a Photon Cannon is alive and powered, Probius gains 40 Spell Armor.

2.name: Turbo Charged
2.description: Worker Rush grants an additional 10% passive Movement Speed while in a Power Field, and its cooldown is reduced by 14 seconds.

3.name: Shield Capacitor
3.description: Probius gains permanent Shields equal to 10% of his max Health. Shields regenerate quickly as long as he hasn't taken damage recently.

1.name: Particle Accelerator
1.description: After hitting 3 Heroes with Disruption Pulse, the next Warp Rift detonated by a Disruption Pulse fires 4 additional pulses that deal 78 (+5% per level) damage from the impact location in different directions.  Passive: Reduce the cooldown of Disruption Pulse by 0.5 seconds.

2.name: Rift Shock
2.description: Hitting a Warp Rift with Disruption Pulse within 1 second of it arming deals 105 (+5% per level) damage over 3 seconds.

3.name: Tower Defense
3.description: Reduce Photon Cannon's cooldown by 3.5 seconds when Disruption Pulse or Warp Rift damages an enemy Hero.

1.name: Pylon Overcharge
1.description: For 8 seconds, increase the size of Pylon power fields and allow them to attack enemy Heroes within it for 96 (+4% per level) damage per second. Pylons are Invulnerable for the duration.

2.name: Null Gate
2.description: Vector Targeting Project a barrier of negative energy in the target direction that lasts 4 seconds. Enemies who touch the barrier take 76 (+4% per level) damage per second and are Slowed by 80% for as long as they remain in contact with it.

1.name: Aggressive Matrix
1.description: Pylon's Power Field grants allied Heroes 35% increased Attack Damage.

2.name: Power Overflowing
2.description: Pylon's Power Field grants allied Heroes 10% increased Spell Power and 2 Mana per second.

3.name: Shield Battery
3.description: Pylon's Power Field grants allied Heroes 28 (+4% per level) Shields per second, up to 112 (+4% per level). Shields persist for 2 seconds after exiting a Pylon Power Field.

1.name: Quantum Entanglement
1.description: Enemies continue to be slowed for 3 seconds after their last contact with a Warp Rift.

2.name: Gravity Well
2.description: Enemies are slowed more the closer they are to the center of the Warp Rift, up to a maximum slow of 60%.

3.name: Interference
3.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Warp Rift explosions have their Spell Power reduced by 35% for 5 seconds.  Additionally, enemies hit by Warp Rift explosions are knocked away from the center.

1.name: Construct Additional Pylons
1.description: Probius can now have up to 3 active Pylons, and increase the damage of Pylon Overcharge by 25%.

2.name: Gate Keeper
2.description: Null Gate lasts indefinitely if either end is within a Power Field.

3.name: Shoot 'Em Up
3.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Disruption Pulse take a  bonus 2.5% of their maximum Health as damage.  Passive: Reduce the cooldown of Disruption Pulse by 0.5 seconds.

4.name: Probius Loop
4.description: Whenever a Rift explosion hits 1 or more enemy Heroes, create a new Warp Rift in the same location.

1.name: Death's Reach
1.description: Increase Wraith Strike's range by 35%.

2.name: On a Pale Horse
2.description: Gain an additional 20% Movement Speed while mounted.

3.name: Fear the Reaper
3.description: Activate to increase Movement Speed by 25% and pass through other units for 4 seconds.

1.name: Die Alone
1.description: Soul Rip deals 50% more damage to Heroes if it hits only one Hero.

2.name: Throwing Shade
2.description: Increase Death Shroud's range by 33%, reduce its cooldown by 3 seconds, and reduce its Mana cost from 50 to 30.  Death Shroud's initial impact deals 2% maximum Health as damage to non-Structure enemies.

3.name: Black Harvest
3.description: Quest: Apply Reaper's Mark to Heroes for a total of 180 seconds.  Reward: Permanently increase Reaper's Mark's duration by 2 seconds.

1.name: Cold Hand
1.description: Soul Rip Slows enemies by 20% for 2.5 seconds.

2.name: Massacre
2.description: Wraith Strike now damages and applies Reaper's Mark to enemies around its target.

3.name: Touch of Death
3.description: Activate to reduce healing received by Heroes afflicted by Reaper's Mark by 50% for 4 seconds.

1.name: Tormented Souls
1.description: Unleash a torrent of souls, continually applying Reaper's Mark to nearby enemies for 4 seconds.  When Tormented Souls is cast and when it expires, reset the cooldown of Wraith Strike.

2.name: Last Rites
2.description: Apply a death sentence to an enemy Hero that, after 2 seconds, deals damage equal to 50% of their missing Health.  Quest: Enemies killed between the application of Last Rites and within 1.5 seconds of it dealing damage permanently reduce its cooldown by 5 seconds, to a minimum of 20 seconds.

1.name: Soul Siphon
1.description: Increase Soul Rip's bonus healing from Heroes to 4.75% of the Hero's maximum Health.

2.name: Ethereal Existence
2.description: Gain 10 Physical Armor per enemy Hero afflicted by Reaper's Mark, up to a maximum of 30.

3.name: Inevitable End
3.description: Activate to become Unstoppable for 2 seconds, but remove all active Reaper's Marks.

4.name: Shroud of Wisdom
4.description: After 2 seconds, gain 50 Spell Armor for 4 seconds.

1.name: Soul Collector
1.description: Reduce Soul Rip's cooldown by 0.5 seconds and increase its range by 25%.

2.name: Mortality
2.description: When damaging a Hero, Wraith Strike deals bonus damage equal to 8% of the Hero's maximum Health.

3.name: Memento Mori
3.description: Reaper's Mark deals 60% increased damage after afflicting an enemy for more than 4 seconds.

1.name: Reaper of Souls
1.description: Increase Tormented Souls' duration by 2 seconds.  While Tormented Souls is active, Hero Takedowns refresh the duration.

2.name: Angel of Death
2.description: Last Rites heals for 100% of the damage dealt, and its current and future cooldown reduction bonuses are doubled.

3.name: Final Curtain
3.description: Death Shroud leaves a trail in its wake for 4 seconds, applying Reaper's Mark to enemies in its area.

4.name: No One Can Stop Death
4.description: Activate while dead to immediately respawn at the Hall of Storms but increase Malthael's next respawn time by 25%.

1.name: Ambush
1.description: Gain Stealth when entering Siege Mode or after not taking or dealing damage for 3 seconds while in Siege Mode. Basic Attacks while Stealthed deal 125% more damage.  Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible.

2.name: Advanced Artillery
2.description: Increase Siege Mode's splash damage to 60% of Basic Attack damage, and increase its splash radius by 25%.

3.name: Maelstrom Rounds
3.description: Activate to increase Basic Attack damage dealt by 30% for 5 seconds. Hitting enemy Heroes or Structures with Basic Attacks while in Siege Mode reduces the cooldown of Maelstrom Rounds by 5 seconds.  Stores up to 3 charges.

1.name: Barricade
1.description: Reduce Concussive Blast's cooldown by 4 seconds, its Mana cost by 40, and when cast create an impassable wall in front of Sgt. Hammer for 4 seconds.

2.name: Siege Tactics
2.description: Using Neosteel Plating while in Siege Mode grants Unstoppable for 2 seconds, as long as she remains in Siege Mode.

3.name: Regenerative Bio-Steel
3.description: Basic Attacks while in Siege Mode heal for 10% of the damage dealt.

1.name: Pulse Detonation Core
1.description: Spider Mines detonate 3 times over 3 seconds.  Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes grant 5 Mana and reduce the cooldown of Spider Mines by 1.5 seconds.  Increase this bonus to 2.5 seconds while in Siege Mode.

2.name: Hover Siege Mode
2.description: Sgt. Hammer can move at 50% Movement Speed while in Siege Mode.

3.name: Graduating Range
3.description: While in Siege Mode, Basic Attack range is increased by 1 every 1.5 seconds, up to 3.

1.name: Blunt Force Gun
1.description: Fire a missile across the battlefield, dealing 500 (+3% per level) damage to non-Structure enemies in its path.

2.name: Napalm Strike
2.description: Deals 164 (+4% per level) damage on impact, and leaves a napalm area that deals 50 (+4% per level) damage per second. Lasts for 4 seconds.

1.name: Tactical Mine Deployment
1.description: Moving while Thrusters is active leaves a trail of up to 5 Spider Mines. Additionally, increase the Slow of Spider Mines by 15%.

2.name: Entrenched
2.description: While in Siege Mode, Concussive Blasts's damage and knockback distance are increased by 75%.

3.name: Hyper-Cooling Engines
3.description: While in Siege Mode, hitting Heroes with Basic Attacks reduces the cooldown of Thrusters by 5 seconds.

1.name: Mechanical Know-how
1.description: Neosteel Plating grants 20% maximum Health as a Shield for 2 seconds and increases Basic Attack damage by 30% for 5 seconds.

2.name: Executioner
2.description: Attacking a Hero that is slowed, rooted, or stunned increases your Basic Attack damage by 30% for 3 seconds.

3.name: Giant Killer
3.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes deal bonus damage equal to 1.5% of the Hero's maximum Health.

1.name: Orbital BFG
1.description: Blunt Force Gun's missile orbits the planet every 5 seconds. Only the last missile fired orbits.

2.name: Advanced Lava Strike
2.description: Napalm Strike's range is increased by 75% and its impact does 50% more damage.

3.name: Shrapnel Mines
3.description: Upon detonating, Spider Mines reduce the Armor of enemy Heroes hit by 10, up to 50, for 4 seconds.

4.name: Ultra Capacitors
4.description: Hitting enemy Heroes with Basic Attacks while in Siege Mode grants 10% Attack Speed for 5 seconds, up to 60%.

1.name: Adrenaline Stimpack
1.description: Passive: While over 80% Health, gain 25% bonus Attack Speed and 10% bonus Movement Speed.  Activate to gain 100% Attack Speed and 25% Movement Speed for 5 seconds.

2.name: Endurance Stimpack
2.description: Activate to gain a Shield that absorbs 590 (+4% per level) damage over 5 seconds.  When taking damage while below 30% maximum Health, Endurance Stimpack will automatically be cast if it is not on cooldown.

3.name: Neural Stimpack
3.description: Activate to gain 40 Mana and cause Basic Ability cooldowns to recharge 100% faster for 5 seconds.

4.name: New Habits
4.description: Collecting Regeneration Globes reduces the cooldown of Pyromania by 6 seconds.  Quest: Collect 15 Regeneration Globes.  Reward: Pyromania grants Unstoppable for 2 seconds.

1.name: Oil Dispersal

2.name: Meltdown
2.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Pyromania reduces their damage dealt by 8% for 2.5 seconds, up to 40%.

3.name: Incinerator Gauntlets
3.description: Increase Basic Attack area by 15%, and Basic Attack damage to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters by 50%.

1.name: Suppressive Fire
1.description: Each stream of Flame Stream reduces the Spell Power of Heroes hit by 25% for 4 seconds, up to 50%.

2.name: Nanomachine Coating
2.description: Enemies standing in Oil Spills and Ignited Oil Spills have their Attack Speed reduced by 50% for 3 seconds.

3.name: Fuel Leak
3.description: Jet Propulsion creates Oil Spills along Blaze's path. If Jet Propulsion impacts an enemy Hero, an additional Oil Spill is created underneath them.

1.name: Bunker Drop
1.description: After 0.5 seconds, deploy and enter a Bunker with 1435 (+4% per level) Health. Blaze and his allies can enter and exit the Bunker at will. While in the Bunker, occupants gain access to Flamethrower, dealing 170 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in a line.  Exiting the Bunker grants 25 Armor for 2 seconds. Bunkers last 10 seconds, or until destroyed.

2.name: Combustion
2.description: Channel for up to 2.6 seconds. Upon ending, Slow nearby enemies by 60% and deal 55 (+4% per level) damage to them every 0.5 seconds. Combustion's Slow and damage over time duration is extended the longer Blaze Channels, from 1 second up to 5 seconds.  Blaze's Movement Speed is reduced by 40% while Channeling.

1.name: Grill and Kill
1.description: Increase Ignited Oil Spill damage by 45%.  Quest: Damage enemy Heroes with Ignited Oil Spills 30 times.  Reward: Increase Oil Spill's Ignite duration by 2.5 seconds.

2.name: Adhesive Petroleum
2.description: Enemies standing in Oil Spill when it is Ignited are Slowed by 40% and take 35% more Basic Attack damage from Blaze for 3 seconds. Additionally, Basic Attack splashes Ignite Oil Spills.

3.name: Collision Course
3.description: Jet Propulsion's collision deals 275 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy Hero hit.

1.description: Each enemy hit by Jet Propulsion grants 10 Armor for 3 seconds and reduces its cooldown by 1.25 seconds.

2.name: Heat Treatment
2.description: Heal for 75% of the damage dealt by Pyromania.

3.name: Juggernaut Plating
3.description: Activate to gain 50 Spell Armor for 3 seconds. Upon expiration, gain a Shield equal to 125% of the Spell Damage taken while Juggernaut Plating was active.

1.name: Fortified Bunker
1.description: Occupants can cast Oil Spill from Bunker Drop every 6 seconds. Additionally, Bunker Drop's Armor bonus upon exiting is increased by 25, and its duration by 1 second.

2.name: Flash Fire
2.description: While Channeling Combustion, Blaze's Movement Speed is no longer reduced, and nearby enemies are Slowed by 60%.

3.name: Burn Notice
3.description: Basic Attacks Slow enemies by 5% and deal an additional 18 (+4% per level) damage over 2.5 seconds. Stacks up to 5 times.

1.name: Perfect Storm
1.description: Quest: Every time Muradin hits an enemy Hero with a Basic Attack, increase Storm Bolt's damage by 0.75. If an enemy Hero is killed within 3 seconds of being hit by a Storm Bolt increase its damage by an additional 10.

2.name: Dwarf Block
2.description: Casting Dwarf Toss grants 4 charges of Block. Each Block charge grants 75 Physical Armor against a single enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing the damage taken by 75%.

3.name: Third Wind
3.description: Increases Health Restoration rate to 90 (+4% per level) per second, and raises Health threshold to 60% Health for improved 180 (+4% per level) per second Restoration.

1.name: Sledgehammer
1.description: Stormbolt deals 350% damage to non-Heroic enemies. Increase Storm Bolt's cooldown reduction from 1 second to 1.25 seconds per Basic Attack.

2.name: Reverberation

3.name: Thunder Burn
3.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Thunder Clap triggers a second explosion 2 seconds later in the same location that deals 75% damage.

1.name: Heavy Impact
1.description: Enemies hit by Dwarf Toss are Slowed by 80% for 1.5 seconds.

2.name: Give 'em the Axe!
2.description: Attacking a Hero that is Stunned, Rooted, or Slowed increases Muradin's Basic Attack damage by 50% for 3 seconds.

3.name: Skullcracker
3.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack against the same enemy deals 90% bonus damage and Stuns them for 0.25 seconds.

1.name: Avatar
1.description: Transform for 20 seconds, gaining 1000 (+4% per level) Health.

2.name: Haymaker
2.description: Stun target enemy Hero, and wind up a punch dealing 319 (+4% per level) damage and knocking the target back, hitting enemies in the way for 319 (+4% per level) damage and knocking them aside.

2.name: Healing Static
2.description: Muradin heals for 5% of his maximum Health for each Hero hit by Thunder Clap.

3.name: Thunder Strike
3.description: Thunder Clap deals 300% damage if only one target is hit.  Passive: Increase the duration of Dwarf Toss's Armor by 2 seconds.

1.description: Increase the range of Dwarf Toss by 40%. Hitting an enemy Hero with Dwarf Toss reduces its cooldown by 2 seconds.

2.name: Imposing Presence
2.description: Activate to reduce the Attack Speed by 50% and Movement Speed by 20% of nearby Heroes and Summons for 2.5 seconds.  Passive: Heroes and Summons that attack your Hero have their Attack Speed Slowed by 20% for 2.5 seconds.

3.name: Stoneform
3.description: Activate to heal Muradin for 30% of his maximum Health over 10 seconds. Second Wind is disabled during this time.

1.name: Unstoppable Force
1.description: While active, Avatar grants 20 Armor and causes Muradin's Basic Attacks to reduce the cooldowns of Thunder Clap and Dwarf Toss by 0.75 seconds.

2.name: Grand Slam
2.description: Haymaker gains a 2nd charge and its damage is increased by 25%. If a Hero dies within 3 seconds of being hit by Haymaker, instantly gain 1 charge.

3.name: Hardened Shield
3.description: Activate to gain 75 Armor for 4 seconds, taking 75% less damage.

4.name: Rewind
4.description: Activate to reset the cooldowns of your Basic Abilities.

1.name: Once Again the First Time
1.description: Quest: Hit 40 Heroes with Sand Blast from Chromie or her Echoes.  Reward: Increase the maximum number of active Echoes to 2, and increase Echo damage to 45%.

2.name: Deep Breathing
2.description: Quest: Every time Dragon's Breath hits a Hero increase its damage by 1%, up to 20%.  Reward: After hitting 20 Heroes, reduce the cooldown of Dragon's Breath by 4 seconds and its Mana cost from 65 to 40.

3.name: Timewalker's Pursuit
3.description: Gain 10% Spell Power and reduce the arming time of Time Traps by 0.75 seconds. Activate to reveal the targeted area for 4 seconds. Enemies seen are revealed for 4 seconds.

1.description: After its Time Stop ends, enemies affected by Time Trap are Slowed by 30% for 3 seconds and allies gain 30% Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

2.name: Time Troubles
2.description: After its Time Stop ends, enemies affected by Time Trap lose 15 Armor for 3 seconds and allies gain 30 Armor for 3 seconds.

3.name: Andorhal Anomaly
3.description: Increase the charges and maximum active Time Traps to 3, and reduce its cooldown by 8 seconds.

1.name: Gnome Speed Ahead!
1.description: After casting Sand Blast, Chromie gains 20% Movement Speed and 200% increased Health Regeneration for 3 seconds.

2.name: Here and There
2.description: Activate to teleport to an area near an Echo, swapping it with Chromie's previous location.

3.name: Time Out
3.description: Activate to place Chromie in Stasis and gain Invulnerability for up to 5 seconds. Can be reactivated to end the effect early.

3.name: Piercing Sands
3.description: Sand Blasts cast from Chromie and her Echoes now pierce all enemies hit.

4.description: Activate to cause Chromie and all allied Heroes to gain 20% Movement Speed and their Basic Abilities recharge 35% faster for 8 seconds.  Hitting an enemy Hero with Sand Blast from Chromie or her Echoes reduces the cooldown of Blessing of the Bronze by 1 second.
