2.description: Increases Kael'thas's Spell Power by 4%. Kael'thas heals for 94 (+4% per level) Health when activating Verdant Spheres.

3.name: Mana Addict
3.description: Quest: Gathering a Regeneration Globe increases Kael'thas's maximum Mana by 15.  Reward: After gathering 20 Globes, Kael'thas can activate Arcane Barrier to gain a Shield equal to 100% of his maximum Mana for 4 seconds. 45 second cooldown.

1.name: Nether Wind
1.description: Increases Gravity Lapse's range by 30%. When Gravity Lapse hits an enemy Hero, refund 80 Mana.

2.name: Energy Roil
2.description: Reduce the Mana cost of Gravity Lapse by 70.  If Gravity Lapse hits a Hero, reduce its cooldown by 8 seconds.

3.name: Mana Tap
3.description: Activating Verdant Spheres restores 5% of Kael'thas's maximum Mana.

1.name: Burned Flesh
1.description: When Flamestrike damages 2 or more Heroes, they take additional damage equal to 8% of their maximum Health.

2.name: Sun King's Fury
2.description: Living Bombs that spread to enemy Heroes deal 35% more damage.

3.name: Sunfire Enchantment
3.description: Activating Verdant Spheres causes Kael'thas's next 2 Basic Attacks to instead deal 115 (+4% per level) Spell Damage.  If both of these Attacks hit enemy Heroes, gain 15% Spell Power for 10 seconds.

1.name: Phoenix
1.description: Launch a Phoenix to an area, dealing 84 (+4% per level) damage to enemies along the way. The Phoenix persists for 7 seconds, attacking enemies for 84 (+4% per level) damage and splashing for 42 (+4% per level) damage.

2.name: Pyroblast
2.description: After 1.5 seconds, cast a slow-moving fireball that deals 810 (+5% per level) damage to an enemy Hero and 405 (+5% per level) damage to enemies nearby.

1.name: Pyromaniac
1.description: Each time Living Bomb deals periodic damage, Kael'thas's Basic Ability cooldowns are reduced by 0.5 seconds.

2.name: Backdraft
2.description: Living Bomb's explosion slows enemy Movement Speed by 30% for 2 seconds.

3.name: Fission Bomb
3.description: Increases Living Bomb's explosion radius by 20%.

1.name: Fury of the Sunwell
1.description: Flamestrike will explode a second time 1.5 seconds later.

2.name: Ignite
2.description: Flamestrikes apply Living Bomb to the enemy Hero closest to its center who is not currently affected by Living Bomb.

3.name: Twin Spheres
3.description: Verdant Spheres gains a second charge.  Passive: Kael'thas benefits from all of his level 7 talents.

1.name: Rebirth
1.description: Increases Phoenix duration by 100%. While alive, the Phoenix may be ordered to move to a different location.

2.name: Presence Of Mind
2.description: Increases Pyroblast's explosion radius by 50%. Heroes that are hit by Flamestrike or have Living Bomb spread to them reduce the cooldown of Pyroblast by 10 seconds.

3.name: Master of Flames
3.description: Living Bomb's spread from explosions can now also spread Living Bomb.

4.name: Flamethrower
4.description: Increases the cast range of Flamestrike by 40%. If Flamestrike hits 2 or more Heroes, its cooldown is reduced by 4 seconds.

1.name: Fetid Touch
1.description: Basic Attacks become ranged and Slow enemies by 20% for 1.5 seconds, but deal 35% less damage. This effect can be toggled.  Quest: Hit Heroes with Weighted Pustule.  Reward: After hitting 15 Heroes, reduce the cooldown of Weighted Pustule by 5 seconds and remove its Mana cost.

2.name: Low Blow
2.description: Lurking Arm deals 100% more damage to enemy Heroes below 50% Health and persists for 1 second after it is canceled.

3.name: Reactive Ballistospores
3.description: While below 50% Health, the cooldown of Bio-Kill Switch refreshes 100% faster.  Activate to instantly spread a Weighted Pustule to all nearby enemy Heroes and reset the cooldown of Bio-Kill Switch.  This effect has a 75 second cooldown.

1.name: One Good Spread...
1.description: After a Healing Pathogen infests 3 targets, restore 10 Mana and reduce the cooldown of Healing Pathogen by 2 seconds.

2.name: Biotic Armor
2.description: Healing Pathogen grants 10 Physical Armor to targets while active on them. Detonating Bio-Kill Switch increases this bonus to 50 for 2.5 seconds.

3.name: Vigorous Reuptake
3.description: Bio-Kill Switch heals for 30% more when detonating 3 or more Healing Pathogens.

1.name: The Long Pitch
1.description: Increase the range of Weighted Pustule by 50%. Detonating 2 or more Weighted Pustules causes Stukov's Bio-Kill Switch and Basic Ability cooldowns to recharge 100% faster for 4 seconds.

2.name: Growing Infestation
2.description: Lurking Arm's area expands by 50% over 2.5 seconds, but it cannot be Channeled for longer than 3 seconds.

3.name: Targeted Excision
3.description: Detonating exactly 1 Weighted Pustule (but any number of Healing Pathogens) with Bio-Kill Switch reduces the cooldown of Bio-Kill Switch to 7 seconds and other Basic Abilities by 1.5 seconds.

1.name: Flailing Swipe
1.description: Swipe 3 times in front of Stukov over 1.75 seconds, dealing 48 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit and knocking them away. Each swipe is larger than the previous.

2.name: Massive Shove
2.description: Extend Stukov's arm. If it hits an enemy Hero, they are rapidly shoved until they collide with terrain, dealing 190 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds. Stukov gains 50 Armor while shoving an enemy.

1.name: It Hungers
1.description: Increase the range of Lurking Arm by 30%. If Lurking Arm damages enemy Heroes 8 times, its cooldown is reset and its Mana cost is refunded.

2.name: Virulent Reaction
2.description: Detonating a Weighted Pustule on an enemy who is inside of Lurking Arm Roots them for 1.5 seconds.

3.name: Poppin' Pustules
3.description: Detonating Weighted Pustule with Bio-Kill Switch within 1.5 seconds of its expiration increases its damage by 150% and applies its damage and Slow in an area. Enemy Heroes hit have a Weighted Pustule applied to them.

1.name: Superstrain
1.description: Whenever an ally with Healing Pathogen is Stunned or Rooted, they are instantly healed for 300 (+4% per level) Health.

2.name: Universal Carrier
2.description: Healing Pathogen can continually spread through Stukov, but its healing is reduced by 25%.

3.name: Pox Populi
3.description: Bio-Kill Switch no longer removes Healing Pathogen but instead sets its duration to 3 seconds.

1.name: Controlled Chaos
1.description: Flailing Swipe gains 2 additional charges, but each use only swings 1 time, at maximum range.  Additionally, its cooldown is decreased to 25 seconds, and its Mana cost is reduced from 60 to 25.

2.name: Push Comes To Shove
2.description: Massive Shove Slows its target by 50% for 4 seconds upon colliding with terrain. If Massive Shove pushes a target for more than 1.25 seconds, its cooldown is reduced by 15 seconds.

3.name: Top Off
3.description: Healing Pathogen's heal over time is increased by 30% while its target is above 60% Health.

4.name: Bio-Explosion Switch
4.description: Bio-Kill Switch now also detonates Lurking Arm, dealing 230 (+4% per level) damage, applying a Weighted Pustule, and Silencing enemy Heroes inside for 2.5 seconds.

1.name: Longshot
1.description: Increases the cast range of Pinning Shot by 30%. Pinning Shot also increases the range of Nova's next Basic Attack by 2.

2.name: Covert Ops
2.description: After being Stealthed for 2 seconds, Pinning Shot's Slow is increased to 60% and costs no Mana. Bonus is lost after losing Stealth for 1 second.

3.name: Advanced Cloaking
3.description: After being Stealthed for 1 second, gain an additional 10% Movement Speed. While Stealthed, regenerate 3 Mana per second.

1.name: Rapid Projection
1.description: Reduces Holo Decoy's cooldown and Mana cost by 60%.

2.name: Holo Stability
2.description: Increase the cast range of Holo Decoy by 100% and its duration by 120%.  Passive: Reduce the cooldown of Ghost Protocol by 15 seconds.

3.name: Covert Mission
3.description: Enemy Minions killed near Nova grant a stack of Bribe. Hero Takedowns grant 10 stacks of Bribe. Use 25 stacks to bribe a Mercenary, instantly defeating them.  Does not work on Elite Mercenaries.  Maximum of 100 stacks. If a camp is defeated entirely with Bribe, the camp respawns 50% faster.

1.name: Perfect Shot
1.description: Hitting an enemy with Snipe reduces its cooldown by 2 seconds and refunds half its Mana cost, doubled against enemy Heroes.

2.name: One in the Chamber
2.description: After using an Ability, Nova's next Basic Attack within 3 seconds deals 65% additional damage.

3.name: Anti-Armor Shells
3.description: Nova's Basic Attacks deal 250% damage and decrease the Physical Armor of Heroic targets by 15 for 3 seconds, but her Attack Speed is proportionally slower.

1.name: Triple Tap
1.description: Locks in on the target Hero, then fires 3 shots that hit the first Hero or Structure they come in contact with for 372 (+4% per level) damage each.

2.name: Precision Strike
2.description: After a 1.5 second delay, deals 435 (+4% per level) damage to enemies within an area. Unlimited range.

1.name: Psionic Efficiency
1.description: Snipe's range is increased by 15% and hitting a Hero grants an additional stack of Precision Sniper.

2.name: Double Tap
2.description: Pinning Shot now has 2 charges, but its cooldown is increased by 2 seconds.

3.name: Ionic Force Field
3.description: Gain 25 Armor for 3 seconds after losing Stealth.

1.name: Explosive Round
1.description: Snipe also deals 90% damage to enemies near the impact.

2.name: Crippling Shot
2.description: Pinning Shot lowers a Hero's Armor by 20 for the duration of the Slow, causing them to take 20% increased damage.

3.name: Lethal Decoy
3.description: Increases the damage Holo Decoy deals to 30% of Nova's damage.

1.name: Fast Reload
1.description: Triple Tap's cooldown is reset if it kills an enemy Hero.

2.name: Precision Barrage
2.description: Precision Strike gains a 2nd charge and its cooldown is reduced by 25 seconds.

3.name: Apollo Suit
3.description: Reduce the cooldown of Permanent Cloak by 2 seconds.

4.name: Rewind
4.description: Activate to reset the cooldowns of your Basic Abilities.

1.name: Nerubian Armor
1.description: Increase Hardened Carapace's Spell Armor by 25.

2.name: Legion of Beetles
2.description: Beetles have 30 Spell Armor. Automatically spawn a Beetle every 12 seconds. Can be toggled on and off.

3.name: Regeneration Master
3.description: Quest: Gathering a Regeneration Globe increases your Health Regeneration by 1 per second, up to 30.  Reward: After gathering 30 Regeneration Globes, you also gain 500 Health.

1.name: Bed of Barbs
1.description: Create a bed of spikes along Impale's path that slows enemies by 25% and deals 21 (+4% per level) damage per second.  Spikes persist for 3.5 seconds.

2.name: Shed Exoskeleton
2.description: Harden Carapace grants 30% increased Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

3.name: Underking
3.description: Increases Burrow Charge range by 20% and damage by 100%.

1.name: Chitinous Plating
1.description: While Harden Carapace is active, taking damage from enemy Abilities reduces its cooldown by 1 second, up to 3 seconds.

2.name: Subterranean Shield
2.description: Burrow Charge also grants a 400 (+4% per level) point Shield for 5 seconds.

3.name: Leeching Scarabs
3.description: Beetles gain 30% bonus attack damage and they heal Anub'arak for 50% of their damage with each attack if he is nearby.

1.name: Locust Swarm
1.description: Deal 68 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. Each enemy damaged restores 24 (+4% per level) Health. Lasts 6 seconds.

2.name: Cocoon
2.description: Wraps target enemy Hero in a cocoon, rendering them unable to act or be targeted for 7 seconds. Allies of the Hero can attack the cocoon to break it and free them early.

1.name: Urticating Spines
1.description: Casting Harden Carapace will also deal 90 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies. Deals double damage against Heroes.

2.name: Burning Beetles
2.description: Deal 21 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. Beetles deal 6 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies.

3.name: Acid Drenched Mandibles
3.description: Attacking a Hero that is slowed, rooted, or stunned increases Anub'arak's Basic Attack damage by 80% for 4 seconds.

1.name: Epicenter
1.description: Increases Burrow Charge impact area by 60% and lowers the cooldown by 1 second for each Hero hit.

2.name: Debilitation
2.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Burrow Charge or Impale have their Spell Power reduced by 50% for 4 seconds.

3.name: Beetle, Juiced
3.description: Passive: Beetles gain 30% increased health.  Every 4th Basic Attack spawns a Beetle.

1.name: Hive Master
1.description: Gain a permanent Vampire Locust that attacks a nearby enemy every 3 seconds. The Vampire Locust deals 165 (+4% per level) damage and returns to heal Anub'arak for 80 (+4% per level) health.

2.name: Cryptweave
2.description: Staying near the Cocoon allows Anub'arak to extend the duration by up to 6 seconds per Cocoon. Upon exiting the Cocoon, enemies take 60 (+4% per level) damage over 4 seconds. This damage is increased by 100% for each second that they were inside.

3.name: The Traitor King
3.description: Gain 10% bonus maximum Health and 20 Spell Armor.  Activate to gain 75 Armor for 4 seconds.

4.name: Rewind
4.description: Activate to reset the cooldowns of your Basic Abilities.

1.name: Immolation
1.description: After using Sweeping Strike, burn nearby enemies for 22 (+4% per level) damage a second for 4 seconds.

2.name: Battered Assault
2.description: Increase Sweeping Strike's Basic Attack damage bonus duration from 3 to 5 seconds. If Sweeping Strike hits 2 Heroes its damage bonus is increased from 35% to 125%.

3.name: Unending Hatred
3.description: Quest: Minion kills grant 0.2 Basic Attack Damage. Hero Takedowns grant 1 Basic Attack Damage.  Reward: After gaining 20 increased Basic Attack Damage, receive an additional 20 Basic Attack Damage.

1.name: Reflexive Block
1.description: Using Dive grants 75 Physical Armor against the next 3 Hero Basic Attacks for 4 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 75%.

2.name: Thirsting Blade
2.description: Betrayer's Thirst's healing from Basic Attacks is increased from 30% to 50% while Sweeping Strike's damage bonus is active.

3.name: Hunter's Onslaught
3.description: Basic Abilities heal for 35% of the damage they deal. This bonus is doubled versus Heroes.

1.name: Rapid Chase
1.description: Dive grants 20% Movement Speed for 3 seconds. If the target is an enemy Hero, reduce its cooldown by 1 second.

2.name: Friend or Foe
2.description: Increases the range of Dive by 20% and allows it to be used to dive to allied Heroes.

3.name: Unbound
3.description: Sweeping Strike can go over walls and terrain.  Reward: After hitting 15 Heroes with Sweeping Strike, gain a second charge.

1.name: Metamorphosis
1.description: Transform into Demon Form at the target location, dealing 46 (+4% per level) damage in the area. Temporarily increases maximum Health by 220 (+4% per level) for each Hero hit by the initial impact. Lasts for 18 seconds.

2.name: The Hunt
2.description: Charge to target unit, dealing 251 (+4% per level) damage on impact and stunning for 1 second.

1.name: Nimble Defender
1.description: If Sweeping Strike hits an enemy Hero, gain 25 Armor for 2 seconds, reducing damage taken by 25%.

2.name: Elusive Strike
2.description: Sweeping Strike reduces the cooldown of Evasion by 3 seconds every time it damages an enemy Hero.

3.name: Sixth Sense
3.description: While active, Evasion grants Illidan 75 Spell Armor against the next 2 sources of Spell Damage, reducing their damage by 75%.

1.name: Marked for Death
1.description: Dive deals an extra 180 (+4% per level) damage if used consecutively on a target within 10 seconds.

2.name: Fiery Brand
2.description: Every 3rd attack against the same Hero deals an additional 7% of their maximum Health as damage.

3.name: Blades of Azzinoth
3.description: Hitting 5 Heroes with Sweeping Strike allows Blades of Azzinoth to be activated, increasing Basic Attack damage by 75% for 8 seconds.

1.name: Demonic Form
1.description: Permanently remain in Demonic Form. Metamorphosis also increases Attack Speed by 20% and reduces the duration of Stuns, Roots, and Slows by 50%. Illidan can now mount in Demonic Form.

2.name: Nowhere to Hide
2.description: The Hunt gains unlimited range. Illidan passively reveals enemy Heroes below 25% Health anywhere on the Battleground.

3.name: Nexus Blades
3.description: Basic Attacks deal 20% more damage and Slow enemy Movement Speed by 20% for 1 second.

4.name: Bolt of the Storm
4.description: Activate to teleport to a nearby location.

1.name: Bonds of Justice
1.description: Quest: Each tether applied to a secondary target of Umbral Bind permanently increases Umbral Bind's pull damage by 15.  Reward: After applying 5 tethers to secondary targets, increase Umbral Bind's pull damage by 75.  Reward: After applying 10 tethers to secondary targets, increase Umbral Bind's cleave damage by 30%.

2.name: Pursuit of Vengeance
2.description: Each Hero tethered by Umbral Bind reduces the cooldown of Spirit of Vengeance by 2.5 seconds and each Hero hit by Spirit of Vengeance reduces the cooldown of Umbral Bind by 1 second.

3.name: Naisha's Memento
3.description: Activate to make primary Basic Attacks bounce between nearby enemies up to 2 times. Lasts 8 seconds.  Recharge Naisha's Memento by hitting at least 2 Heroes with a single Fan of Knives.

1.name: Pin Down
1.description: Quest: Hit 3 enemy Heroes with a single Fan of Knives.  Reward: Increase Fan of Knives damage by 35%.  Reward: Each additional time 3 enemy Heroes are hit by a single Fan of Knives, gain an additional 5% damage, up to 50%.  Reward: Hit 4 enemy Heroes with a single Fan of Knives to instantly gain all Rewards.

2.name: Blade Dance
2.description: Using Fan of Knives deals 50 (+4% per level) Physical Damage to enemies around Maiev.

3.name: Sudden Vengeance
3.description: After blinking with Spirit of Vengeance, the shadow explodes, damaging all nearby enemy Heroes for 6% of their maximum Health.

1.name: Elune's Wrath
1.description: Hitting at least 2 Heroes with a single Fan of Knives causes the next Fan of Knives to drop a star on targets that deals 77 (+4% per level) damage when it impacts.

2.name: Bonds of Corruption
2.description: Enemy Heroes pulled by Umbral Bind have their Armor reduced by 15 and are Slowed by 25% for 3 seconds

3.name: Ruthless Spirit
3.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Spirit of Vengeance increases all damage Maiev deals by 15% for 4 seconds, stacking up to 30%.

1.name: Containment Disc
1.description: Throw a glaive in the target direction. If an enemy Hero is hit, Containment Disc can be reactivated to remove their vision and Time Stop them for 4 seconds. Leaving Containment Silences the enemy Hero for 1.5 seconds.  Containment Disc automatically activates 6 seconds after hitting a Hero.

2.name: Warden's Cage
2.description: Summon 8 Warden Avatars as a cage around Maiev. After 1.5 seconds, enemy Heroes that come in contact with an Avatar consume it and are knocked to the center of the cage. Warden Avatars last 5 seconds.

1.name: Bladed Armor
1.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Fan of Knives grants 5 Armor for 5 seconds, up to 20 Armor.

2.name: Chain Gang
2.description: Tethering at least 2 enemy Heroes with Umbral Bind grants 35 Armor for 4 seconds.

3.name: Shadow Armor
3.description: Blink grants 20 Armor for 3.5 seconds. Maiev's Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes refresh this duration.

1.name: Vengeful Knives
1.description: Dealing damage to enemy Heroes causes the next cast of Fan of Knives that hits enemy Heroes to deal 1% maximum Health as bonus damage, up to 5%.

2.name: Cruel Chain
2.description: Umbral Bind grants 25% Movement Speed for 2.5 seconds. In addition, each time Maiev deals damage to tethered targets, Umbral Bind's pull damage to all targets is increased by 30%, up to 150%.

3.name: Armored Assault
3.description: While Maiev has positive Armor of any kind, all Physical Damage dealt is increased by 25%.

1.name: Shadow Orb: Vengeance
1.description: Activate to reset the cooldown of Spirit of Vengeance.  Recharge Shadow Orb by damaging enemy Heroes with Spirit of Vengeance 5 times.

2.name: Shadow Orb: Huntress
2.description: Activate to increase Movement Speed and Attack Speed by 40% for 5 seconds.  Recharge Shadow Orb by dealing Physical Damage to enemy Heroes 10 times.

3.name: Shadow Orb: Shadow Strike
3.description: Activate to deal 75 (+4% per level) damage to an enemy Hero, Slowing them by 30% and reducing their Armor by 20 for 4 seconds.  Recharge Shadow Orb by dealing Spell Damage to enemy Heroes 10 times.

1.name: Evenhanded Blessings
1.description: If Flash Heal is cast on a different target from its last, increase its healing by 15% and refund 40% of its cooldown.

2.name: Power Word: Shield
2.description: While Divine Star is traveling out, allies in its path gain a Shield that absorbs 128 (+4% per level) damage for 4 seconds.  If Divine Star hits an enemy Hero, Anduin gains a Shield that absorbs 185 (+4% per level) damage for 4 seconds.

3.name: Lightwell
3.description: Summon a Lightwell that periodically heals a nearby allied Hero for 50 (+4% per level). The well only fades after healing 15 times or when recast.  This cooldown is reduced by 1 second each time Anduin heals an allied Hero.

1.name: Moral Compass
1.description: Divine Star fires Basic Attacks at Heroes close to its apex.  Passive: Increase Attack Range by 1.1.

2.name: Surge of Light
2.description: Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Chastise by 0.75 seconds. Basic Attacks against Heroes Rooted by Chastise launch an additional Basic Attack and restore 25 Mana.

3.name: Piercing Light
3.description: Chastise pierces to hit an additional Hero.  Quest: Hitting two Heroes with a single Chastise permanently increases Spell Power by 1, to a maximum of 10.

1.name: Binding Heal
1.description: Casting Flash Heal on an ally heals Anduin for 135 (+4% per level).

2.name: Blessed Recovery
2.description: If Anduin loses more than 8% of his maximum Health at once, recover 15% Health over 3 seconds.  This effect has a 10 second cooldown.  Current Health required: 133 (+4% per level)

3.name: Desperate Prayer
3.description: Activate to instantly heal an allied Hero for 375 (+4% per level), but kneel for 2 seconds, unable to act.

1.name: Holy Word: Salvation
1.description: After 0.5 seconds, Channel to invoke the Light for 3 seconds. While nearby, allied Heroes heal for up to 30% of their max Health and are Protected.

2.name: Lightbomb
2.description: Imbue an allied Hero with the Light. After 1.5 seconds, it explodes, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage to enemies and Stunning them for 1.25 seconds.  The target gains a Shield that absorbs 165 (+4% per level) damage per enemy Hero hit. Lasts for 5 seconds.

1.name: Speed of the Pious
1.description: While Divine Star is traveling, gain 30% Movement Speed.  Each allied Hero healed by Divine Star on its return to Anduin reduces its cooldown by 1 second.

2.name: Push Forward!
2.description: Damaging an enemy Hero increases Movement Speed by 2.5% and the amount healed by Pursued By Grace by 5% for 6 seconds. These effects stack up to 8 times.

3.name: Enchant Boots - Lion's Speed
3.description: Gain 5% Movement Speed. This bonus is quadrupled while Leap of Faith's cooldown is available. Allies pulled by Leap of Faith are healed for 280 (+4% per level) over 4 seconds.

1.name: Renew
1.description: Flash Heal heals an additional 180 (+4% per level) over 6 seconds. The duration of this heal is refreshed each time Anduin hits an enemy Hero with a Basic Attack.

2.name: Holy Nova
2.description: After Anduin catches Divine Star, it explodes, healing nearby allied Heroes for 105 (+4% per level) and damaging enemies for 150 (+4% per level).

3.name: Glyph of Faith
3.description: Leap of Faith gains a 2nd charge.

4.name: Inner Focus
4.description: Activate to reset the cooldown of Flash Heal and its next cast heals for 25% more.  Damaging enemy Heroes reduces this cooldown by 1 second.

1.name: Light of Stormwind
1.description: Holy Word: Salvation grants allied Heroes Invulnerability instead of Protected. This does not affect Anduin.  Channeling Holy Word: Salvation for its full duration reduces its cooldown by 60 seconds.

2.name: Inner Fire
2.description: The target of Light Bomb gains 40% Move Speed and 50 Armor for 3 seconds.

3.name: Censure
3.description: Chastise Stuns for 0.75 seconds and its Root duration is increased by 0.5 seconds.

4.name: Varian's Legacy
4.description: Basic Attacks burn enemies for 87 (+4% per level) damage over 3 seconds and Anduin heals for 50% of the damage dealt.

1.name: Quarterback
1.description: Increases Frag Grenade's damage by 10% and its range by 50%.

2.name: Dash
2.description: Increase the range of Run and Gun by 50%. When cast, increase Tychus's Movement Speed by 20% for 2.5 seconds.

3.name: Press the Advantage
3.description: Increase Tychus's Basic Attack range by 1.

1.name: In the Rhythm
1.description: Quest: While Minigun is active, Basic Attacks against Heroes permanently increase future Minigun durations by 0.03 seconds.

2.name: The Bigger They Are...
2.description: Increase the damage bonus to 4% while enemy Heroes are above 30% Health, but Minigun no longer has any effect on targets below 30%.

3.name: Master Assassin
3.description: Passive: Increase Tychus's Attack Speed by 10%.  Reward: After getting 15 Takedowns, Tychus's Attack Speed is increased by an additional 15%.

1.name: Melting Point
1.description: Enemies hit by Frag Grenade take an additional 75 (+4% per level) damage over 3 seconds. This damage is increased by 100% against Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters.

2.name: Combat Tactician
2.description: Reduce the cooldown of Minigun by 4 seconds. Reduce the cooldown of Minigun by an additional 4 seconds after using Run and Gun.

3.name: Relentless Soldier
3.description: Being Stunned or Rooted grants 30 Armor for 3 seconds, reducing damage taken by 30%.

1.name: Commandeer Odin
1.description: Call down an Odin to pilot. The Odin deals increased Damage, has 100% increased Basic Attack range, and uses different Abilities. The Odin has 25 Armor and lasts 23 seconds.

2.name: Drakken Laser Drill
2.description: Call down a Laser Drill to attack nearby enemies, dealing 142 (+4% per level) damage every second. Reactivate to assign a new target. Lasts 22 seconds.

1.name: Spray 'n' Pray
1.description: Overkill Slows enemy Movement Speed by 25% and its range is increased by 25%.

2.name: That's the Stuff!
2.description: Minigun heals Tychus for 100% of the bonus damage dealt after it expires.

3.name: Neosteel Coating
3.description: Activate to gain 75 Spell Armor for 4 seconds, reducing Ability Damage taken by 75%.

1.name: Armor Piercing Rounds
1.description: Each time Overkill hits an enemy, its damage against them is increased by 15%, stacking up to 60% bonus damage.

2.name: Titan Grenade
2.description: Frag Grenade deals bonus damage to Heroes equal to 5% of their maximum Health.  Each enemy Hero hit by Frag Grenade reduces its cooldown by 1 second.

3.name: Sizzlin' Attacks
3.description: Basic Attacks deal bonus damage to Heroes equal to 1% of their maximum Health. Stacks with Minigun.

1.name: Big Red Button
1.description: Odin lasts 50% longer and Ragnarok Missiles also launches a Nuclear Missile which lands 2.5 seconds later, dealing 319 (+4% per level) damage in its area.

2.name: Focusing Diodes
2.description: Increases the range of the Drakken Laser Drill by 50%.  Deals increasing damage the longer it remains on a single target, up to 100% extra damage.

3.name: Can Do This All Day
3.description: Reduce Overkill's cooldown by 5 seconds.  While Channeling Overkill, Tychus gains 40 Armor.

4.name: Bob and Weave
4.description: Run and Gun and Odin's Thrusters gain 2 additional charges and reduces Run and Gun's Mana cost from 50 to 25.  After using Run and Gun, increase Tychus's Basic Attack range by 1.5 for 4 seconds.

1.name: Deep Roots
1.description: Entangling Roots grows 25% larger, and persist on the ground 40% longer.  Repeatable Quest: Every time an enemy Hero becomes Rooted, gain 14 Mana permanently.

2.name: Vengeful Roots
2.description: Entangling Roots spawns a Treant that deals 58 damage per second and lasts 10 seconds.  Repeatable Quest: Hitting enemy Heroes with Entangling Roots permanently increases the Treant's Basic Attack damage by 7.

3.name: Emerald Dreams
3.description: Entangling Roots Sleeps enemy Heroes for 2 seconds after its Root expires.

1.name: Rejuvenation
1.description: Casting Regrowth on an ally also grants Malfurion its effect for 50% normal duration.

2.name: Celestial Alignment
2.description: Increase Moonfire's reveal duration by 3 seconds. Malfurion's Basic Attacks against Heroes revealed by Moonfire deal 85% more damage.

3.name: Shan'do's Clarity
3.description: Gain a second charge of Innervate. Its cooldown recharges 25% faster per ally affected by Regrowth.

1.name: Wild Growth
1.description: Each Hero hit by Moonfire extends the duration of currently active Regrowths by 1 second.

2.name: Tenacious Roots
2.description: Increase the Root duration of Entangling Roots by 25%. When Malfurion is Stunned, the cooldown of Entangling Roots is instantly reset. This can only occur every 10 seconds.

3.name: Nature's Cure
3.description: Activate to remove all Stuns, Roots, and Slows from allies affected by Regrowth.

1.name: Tranquility
1.description: Heal nearby allied Heroes for 80 (+4% per level) Health per second for 8 seconds. Allies affected by Regrowth within Tranquility's area gain 10 Armor.

2.name: Twilight Dream
2.description: After 0.5 seconds, deal 310 (+4% per level) damage in a large area around Malfurion, Silencing enemies making them unable to use Abilities for 3 seconds.

1.name: Nature's Swiftness
1.description: Malfurion gains 6% Movement Speed for every active Regrowth.

2.name: Hindering Moonfire
2.description: Moonfire Slows Heroes hit by 25% for 3 seconds.

3.name: Revitalize
3.description: Using Innervate also grants Malfurion 15% of his max Mana and causes his Basic Ability cooldowns to refresh 50% faster for 5 seconds.

1.name: Ysera's Gift
1.description: While Malfurion is above 75% Health, Regrowth's healing-over-time is increased by 75%.

2.name: Nature's Balance
2.description: Increase Moonfire's area by 25% and Regrowth's duration by 5 seconds.

3.name: Moonlit Harmony
3.description: Increase Moonfire's heal by 20%, and 15% per ally affected by Regrowth.

1.name: Serenity
1.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Moonfire reduces the cooldown of Tranquility by 3 seconds. Increase Tranquility's healing by 25% and 10% per ally affected by Regrowth.

2.name: Astral Communion
2.description: Activate to Channel for 1 second, and then instantly teleport and cast Twilight Dream at the targeted location.  Cooldown is shared with Twilight Dream.  Passive: Increase Twilight Dream's Silence duration to 5 seconds.

3.name: Lifebloom
3.description: Casting Regrowth instantly heals its target for 10% of their missing Health.

4.name: Lunar Shower
4.description: If Moonfire hits a Hero, its cooldown is reduced by 1 second and the next Moonfire within 6 seconds deals 20% more damage. This damage bonus stacks up to 60%.

1.name: One-Two Punch
1.description: Reduce the cooldown of Melee by 1 second and it gains an additional charge.

2.name: Parting Gift
2.description: Recall leaves behind 6 bombs that deal 240 (+4% per level) damage each to different targets. Heroes hit with these bombs are slowed by 50% for 0.75 seconds and grant 7% Pulse Bomb charge.

3.name: Tracer Rounds
3.description: Increase Basic Attack range by 10%. Basic Attacks against Heroes reveal a small area around them for 3 seconds.

1.name: Leeching Rounds
1.description: Increase the healing from Basic Attacks by up to 200%, based on the amount of health Tracer is missing.

2.name: Pulse Generator
2.description: Successfully sticking a Pulse Bomb to an enemy Hero heals Tracer for 18% of her maximum Health over 1.5 seconds and refunds a charge of Blink.

3.name: Is That a Health Pack?!
3.description: Collecting a Regeneration Globe instantly heals Tracer for 10% of her maximum Health and reduces the cooldown of Healing Fountain by 15 seconds.  Drinking from a Healing Fountain instantly heals for 20% of Tracer's maximum Health.

1.name: Sleight of Hand
1.description: Reduces Reload time by 50%. This equals 20% more damage per second.

2.name: Focus Fire
2.description: If an entire ammo magazine is unloaded on an enemy, the last bullet will deal 80 (+4% per level) bonus damage.  This is equal to 35% of the total magazine.

3.name: Locked and Loaded
3.description: Reactivate Reload within the last 50% of its cast time to increase Tracer's Basic Attack damage by 40% for that magazine.

1.name: Sticky Bomb
1.description: Increases Pulse Bomb's radius by 50% and enemies hit are Slowed by 70% for 3 seconds.

2.name: Quantum Spike
2.description: Pulse Bomb deals an additional 6% of maximum Health as damage to Heroes.

3.name: Pulse Rounds
3.description: Increases Pulse Bomb's range and charge rate from Basic Attacks against Heroes by 100%.

1.name: Untouchable
1.description: Passive: After Blinking, gain 20% Movement Speed for 1.25 seconds.  Quest: Takedowns increase Tracer's Basic Attack damage by 5%, up to 25%. These bonuses are lost on death.

2.name: Jumper
2.description: Passive: When Blink has no charges remaining, its cooldown refreshes 150% faster.  Casting Blink grants Tracer a Shield equal to 6.5% of her maximum Health for 3 seconds. This Shield stacks up to 3 times.

3.name: Telefrag
3.description: Passive: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes reduce the cooldown of Recall by 0.1875 seconds.  When Tracer arrives at her Recall location she becomes Unkillable for 1 second and nearby enemies take 175 (+4% per level) damage and are knocked back.

1.name: Bullet Spray
1.description: Increases the radius of Melee by 30%, and causes it to damage all enemies in range.

2.name: Heavy Handed
2.description: Heroes hit by Melee have their Armor reduced by 15 for 4 seconds.

3.name: Ricochet
3.description: Tracer's Basic Attacks have a 60% chance to hit another nearby enemy, prioritizing Heroes.

1.name: Chrono Triggers
1.description: Casting Blink causes Basic Attacks to not consume ammo for 1 second.

2.name: Get Stuffed!
2.description: Increases Melee's Pulse Bomb charge against Heroes from 10% to 20%. Hitting an enemy with Melee who is stuck with a Pulse Bomb causes the bomb to instantly explode and knock the target away.

3.name: Total Recall
3.description: Recall heals Tracer equal to the amount of Health she lost during that time.

4.name: Composition B
4.description: Successfully sticking a Pulse Bomb to an enemy Hero also drops another one at their feet that deals 50% damage and explodes slightly earlier.
